Anniversary Celebration
Doctor, I... I'm really going to treasure all the time we've spent together. And if I ever go back one day, I'll never forget you.

So it's your birthday, Doctor! No wonder there's so many people aboard. Sorry, I didn't get a present ready in time for this, um... you can have this scroll from the Hall for Spirits, and if you're ever in danger, it'll save your life!
Hello, Doctor!
New Year's blessing
Happy New Year, Doctor. This is for you. It's lou mei from Ah Gen, since he wanted to thank everyone for treating us so well the past year.
Assigned to Facility
I can't forget about the mission the Doctor gave me. But this mat's so comfortable, and the sun's so warm. I think I'm getting kinda sleepy...
Operation Failure
It's all my fault for being so weak, Doctor...
Sub 3-star Result
Phew—lucky. You're still fine, right?
3-star Result
There's just mighty people everywhere.
4-star Result
Is everyone okay? I'm so, so glad!
Doctor, grab onto me, I'll use my power to send us there. It's quicker that way.
Appointed as Squad Leader
I'm gonna be the captain? Can I handle that...?
Added to Squad
Doctor, I'm here! Huh? Is there something on my face? Ah, I just finished eating, haha.
Promotion 2
I still don't really get it, but thanks, Doctor.
Promotion 1
Promotion? What does that mean?
Watching Battle Record
Doctor... if I don't understand these tapes, can I ask you about them?
Hello, Doctor, my name's Xiaohei, and I'm a spirit.
Doctor, are you eating something secret there?
Talk after Trust Increase 3
Doctor, are we friends now? Then if you can, you should visit our side to play sometime!
Talk after Trust Increase 2
I'll be an Executor someday, just like my master. My master's really mighty! Um... you too. Everyone on this battleship listens to you, so you've got to be somebody incredible.
Talk after Trust Increase 1
I get it! Operators are Executors, aren't they? Executors do errands for the Hall for Spirits, and Operators do errands for Rhodes Island! Huh? No?
Talk after Promotion 2
There's so many Catastrophes here... Is this why your cities have to keep wandering everywhere all the time?
Talk after Promotion 1

This place is a lot like the Hall for Spirits to me, with all the Infected staying here because they have nowhere to go. But... the Infected have it really different from spirits. They can't even escape just by staying far away from everyone.
The people here look a lot like the spirits in our world. So maybe, the spirits in this world look like you do, Doctor?
My power is controlling metal, stuff like the thing on your table. I can make it turn pointy, round, or flat, and even more complicated shapes too.

What are you doing here? There's these Medic Operators who keep chasing my tail all the time saying they wanna study me! I need to lay low! Still, why are you hiding here too? You're not slacking off, right, Doctor?
Appointed as Assistant
This table's really high! I guess it's easier if I just use my old form to jump up.

In the beginning, all I wanted was to survive. But before I knew it, I'd shouldered the responsibility for leading my people. I want to find myself, and my people, a home. Doctor, should I keep walking with Rhodes Island, will I be able to?

Doctor, happy birthday. This is for you. Ah, it's a stone sculpture of my making, not a 'friend'. 'Friends' can't be given away as presents. You like it? I could teach you, sometime, to talk to my friends. Are you interested?
Hello, Doctor.

The New Year? I see. Another year has passed. I... never liked days like this before, the whole idea of 'out with the old, in with the new.' What we lost has always left a much deeper impression than what we gained, but maybe things are slightly different now. Mm—may I join in on the dinner party? Doctor?
Trust Tap
Doctor? Could you stay with me for a bit? I'd like... to ask you a little about Kazdel. Ah, and my friends have missed you, too.
...Mm? Did you touch me just now?
The ceiling's... a little lower than I imagined.
This isn't the first time I've turned and run from an enemy. If this is how we save lives... I'll cover your backs.
Chase them... I'll watch over the battlefield with my friends' eyes.
My friends are quietly celebrating. They're cheering for our victory, Doctor.
Running is pointless... Resist, even if you lost the will. This is the only way I've learned to face suffering.
In Battle 4
Arise, great boulder.
In Battle 3
Heed my call.
In Battle 2
Rise into mountains.
In Battle 1
The land is as my friend.
Deployment 2
Fight for yourself.
Deployment 1
War… war never changes.
Selecting Operator 2
Orders please. The rocks are listening.
Selecting Operator 1
The soil answers my will.
Begin Operation
The enemy…
It's time to fight.
I'm captain…? I don't like to lead, but… I'm used to it.
I'm a Rhodes Island Operator, now. I'll obey your commands.
Hm? A nice change of pace? I never take my helmet off in battle, after all... There's a lot of reasons why, but things have changed now. K... Keep it off? If I have to…
They used to call me Reunion, and then the Mudrock Squad, and now... I've been promoted by my former enemy. Is this what they meant by 'life is a highway'?
I've had a taste of how Rhodes Island fights before, but, well, this still makes a great reference...
Sarkaz mercenary, Mudrock... You're the Doctor, then. Rhodes Island has saved me many times, and now, I'd like you to let me return the favor.
...The one in the hood napping there is the Doctor. Remember that well. Our road together is sure to be a long one.

From Kazdel to Leithanien, so many marks carved into suffering. The moment they had no choice but to fight, and realized they had nothing at all. How do you see me, Doctor? You trust me? Will that trust... let me live on?

Me... talking to a clay doll... all alone...? Y-You... you saw me? That was just a little ritual… huh? So everyone already knew? R-Really? Then I'll be more careful next time, do it late when no one's around... um, I shouldn't?

I became a Rhodes Island Operator to see my people treated well, to see them live on, and to give my fighters' deaths... real meaning. But... since coming to Rhodes Island, I've seen clearly what I, myself, am truly fighting for. That was a first for me.

Dr. Kal'tsit, huh...? I'm surprised, but she's very reassuring... One thing, though. Rhodes Island seems to have some involvement with another mercenary group. Could you tell me about them, Doctor? It's best I don't know? I see... then I think I can guess who we're talking about.

I often think of the fighters, the friends who have left us. Sometimes, I get lost in the idea that even now, I'm still fleeing... Doctor, have you been to Kazdel? That place... was the start of my journey, and once, I thought it would be my... end.

That elite operator... I thought the Arts I saw in Leithanien were already really fantastical. And yet, when I saw him just brush aside the mist, I realized, as a Sarkaz, he was young, but also ancient.

Thank-you letters? Ah, from the Sarkaz workers yesterday? My equipment and type of Arts are a good match for physical work. Besides, their materials and fuel are heavy. And they rely on flesh and blood power to ensure Rhodes Island sails smooth... it's incredible.
Closure told me I shouldn't walk about Rhodes Island 'fully equipped'... but I'm not used to... revealing... myself. Sorry...
Hm? Ah, this handful of soil... it can murmur. It can dance. It is my friend.
Your eyes… remind me of a friend. Idealistic eyes, shining bright. Don't worry, I'll help you out—by my rules.
Birthdays only come once a year. So, what would you like to eat? Anything you fancy. Yes, even a pineapple pizza, if you dare—though I'm sure you know you'll pay for it someday.
Demetri Certaldo Bellone, happy to serve.

The new year is a time for family gatherings. I should go eat with my famiglia. An unshakable tradition. We'll have dinner together after that. It might be a late one, but I'll make it back before the clock turns over.
Let's go for a walk and inspect our territory.
Did I miss something important?
You have a big famiglia of your own. That's no easy feat, making sure they're all cared for.
Let's see… how can we flip the situation to our advantage?
Stragglers will return for revenge, so we'll have to devise a plan to eradicate all possible threats.
Not all donuts come out with a hole. I'll review it when we get back.
Meticulous plans, finely executed. You'll get used to these splendid triumphs with me around, Doctor.
Don't worry. I'll take care of your family when you're gone.
This is the price you pay for offending the famiglia.
It's time to repay your debt.
The Bellones say hello.
I'll handle it.
Leave it to me.
Don't hesitate.
You're asking me? I say it's time to move.
Stay silent and wait.
I don't need so many hands with me. Those on standby, just watch us work.
Do as I say, and ask no questions.
Let's go. It's time we witness the fruition of our plans.
Titles and tokens don't necessarily equate to trust, but at least they show how you see me. È un onore.
A promotion… It's been a long time since someone's used this word with me. Feels fresh.
Violence is only the means, and not the end. But these pups are too inefficient at it.
So Leon's codename is 'Vigil'? Abandoning both his family and his name… I see. Well then, Operator Bellone, reporting in.
You're looking a little sluggish… it's time to rest. Here's a cocktail. Salute.

Passively carrying out orders isn't my style. Taking control, eliminating all obstacles when the opportunity strikes, and achieving my objective, by any means—That's how I do things, so you'll want to get used to it, Doctor.

Of course, you may overlook my concern and kindness, as many do when they first meet me. But soon, you will meet something you can't manage on your own, and then, well… Someday, and that day may never come, I will call upon you to do a service for me. And you will say sì.

You were told that enjoying authentic Siracusan cuisine is a proper show of respect to a Siracusan? No, I differ on this. You come to my home, and I make sure you're sated. Finishing the food on your plate is a show of respect to me, è così semplice.

You think the Bellone name is important? No, what's important is our people and our bond. As for Rhodes Island… we have an excellent working relationship, but if you hope to advance our working relationship even further… you'll have to prove a familial bond exists between us first, Doctor.

At first, the famiglie were just packs of runts keeping each other alive, while the dons used them as tools to grab power. But in Nuova Volsinii, under Leon's rules, a famiglia does imply a real family now—at least, that's how it is for the Bellones.

You want to learn to knuckle-roll a lighter as fast as I do? It's easy, here. Don't worry, just try again. I practice these tricks to keep my hands nimble—after all, there are times when you can't just draw a blade, even in Siracusa.

The Bellones took me in when I was five, and trained me to become Leon's consigliere. With this bulky suitcase in tow, I went to many places and met many faces as I ran errands and collected intelligence. Even now, I still do many things myself.

There are no famiglie in Nuova Volsinii, not a single one. A famiglia must flip into a corporation before it can enter the city, and that's hardly a bother. Indeed… and there's not much difference between a mafia and a corporation, whether Siracusan or foreign.
Sort these files? Fine, but before we begin your trivial task, you might have a look at these plans I've mapped out for you.

When I set out, I grabbed all the spools of thread from the store, thinking to myself that I had to surpass Nonno before the thread ran out. And at this moment, I still have plenty of thread left—Doctor, do you think I've met my goal?

Happy birthday, Doctor! Come and try this new outfit. I based it off the measurements of your coat to make sure it would fit. Huh? I made it too small? Nonsense, you must've eaten too much cake! No, no, that's not the issue. I have all the tools on me right now. Let me fix it for you!
Oh, Doctor, what a spiffy ensemble you've got there today. Oh? This is what you always wear? Err... Well, that's worth complimenting too!

The mafiosi had their own secret ways of exchanging New Year's greetings. Back in the shop, we'd sew lace onto sleeves and gift leather wallets to our clients to celebrate the occasion. But none of these rituals seem appropriate for Rhodes Island. Getting to say 'Happy New Year' is more than good enough.
Doctor, have you settled on the style you'd like to have made?
Alright, alright! I'm focused!
Any place to stash my toolkit?
Don't worry. It's only natural to waste some material when tailoring a suit.
Thank goodness we accomplished our mission. Tsk, why is there a loose thread...?
This tactic was tailor-made for today's battle!
A perfect stitch!
Keep your back straight—Tsk, tsk. Who told you to keel over?
Stand still while I'm measuring!
Such poor taste!
A waste of perfectly good fabric.
Ready with the needle.
Time to take measurements.
Got a fabric in mind?
Got a style in mind?
Hmph. Tough customers.
Suit up, and set out.
Formulating strategies? Phew... Okay, I can do this, nothing I can't handle. It's just like threading a needle...
Trust me, I'm capable of handling field operations.
Does this second promotion mean I can finally take charge on my own?
I appreciate the thought, but you really don't have to go out of your way to treat me like a child.
Well, can't be any harder than learning to tailor.
This where I report in, right? Sorry, I came without getting changed first. Oh, I don't need to do that? Thank goodness, I feel more comfortable wearing familiar clothes.
One end of the thread's over here, and other's over here... Ugh, it's all messed up again. What, do you think tailors never get their threads tangled?

Fold this corner first, go around twice like this, and finally tie it around your neck—Oops, the scarf doesn't match. How about I just make you a complete Siracusan ensemble? It won't take anything I don't already know, so you might as well say yes.

Doctor, did you not sleep well? I can see the bags under your eyes. Why not take a page from my book and use some eyeshadow to make yourself look more energetic? Never mind. Even though you're the type who never gets enough rest, you can always freshen up quick when it's time to get serious. I'll take care of dressing you then.

It's alright, I can finish these letters on my own. See, they're from our neighbors, di Montano's regulars. Even though they know that Nonno isn't around anymore, they still send their regards to the shop... Maybe that's what he meant by 'respectability'.

I thought the end of Carnival was just as cruel as Siracusa's old fairy tales. But when midnight came and the fireworks burst into the night sky, everyone could still truly celebrate together... And that's how a fairy tale should end, right? I wonder if the tale of Siracusa to come will be like that too.

Once upon a time, I wanted to join the ranks of Siracusa's worthies, but Nonno only taught me how to hold a ruler and a pair of scissors. Yet with those two tools alone, he managed to win the respect of so many such worthies... There's still a lot for me to learn, and for now, I want to start with a new suit of clothes.

Nonno used to tell me all sorts of fanciful stories so I wouldn't get bored in the shop. I've been able to retell those stories backwards and forwards for ages, so how could I believe in them...? Woah! D-Doctor, just now, there was a doll floating by! Y-You didn't see it? Don't try to scare me!

The tailor shop isn't half bad. Look at this way: I have two brothers; one went to the police academy, the other joined a famiglia, and the two have never spoken since. But at the tailor shop, they're both my customers. They come to me when they need their clothes made.

This strap buckle came from a Carnival stall, and the strap itself is an old measuring tape of mine. The hairpin was customized with a beading needle, and I embroidered this pattern here myself... It's too flamboyant? I'll have you know, this is the pinnacle of Siracusan style. Get with the times.

Back when I was an assistant at the shop, I recorded whole binders of hundreds of different customers' preferences. Materials, hem lengths, even the number of buttons they wanted on the cuffs. Rhodes Island's paperwork couldn't be more complicated than–– W-Wait, this much?!

I contacted Rhodes Island in the first place because it was the most suitable place to treat Lisa. But now, I would send her here to learn, even if she was cured. Do not let this landship ever stop, Doctor, not after it has been sailing for so long.
Buon compleanno, Doctor. Lisa's papa asked me to give you this omamori. He hopes to visit you in person, if given the chance. As for me, I offer a promise: call my name anytime you need my blade.
Ciao, Doctor... I can hear your footsteps even with folded ears, you know.

Happy New Year. What a wonderful gathering. Dancing, chatting, making noise for a reason other than muffling troublesome movements —Lisa's making her way here, Doctor. That was sake in my cup and not a double whiskey shot, correct?
The scar on my face? I wasn't born with it... no, never mind.
Huh? Even Lisa has grown out of this by now.
The soundproofing is excellent. Was it done for professional reasons?
Leave the rest to me... it's clear why we failed, and I know how to make it even.
It's not easy to pull yourself out of the mud, but there is no need to stay serious all the time.
There's nothing to clean up. Let's go.
Higashinese shoji screens often run a common theme. The kami created life and land to propagate themselves... a pity they didn't care for what came next. Sorting out this mess is hard work.
Why the rush? The road to hell is crowded enough.
Try getting my coat off first.
Flowers imbibed, the woman in suit and tie—a dance with her blade.
Hate and resentment have no place, but in a burst of autumn red.
Posto bellissimo.
Fa bel tempo.
So much negotiation and we end up talking with our blades.
I'm all ears. Speak.
You want to parley? A rare business for me, whether in Siracusa or Higashi.
My ears are sharp, so when I stop, you stop.
Just keep yourselves safe.
Leave the toughest one for me.
I accept your medal, Doctor. But enough talk, I do know the difference between this decoration and the emblems of the Siracusan famiglie.
I appreciate the recognition. But this means those after the bounty on my head will come looking for Rhodes Island. You are not worried?
It's not often I see recordings of myself. I fought my battles in quiet alleyways, with no witnesses.
Ciao. I've always been curious what 'the incredible Doctor' Lisa always mentioned in her letters looked like... heh. And here you are. Could you update me on her schooling? If you have the time?
I'm over here, just call me if you need something... I am a very patient woman, Doctor. Did you ever try combing nineteen tails in one go?

So much snow on the deck, and yet the corridors are not cold. I detest inconsistent weather, so the landship has been a blessing—I only just realized how long I've been here. You're right: An assassin's vacation is a good thing, for herself, and others.

The wine tasting is already finished? I went to fix my suit and hurried back as quick as I could... Ah, scusa. I forgot to look at my watch. My work requires careful timekeeping—there is a method behind the timing at which the bastardi die. But why not stay a while? Whiskey is a fine drink, special occasion or no.

Why are you staring so emptily? Is something bothering you? Perhaps some work less suited to a so-called pharmaceutical company? If I can be of help, then speak, Doctor... My patience will last only until I finish this braid.
How was my return trip to Siracusa, you ask? The guilty party is dead, so there is little else to say. How could one who made so many suffer on a quest for power die with honor?

No need to hide the Wolumonde story from me... You look nervous, but I'm not here to cast blame, my daughter knows her work is meaningful. The Suzuran is no fragile flower, and I am no old-fashioned gardener.

You have some nervous Operators here. Perhaps they could try reciting a haiku or two to pace their breaths. Like 'Solitude seeps not from autumn's shade, but from the mountain pines in red sun's fall.' Or 'I bear no off'ring branch unto the hills, for rich brocades of maple sate the gods.'—these poems evoke a particular image? Hm. I suppose.

Uniform? No, grazie. I don't understand why you people need so many pockets, just as I can't grasp why the Higashinese love stuffing planks and pillows into their waists, making it so terribly hard to move around... I'm comfortable in this outfit, and it has nothing to do with me being Siracusan.

These are clothes and snacks for Lisa, and these are some gifts I prepared for her friends. As for this box of old books her papa insisted I bring, I'm not sure what they're for. I'll just let my daughter handle it herself, once she's here.
Have someone else handle the paperwork and filing. But if you need anyone dealt with, or protected, just give me the list of names and I will go.

Hah, the things you and the Rhodes Islanders do are quite interesting indeed. Siracusa, no, all of Terra is a filthy swamp, yet Rhodes Island manages to hold on still. Is it because you're so adaptable, or—did you have a hand in writing the rules of the game?

One birthday, my father brought me to tour a vineyard in bloom. Back then, I wondered why there was no monstrous vehicle to run it down to ruin, along with the whole of Siracusa—What? No, I bought this bottle of vino off some random shelf. That manor became a trash heap long ago.
Here's a carnival costume. Put it on.

Happy New Year! You're inviting me in? How will you introduce me? Texas's archenemy, the Saluzzo traitor, or the white wolf who would conquer all? Enjoy the evening, Doctor. The twin moons shall rise only for the hunt as before.
Vieni qui! Dance with the wolves.
Haha... is this how you greet Texas too?
It's quiet in here—not afraid to miss the excitement outside?
Defeat? Hahahaha. That's just the end of Act One.
Every mask has fallen. Aloof faces, shameful grimaces, and some finally about to lose it all... what fun!
Work's over, time for a drink. Where is Texas?
A grand spectacle, a perfect show, a dignified exit... Bravo, but I won't applaud your efforts—unless an accident befalls this act, hahahaha.
Do not disappoint tonight, my friends!
The spotlight shines on us. Hahahaha!
What are you waiting for? The curtains are about to fall!
Che fare? Saw you right away.
No hiding, no holding back. A secret exposed means nothing to hide.
We've all drawn our weapons, why wait?
Look, Zaaro! See the game we humans are born to play—
What a riotous revelry! Did the show start without me?
The mad lead the blind! Hahahaha! 'Tis no wonder they never tire!
Ah, the parade's here.
A wolfpack I am.
Where be the barrens? Where be civilization?
Are you trying to placate me? Or do you think the game isn't fun enough...? I can't figure it out. It's no wonder I find your trust so entertaining!
Not a chance. I don't think Rhodes Island could throw a decent carnival, even if we put a mask on each and every one of you.
Bah. What a bore!
Quanto tempo. Oh no, did my weapon take your seat on the sofa...? A pity I was here first. What happened on the carnival stage, you ask? Why so curious?
Doctor, I do wonder... What would you trade for the peaceful nights you once knew?

You care very much for Rhodes Island, much as Texas cares for her companions—that serious look on your face! Buonissimo! Why don't we make a wager, with this landship... you count me as a part of this place too? Molto interessante, Doctor.

Whiskey, on the rocks, with a mint garnish. Don't mind me, taking a few shots here while you carry on with your grand ambitions. I'd ease up on the goodness, or the suffering will double when ruin comes for you.

Texas said I'd show up eventually? She knows me so well. Anyone would burn their bindings to cinders, but how many dare to remain and sift through the ashes to find what's left? Hahahaha, there is no shame in running away. Just pray for an end to the daily dreams of returning to the flames!

Zitti. I won't have another 'wasteland', or 'civilization' enter my ears—our new game is not so boring. You must learn quickly how the humans play... Hahahaha, you overheard me? Then, Doctor, let's have you stand against me.

The famiglie, the government, Signora Sicilia... every party has proved their own theories for their own gain. But how is a new city enough? What they want is a brand new country! And me? I want to see all their wishes come true, of course!

The left sword drops, donating wineries to the city. The right blade falls, offering free admission to next year's carnival—Hahahaha, even as that obsessive, controlling father of mine rots away in jail, the Siracusans will never forget him!

Ah, è una bellissima giornata—Siracusa's rainy season is over, and the Grey Hall vecchi can no longer stay in their seats as all the hungry opportunists rush in. Hahahaha, could the carnival have been such a roaring success without my help?

It's Siracusan tradition to mask up and dress formally for a kill, but the people of Nuova Volsinii think such costuming means embracing a new life. You must find the best tailor for the job, regardless of the occasion, no? I certainly have.
Leaving all this work to me? Hahahaha, I appreciate your trust.

Here, take some whiskey, add a little amaretto, then put it on the rocks. Wanna sip? Hehe. In Siracusa, we call this a 'Luci Spente,' and one sip means you're killing the guy next to you. Texas? She'll never tell you this, but she used to love this drink. Come, salute!

Is it so strange that I got you a gift? Do you not like it, or did you just not expect it…? I can tell by your face, you loved my gift, didn't you? What did Texas give you? Let me see! Whose do you like better?
Heh. Hi, Doctor.

Where's Texas? It's almost time for the countdown, shouldn't she be at Rhodes Island? Hah, to think I don't even get to see her on a day like this. Where are those precious friends of hers? I'm going to find Texas. Wanna come with, Doctor?
The more I get to know you, the better I understand Texas. I Love it.
Hm? Did I see a red shadow flash by?
Bravo! Now I want to crush them that much harder! Hahaha!
Not my best work. You can lay it on me for letting a few get away.
Hahaha, sliced 'em up like a millefoglie. How do you like it?
It's over? Ah, che noia!
You'll have to try harder than that!
Just try me!
Can you do it?
C'mon! C'eri quasi, tesoro!
Solid positioning.
Tell me, what's your plan?
Show me what you've got.
We're fighting you guys? Then please do your bestest job, or I'll be really bored.
Haha, you people... I don't think I'll even remember your faces after this one... Anyway, let's just get started.
Put Texas on my team!
Make Texas the leader!
Molto bene! That's more like it! Strength, unfettered and unchained! That's what I'm talking about!
Hahaha! Bene! I love how much you trust me. You can't say the same for Texas, right?
Don't you just love how I keep getting more and more powerful?
A great evil stands in the way of justice. My master, in the name of hatred and revenge, lead the weak onward!
Sleep tight... enjoy your sweet dreams while you still can.
You want to know what happened between me and Texas? Hehe, you don't have a single idea of what you are sticking your nose into. You'll find out the truth someday, but not from me.
That red one... oh... Doctor, keep her away from me! She'd definitely kill me in a fight. But I have this feeling... this feeling... ugh, why do I want to fight her so badly?
Texas? Ha, she's afraid of me, but I don't wanna do anything to her, except maybe try to bring back the old Texas. The one we got here's a cucciolo impaurito.
I love power, Doctor. And you offered me a job where I can use my power to my heart's content... Love it. Honestly, the only joy I get out of this insane world is using my power to conquer it.
You think I'm an assassin, huh? Yeah, alright. Call me whatever you want. I can be anyone, do anything, kill anyone anytime. Just so long as I want to!
It's been a while... I see that Texas made some friends. Hehehe... Affascinante! Can't wait to get to know them!
If someone's out for revenge on you, don't hesitate, just take them out. Once you decide to pick up a weapon, you don't need a reason to kill.
Somebody out to get you, huh? Then have a long, hard think about who you might've wronged in the past.
Ehi, Doctor. Hope you don't mind if I bring my weapons inside. I'll plop myself right over here.
I like how Rhodes Island does its anniversaries. Here's a couple wine truffles I just picked up, rum and bitter almond flavor. Tastes pretty good. Why don't you give them a try?
Here's a box of vinyls from the boss's collection. I got it from Lungmen. Take it, Doctor. No need to worry about my boss. Happy birthday.

Happy New Year. I was just about to give these to Exusiai. She said she'd be hosting a big party tonight, to celebrate her results not being rock bottom. The other girls? Croissant was hauling a huge batch of goods she got in earlier, so I figure she's got a stall laid out now. As for Sora... have you heard her new single, Doctor? I'm pretty into it.
What is it, Doctor?
Do you need any supplies? Just let me know.
I may have underestimated this operation.
A few of them passed through.
Whew... No problem.
Cut them to pieces!
You can't stop me.
Let's begin.
Draw swords!
Awaiting orders.
Exusiai, cover me.
Let's go.
I'm not good at barking orders.
What do you need?
Thanks for trusting me, Doctor.
This will work as payment.
Code name Texas. I'm responsible for driving, moving cargo, and keeping our people safe. Try to get the mission briefings as concise as possible, please.
Is it time for a break?
My independent lifestyle and rowdy friends have brought me a lot of trouble... but I kind of like it this way.
No matter how hard I run, my past will catch up to me one day.
Watch out for the Red Wolf. She's not evil, but... she's not like us.
How long have I worked for Penguin Logistics? When did I start...? I don't even know how long it's been.
Cigarette? Oh, no, this is chocolate. You've gotta replenish your energy regularly. Which reminds me... do you want some coffee?
I usually listen to Sora's songs when I'm driving.
Our job is to handle life and death.
I don't say much? That's because I'd rather avoid thinking about most things.
My next mission is to protect you, Doctor.

Sometimes I think to myself, what Rhodes Island is trying to do is really hard, but you're actually doing it. Me? I don't think about anything so complicated, but I'm more than glad to help out. All we're looking for is peace.

Happy birthday, Doctor. You're another year older, and you'll have another chance to grow. Since it's a special occasion, want me to call over the Penguin Logistics girls and throw a birthday party? Even I get in the mood for a little bit of fun and excitement with my friends. That's not the kind of 'excitement' you'll ever find in Siracusa.
Great, this place is the same as it ever was. Morning. Got any new plans?

It's a brand new year, so Happy New Year. Sora gave me a CD to listen to, and it's a totally different style. Very relaxing. Looks like her time in Siracusa expanded her horizons too. Want to give it a listen?
Doctor, where's the hair dryer? I'd like to dry my tail.
Hey. Stop it.
This place reminds me of Lungmen. It's quiet. Doesn't have the constant pitter patter of the rain.
I can take out a few more. You go ahead and retreat.
There's still more to clean. When's our next sweep?
A battle without an explosion or cheering makes me feel a little uneasy. Let's head back. A drink? Maybe next time.
The only way to solve a problem is to clear all the obstacles in the way, no matter what they might be and keep moving.
This will keep you quiet.
Pass on your last words? No.
You saw nothing.
Bad luck, you ran into me.
I see them. I'll be right back.
Got a problem that needs solving?
Need speed to succeed.
Moving to designated location.
Don't leave bloodstains. They're hard to clean.
No need to make a scene.
Alright. Try to keep up. Let me know if you can't.
Order confirmed, crystal clear.
I still have a lot to take care of before I can enjoy a peaceful life, and if the only way to shake the past is to smash it to pieces, then that's exactly what I'll do. Simple as that.
I'm not helping you for the money, Doctor. But still, go ahead and send my salary over to Penguin Logistics as usual. I'll pick it up from Emperor.
Thanks. Doesn't seem much different from your average delivery run in Lungmen.

We meet again, Doctor. The Siracusan rainy season always gets my tail wet, so I prefer the climate here. Don't worry, Exusiai and the girls will keep taking care of the deliveries, but I'll handle any jobs assigned to me personally.
It's quiet here. No hitmen haunting the shadows, no wolves waiting in the alleys.

In Siracusa, there were a whole lot of people trying to guess what I'd do. It wasn't that complicated. I was there to do what I had to do, and help those who deserved help. Doctor, all I ask is that we continue to get along just like we used to. This relationship, built on real trust, is hard to find there.

I was born in Columbia, but my grandfather wanted me to become a proper mafiosa and sent me to Siracusa to learn the trade. But to this day I don't understand why the people here like macaroni so much? I used to go to this little place for macaroni myself, but it closed down a long time ago. The owner died in a back alley.

I saw Lappland in Siracusa. Oh, you haven't seen her in a while? Not like she needs anyone worrying about her. If she's over me now, she'll find something else to cut. As for the score we haven't settled, I say it doesn't matter. We'll meet again soon enough.

I've got no interest in joining Greyhall. The dons sit in their chairs, acting all high and mighty, hiding their plans. I decided to confront Signora Sicilia because she thinks she can tame everyone, and that's one thing I can't stand.
Ever noticed how even the rain here stains the walls outside? Dirty rainwater can't wash anything clean. And that's Siracusa. Siracusans might be used to it, but I'm not.

Sometimes I hear Siracusans talking about the downfall of Famiglia Texas. No two versions of the story are the same. Most are pretty dull, and some make for interesting fairytales, but in the end, they're all pretty embellished. The real story is... I just got exhausted, and decided to leave.

I didn't want to get Penguin Logistics involved, but it was a relief to see them in Siracusa. My noisy friends, that life of freedom... Looking back now, staying with them in Lungmen was the best decision I ever made. Just, don't tell them I said that.

How does it feel to be back in Siracusa? Not great. It's for wise guys and famiglie, not me. I'm only staying long enough to cut ties with the past. After I'm done washing my hands of the whole business, I'm heading back to Lungmen to pick up the girls, and then going out for a nice drive.
I'm your bodyguard again, just like old times, Doctor. And it's not just a job, it's a reunion. That's something worth cherishing.

Doctor, Rhodes Island has a grand vision, but we have to think carefully. After all the slogans, ideals, and aspirations have been stripped away, whether we still have pure hearts, that is far more important than any false order.
Doctor, is today your birthday? I'll skip the serious business for now, so just enjoy this day to yourself. If you have nothing to do, I could tell you about some of Siracusa's osterie?

Doctor, I've categorized these documents according to their importance. Let me remind you that some of your operations land in a legal gray zone. I'm not opposed to them, but you need to think things through. I'll offer my advice as well.

Back in my homeland, even New Year's Day comes with no guarantee of peace. The conflicts of interest do not stop for a holiday. That's why I cherish my time here at Rhodes Island, spending it with all of you. Buon Anno, Doctor.
Are you here to discuss criminal procedure with me? No? Eccellente. I hope you never need my knowledge in that regard.
Please show proper respect.
This place is nothing like stagnant, old Siracusa. The breath of hope flows here.

Naturally, they and the darkness behind them will occasionally prevail... But mark my words, even the most frustrating rainy season will pass in time. Until then, all we can do is persevere, and keep trying.
Doctor, prepare a team to arrest the fugitives. There is no difference between a moment of mercy and a miscarriage of justice. They have not yet been read their verdict.
A trial in all its vaunted glory will not bring about any substantive change. It matters more what we do after the trial. Doctor, I've seen what you've done, and find it praiseworthy.
Even a crime-ridden swamp is not beyond salvation. Doctor, thank you for once again reminding me of this fact.
Your crimes are irrefutable.
Can crimes be punished through methods outside of the law?
There is no such thing as absolute justice, but I still invoke it!
The law is a means, not an end.
I am fighting for more than just the law. Also the justice and virtue that extend beyond it.
This gavel of justice is weighty. Spero che siate pronti.
What the law does not specify, I will reveal through practice.
No matter what I might encounter, I will not back down.
This time, I will hand down a fair verdict.
Contempt for the law is a crime. The words of my codex will prove their own worth.
Whether or not you are burdened by a criminal record is unimportant to me. All I ask is that in this coming battle, our goals might be aligned.
Sitting around in an office won't bring about justice. That's one thing I know for a fact.

Be it a famiglia, a society, or a country, people are often bound by mutual interest... I used to assume this was the way of the world, but Doctor, you showed me a different path. I hope we can share this mutual trust long into the future.

I am honored to earn your support. We can certainly work together and offer mutual assistance, but let me be frank – that doesn't mean you can influence my decisions. Sorry, no offense intended, but that's a lesson I learned the hard way.
So much violence in the name of order... Doctor, I can only pray that your efforts are more than futile.
I am Lavinia Falcone, formerly a judge of Siracusa. Today, I report to you as Operator Penance. I hope that in working for Rhodes Island, I can absolve myself of my past mistakes.
You're sleeping? There's nothing more valuable than these rare moments of peace. Conserviamo questi momenti.

In my many years as a judge, I've only handed down a few verdicts I could feel good about. I still remember the look on those two kids' faces when I broke up their little scuffle and told the aggressor to apologize. What, why are you laughing? Even the greatest justice must start from somewhere small.

If you ever get a chance to visit Siracusa, please avoid the rainy season. However, if you really are that unfortunate... best thing you can do is find a little shop on the street and sit for a while. Maybe only after the rain can one enjoy the momentary illusion that the city is clean.

Oh, mi dispiace, I didn't see you there. If you're all done with work, how about joining me for a drink?… Why that look in your eyes? I'm not an alcoholic. But everyone needs some liquid assistance every now and then, whether for fatigue or for suffering. Ecco. It's on the strong side, so sip slowly.

Maybe Siracusa really is that hard to change. The gangs, the famiglie... They shared a womb with Siracusa and shaped it into the country it is today. But we can't take them for granted. We must believe that a different path exists.

In Siracusa, being a city court judge is a dangerous job. Either you join 'them,' or... you disappear. I thought I could strike a balance between the two, but there's no way to stay clean when you're surrounded by mud. In the end, I was just another accomplice.

They say 'the law is the basis of morality,' but that's not a natural truth. It emerges from a consensus of the people. When the people come to see violence as order, the law is nothing but a fantasy to dream of. And I, as the keeper of that fantasy, am the most ridiculous of all.

The thorns on this codex? Yes, of course the spikes hurt, but I wish for the pain to remind me: No matter how weak the statutes in Siracusa, no matter how highly I think of my calling, perversion of justice and blasphemy against the law are crimes.

You don't have to tiptoe around me. I don't judge good or evil on any ironclad law. And with all the crimes staged in the name of order… Ah, pay no mind to this judge's grumble, a powerless judge waiting to be indicted for misconduct in office.

It's been a long time since I've felt like there was any conviction or meaning in my work. Rather than sit through show trial after show trial, I prefer to wade through these thorny, complicated files.

Doctor, the two of us are actually pretty similar. I believe that even a swamp like Siracusa can change. And your ambitions, hah, they are even bigger than mine. We both have what it takes to make this happen. I'll keep working on myself. I hope you'll do the same.

Your birthday? Doctor, do you seriously celebrate things like that at your age? Alright then. We're partners, so I have to go along with this. Happy birthday. You want me to sing it? Don't push your luck.
None of these documents matter at all, Doctor. The only thing that matters is how you act.

It's a brand new year. A toast to our goals, alla nostra salute. Oh, don't worry, this is just apple juice. I can't handle wine that's too strong. Why are you laughing? Whoever said that mafiosi have to drink?
Ah... Mi mancano le osterie di Siracusa. Doctor, is the kitchen available right now? I can make something myself.
Are you having fun? Because I'm not.
Careful with the moisture-proofing. I hate the smell of rotting wood.
I'll take care of the evacuation. You get moving, fast. I hope this won't happen again, Doctor.
They're getting away. Do you need me to walk you through this? Ma dai! Whack them already.
Are we done yet? What are you looking all smug for? These stronzi have already wasted too much of our time.
They have no idea who they're messing with. Bravo, Doctor. I was right to partner with you. I hope you'll find even more challenges for me in the next battle.
A valiant struggle, but you won't get away.
This hunt has dragged on for too long.
And what purpose do you think your sacrifice will serve?
Let's put an end to this show, pronto.
Anything outside the plan, I'll judge for myself.
Don't make this harder than it needs to be.
They'll be sleeping with the fins in no time.
Ready to move.
Chi morirà qui oggi?
Remember, our purpose is not violence itself, but rather the victory it brings.
The process is just as important as the end result. Don't go dying on me, ragazzi.
Va bene. Let's see if your plan is worthy of my work.
Our partnership has been productive, Doctor. A made man would sell out anybody for his ambitions, but I can promise you one thing: you've bought my loyalty with yours.
A promotion? There's no need to test me like that, Doctor. I've played this game too... winning people over with small rewards. But if you're just trying to show your faith in me... Va bene, grazie.
I am no stranger to violence. As long as I'm on the scene, things should be a little more efficient.

Buongiorno, Doctor. I am Famiglia Bellone's... Lasci perdere. My famiglia doesn't exist anymore, but that was the price we paid to buy change in Siracusa. As for what comes next... Operator Vigil is at your service, Doctor. I hope our partnership will be productive.
Hey. Is our 'cooperation' just me watching you sleep?

Zaaro, il Signore dei Lupi... the shadow lurking behind me and my father. Don't be fooled by his pretentious words. A wild beast's hunt won't slow the progress of humanity. If he appears before you one day, I will drive him away.

Something on your mind? If it calls for blackmail, bribery, or something worse... none of that would be much trouble for me. Underhanded business is pretty much all I inherited from my famiglia. As for how to use my knowledge, that's your call.

If you want to show respect to the Siracusans, then hire a proper Siracusan chef. The next time I see any 'innovative Siracusan cuisine' out of your minions... Beh, let's just say somebody knows about your little office naps, and it'd be a shame if the beans got spilled on your beauty sleep.

The disputes among the famiglie were petty and stupid. The dons clung on to whatever authority they had, thinking they were the masters of Siracusa. But I invite you, Doctor, to join me in shaping a new era.

The old ways make it impossible to find a new path. If the new Siracusa is built on violence, it will fall back into the same well. The destruction of a few individual famiglie is far, far from enough. We must kick the entire 'habit.'

Judge Lavinia never realized what she was getting herself into. The game with Signora Sicilia won't be won through courage or resourcefulness alone... She's looking for me? To discuss my unbalanced diet…? Tell her I'm not here.

For many years, I couldn't really understand my father. He paid the ultimate price, only to betray almost everything in the end... But I still remember the question my father posed to me many years ago, when we were sitting together in a park: 'Siracusa, sara un posto migliore senza le famiglie?'

What do you want to know? Secrets of the Siracusan famiglie? There's hardly anything worth mentioning there. The things we do are no different from the wolves fighting in the wilderness thousands of years ago. Only, time has taught us some new tricks. Heh, you see 'order' could be the official name for 'tearing your prey to pieces.'

Organizing documents? Doctor, we have much more important things to do. Bene, I'll give you a hand, if you insist. But do remember, I expect you to come up with a plan that's worth my while. Do not disappoint me.

I remember the first time I collaborated with Rhodes Island. A difficult fight, but a single Black Snake is nothing to worry about. What's scary is the countless villains out there who use despair to force people into doing their bidding. There's no winning our fights with brute force alone, so we have to keep improving ourselves.

Perfect timing, Doctor. Here's a Bolívarian wood carving, a Victorian tea set, and an Ursine... I'm not asking you to choose, they're all for you. It's been a few years since we've seen each other, so I owe you a few birthday presents. Don't be shy. Happy birthday, Doctor.
Doctor, you haven't changed one bit.

I've seen many different kinds of new years. Once, I watched a group take shelter under huge Originium clusters, promising each other everything would get better while they clinked muddy cups of water together, silently waiting for the sunrise… it's nothing, Doctor. This day only comes once a year, so let's go celebrate with the others.
You don't have to ask—I'm the same old Ch'en, haven't changed one bit.
Doctor, careful you don't poke yourself with the end of my blade.
Furnishings haven't changed. Nice.
Come on, don't lose heart over one setback.
They'd best take this chance to repent.
One day, we won't have to make right with might.
Nicely done, Doctor… you're mistaken. That light in the sky wasn't from my swordplay.
As sword of heaven's plaint, bid dawn as cast.
As sword of stratus rent, once stood stand fast!
As move at teardrop's point, once known be deft.
As move unsheathing blade, cleave now as cleft.
Chi Xiao, unsheath—
I'll stop all evil in its tracks.
I know very well why I draw this sword.
Fear not the power of this blade.
Suppression by force isn't an option on this field.
Move out. I'll make sure no one gets left behind.
Don't worry, I wasn't always on my own these past few years.
Doesn't feel too unfamiliar yet.
I spent a long time mastering Chi Xiao's techniques, but the answer I got was different from the lessons I was taught. Chi Xiao has seen my determination, and when you need it, it will never waver.
You have a lot of people who trust in your command, and depend on you to direct them… that's important to keep in mind.
This battle… Rhodes Island was there too?
Long time no see, Doctor. I know things have gotten pretty serious, so I'm back to lend a hand. In case you need a reminder, I'm still with Rhodes Island.
Need a break, but can't sleep? Yeah, you have a lot of pressure on your shoulders. Sit up straight. I'll teach you some Yanese breathing exercises.

When things calm down, it would be nice to take you around Yan. Not just Lungmen, and not for any investigations either. Just a trip to watch the people make something from nothing in that beautiful land. There's nowhere else like it. You won't have to pack anything either. A sword and a boat. That's all we'll need.

I asked that man why my mother and sister had to suffer, and unsurprisingly, I didn't get the answer I was looking for. It's too bad Chi Xiao can't sever blood ties, and this writing knife can't scrape away recorded history either. There's no granting any forgiveness in their stead, no one is worth sacrificing for any 'greater good', ever.

I've been back to Lungmen a few times. Other than the loss of my favorite cheongfun shop, the changes are nice to see. There are fewer L.G.D. patrols on the streets, and you hear less talk of the slums… There's no lying to myself and pretending I don't care for the city.

We're a long way from a place where everyone is treated equally, and I have no clue if I'm any nearer to this goal. But I've never doubted the equality I envision is real, for when we step up to rage against the injustice we see, we prove it exists.

I followed her and Reunion to many places, and saw many sacrifices made. The people went from being lost and fragmented to becoming united and awakened—on that long and winding road. Many of them were left behind in the huge blaze in Deity Grypherburg, yet it was this very fire that ignited their hope.

Oh, you've noticed my blade? I was told it can erase history's mistakes, but that's practically half of whatever's been archived in the last thousand years, and there's no way a single blade could clean that all up. Let's look to the future instead—the ideals we seek still lie ahead.

Worried about my health? Guess we ought to be checking up on each other, Doctor. I've been through a lot these past few years, time sure does fly. The more you experience, the easier it is to fall into confusion and helplessness. Sometimes I do need a reminder… my time is not infinite.

It's Rhodes Island's visitor logs? Swire, Hoshiguma, and Lin too… Right, assuming they're always asking about me, but there's no way they're coming this much for—Hm. I know a lot of people are waiting for me. It's not too bad, being on someone's mind.
So, do you want a bodyguard, or a cop to watch you work 24/7? Just joking. I haven't forgotten how you do things here.

You have chosen the most difficult game in this realm to play, but if this is enough to make you consider a retreat, then you have surrendered all chance of victory… Merely a warning from someone who once walked the tightrope and lost it all, whatever that may be worth. Do not fret. By my reckoning, this game is still far from over, and there are still many variables at play.

I have not prepared any curios to offer you upon your birthday. Some seek out pearl shells from the southern depths to make stones and fragrant nutmeg-yew wood from the northern ridges to make boards, but such luxuries will not help them play any better… I grant you this ancient record of a game. Since you now understand the Dao of weiqi, you shall be able to discern the thoughts present on the board. The player? Nothing more than an obsessive like yourself.
Doctor. I have heard from others that you are not accustomed to rising early.

Its name is Sui, or 'age'. It seems the people of antiquity knew that time is a terrifying, evil beast. All things are worn away by its passage. I too do not know how much longer I will remember her. Before my memory leaves me… Yes, no need for further urging. I shall come and eat now.
I have some spare time today, so I do not mind a game.
…Remain silent while you spectate.
…This is much more spacious than my last dwelling.
Guileful moves indeed… Another game, what say you?!
Such blunderous command.
Take it away. I have no need for battle reports.
…I am content.
…Why must you insist on struggling?!
Admit defeat now, and spare yourself the embarrassment.
You will not escape this jie so easily.
Warmongering as ever. Even now, you have learned nothing.
You have been drawn into my plans.
Observe the entirety of the board. There is no one point that decides victory.
Simply place your stone. Why ask me?
Spare them or slay them. The choice is yours.
Come, take your seats.
Three Armies, heed these orders: we march.
You truly wish to entrust this authority to me…?
Have your strategies plotted beforehand. You should know how the battle will end before it begins.
There has only ever been 'me'.

The weiqi players of Yan are divided into nine ranks, from the Ninth Clumsy Defender Rank to the First Nearly Divine Rank. As you are now, your prowess should grant you the rank of… This is meant to denote my rank? Preposterous…
Do you truly wish for me to point out all the flaws I see here?

You are Dr. {@nickname}? I am honored to finally meet you. As you've already met many of my siblings, I shall not belabor my introduction. I am Wang, a former strategist. As for our earlier encounters… Let us consider them not worth mentioning.
…After our parting, the blizzard-lashed night outside my window…

I have calculated every possible outcome, yet I cannot see a conclusion where these muddy waters run clear once more. But I know she is still there. A move in a weiqi record, a page in a history book. This simple faith shall suffice… You do not need to question my determination. Surely you too have people you care for.

Quibbling over seniority is inherently ridiculous for us. Not even in ordinary families would you see an elder brother make every single decision for his younger siblings. You do not need to act as my elder brother's messenger. Once this game is over, I shall go to dinner. I am aware Yu is manning the kitchen today.

We no longer obsess over leaving something behind. The exception is our masteries, which each of us has spent more than a thousand years honing. They are worthy footnotes in the fickle realm of humanity, and it would be a pity to lose them to oblivion... The fact that they may leave things behind is, for most parts, a treasure, though far be it from me to pass down knowledge.

That game with It has come to a close, all resentment, gains, and losses stricken from the ledger. Can it be considered victory? We have paid a bitter enough price simply to find our place upon this earth. Surely you too understand the weight of the word 'decision'… One must have no regrets after placing a stone, but can one truly be free of regret?

Through a thirst for victory, seek peace. In this point, and this point only, can it be said warfare is connected to weiqi. People seek egress from all sorts of unbearable struggles, yet it is thus that they can speak of their future. I cannot read your future, but I believe the choices you make are in accordance with the proper moves on the board.

I have never seen my younger brothers and sisters act in so ridiculous a fashion before. It seems they have plenty of time to waste now that this affair is over. No need to inform them I am here. So long as they can live together happily like this… You have already informed them?

The Dao of weiqi is abstruse, but in the end, it is merely a game. You will not learn of military tactics or political maneuvers upon the gridded board. I have seen no small number of people who enjoy making such fantastical claims. As for the story of the general sitting in his camp, breaking his enemy with ease during a game of hand-talk… According to the Laws of Yan, a general making such merry during wartime is to be beheaded.

If you require someone to share your burden during my time on Rhodes Island, I shall do my utmost. Though there is no need to ask me for advice on medical company work... You wish for a round of hand-talk? There is no need to rush, until the day you take your first step on the Dao of weiqi.

It has been centuries since the post of Great Yan's Weiqi Attendant was discontinued, and yet you… You simply wished for me to help you in managing these documents? No, I do not understand what you mean by 'can't be in two places at once'.

I hate how time has taken people away from me, but on the other hand, everyone still with me is precious, and that includes you... so before time washes everything away, why not chill with me here for a bit, Doctor?
Only for your birthday, Doctor, will I follow you anywhere, no matter how dangerous or silly it gets, even if you take full responsibility for the risks. So, figured out where you wanna go yet?
Want a glass? It's just mint tea. C'mon, you think I'm the type to grab a drink at this hour?

Doctor, here's a bike I got for you. Give it a spin. Why did I get it? Uh, the ad was really cool, and they told me they had a New Year sale too... right, so you accelerate here, and this one... wait—Doctor?! Slow down! The bike's out of control!
Careful, my horn's pretty sharp too.
What was that?
Here I am, Doctor. Huh? Oh, I've spent so much time here, it's muscle memory for me to duck my head.
Don't worry, they'll stay clear of you as long as I'm around. See you in a bit, once I'm done with them.
Call it a day here? Hold on, I haven't had my fun yet, so I need to blow off some steam—Phew... So? I seem less scary now, right?
Don't bother checking the battlefield again. I saw every enemy off myself.
...Just like all those years ago? No, I'm following your orders this time, so no regrets on my end.
…What a pity.
You're not the one I'm looking for. Move.
Not scared? You've got guts, but that might be all you've got.
Decided what to carve on your graves yet?
Where's the most dangerous spot? Send me there.
Where's their most annoying guy? I'll take him down.
Don't panic, I am here.
Time for me to get serious?
Prepare yourselves. The battlefield might get a little crazy once I make my move.
If you're stumped, just leave the hardest task to me.
Just focus on offense, no matter how the fight might go. Yup, go wild. I'll keep you all safe.
Mission time? Perfect, I get to stretch my legs far, far away from paperwork.

Another medal? Enough of these stuffy things. If you really want to thank me, why not write something on Hannya's underside? I vow to you, as long as I hold the shield, your inscription will be there forever.
I'll still protect you even without this medal... That said, it's an honor getting a commendation from you. Thank you very much.
Best I learn from you how to command others.
Defender Operator Hoshiguma, reporting in once again—Special Inspection Unit Chief? Yup, that'll be my job title soon. Though on Rhodes I'm just Operator Hoshiguma, it's more chill for me that way.
Here, the coffee machine. I kept watching you run over to it, so I just made it easier for you. It's light enough.

I don't take vows lightly. Moral values are inherently messy, and bending over backwards to do stuff for other people only adds to the horrible hotpot. But you—I trust you. I know you can tell right from wrong. I've said before I'll heed your orders, and that will always be true. You heard me, a promise is a promise.

In his final moments, Ah Faat asked Old Ch'en to take care of me, but she's actually the one who can't keep out of trouble. Today, I have the entire L.G.D. behind me, but her? Ugh... Promise me, Doctor, if she ever asks Rhodes Island for help, don't make a fool of her.

I took Missy to dinner after she got back from Siesta. It was before she got sworn in, so imagine how red her face was when I let a 'Commissioner' slip out—Oh, Commissioner Swire! What an honor to have you grace Rhodes Island!—Ow! Milady—I mean, Missy, please, have mercy!

Yeah, I chose Lungmen in the end. After so many years, I'd long stopped expecting Mitsukue sake to take like it used to. But I never imagined it'd distill itself into tastelessness. All we got left is straight paint thinner. Booze like that, I don't drink.

Kyoukaku? Xiá? Sure, your gallant swordsmen dedicated to lofty moral codes, you hear about them in Higashi's Chuushingura and Yan's wuxia tales, but I'm not the type at all. Those are vigilantes, going against the law with violence; and once you have law enforcement turning into vigilantes, or a vigilante with no choice but to join hands with the police, then everything will—Yeah, stuff's been messed up for a long, long time.

Monks talk of 'Prajna' as a transcendent wisdom beyond mortal comprehension, but the Higashinese are more familiar with 'Hannya', the angry face on this shield. Being born in Higashi as an Oni is already lucky enough for a Sarkaz, but who can say how many of us seek liberation, or die in battle?

One time I showed up to work with this outfit on, and Lungmen's triads were especially well-behaved that day. Too bad Missy ordered me to switch back after the L.G.D. hotline got flooded with residents asking us to handle an 'Unidentified Dangerous Individual'... what a shame.

New weapons? Nope, Hannya just got reforged, and I shared a connection with this blade from early on. I prefer old-school stuff for everything, except my bike—though I do keep my retired rides all nice and clean in the garage.
Just like old times, Doctor. You're safe with me around.

I never knew Rhodes Island could be so bustling during festivals. I have literally been cooking on all burners today. But, well, it's all worth it. Just look at all these young sprouts, so full of promise... Ah! What are you doing? Open your ears, and don't measure me! I-I didn't grow any taller...

Doctor, happy Birthday! This is a present I've treasured for years...my private cookbook. If you follow the instructions step-by-step, you too can become a master chef. If Yu can cook, so can you. What? Still want me to cook for you? Hehe, OK, OK. I'll make an exception today.
Come, have a seat. Make yourself at home. You can order anything on the menu.

Nian, quit sneaking bites and go call Dusk out. Ling, could you lend a hand? Shu and I are swamped in kitchen. Where did Dage wander off to now...? Ah! Doctor! what took you so long? Come, have a seat and join us! Happy New Year!
Are you hungry? Give me a moment.
Haha, stop tickling me!
No open flames? Hmm…
Messed up the dish? Sometimes getting messy is the spice of cooking, and life. Wash it out, and the wok will be good as new.
The taste's passable, but the appearance falls short. Customers won't be as accommodating as me.
Daring to add ingredients like that? You've definitely got the potential to be a top chef.
Not bad. This recipe will stand the test of time.
Still misbehaving? Then let's kick it up a notch!
Tough to swallow, huh? Try to behave yourself next time.
Slow-simmer on low heat. Patience is not optional.
Cold oil into a hot wok. The heat is just perfect.
You will get what you deserve. I mean, what you ordered.
So long as you're here, have some hot soup before you go.
Quickly! The spare ribs have been stewing for so long, they're falling apart!
Patience, friend. Heat control is everything here.
Line up, line up. We have plenty of good eats for everyone.
The mung bean soup is already simmering. Whether you want your beans intact or fully dissolved depends on how quickly you return.
A-hem! The chef has the final word here.
I won't fight for nothing. But for the right price, hehe, I'm in.
Oh? Trying to keep me here? Haha. There's nothing to be ashamed of. You've had a taste of my cooking. If you could forget that flavor, wouldn't all my years of culinary practice have been in vain?

Bitter gourd is in season now. Deseeding, blanching, and adding it to the soup brings out the most flavor. Some find it too bitter, while others are absolutely in love with it. Palates differ, and sweetness or bitterness are unique to each individual.
Maybe we should watch something else while we're eating?
Hello, you must be the Doctor. I'm here to visit my brother and sisters. Do I sign the visitor's log here? Alright. Hmm...? Logistics Operator Employment contract? Nian! You tricked me again!
I'm still not used to the quiet without a kitchen fire burning nearby… It makes me so sleepy…

Here we come to this moment again... You are just like that brother of mine. Once you've got your mind set on something, nothing else matters, and there's no going back. Hey-ya... You see, Doctor. Soup needs to be simmered slowly to develop its flavors, but it can be so mentally exhausting. That's why... one must always take care to eat well.

'Who am I?' My siblings have all thought things through. Me? I'm not ready yet. There are still many dishes I haven't tasted, and too many TV dramas I have to finish... Hey, wait a second. Doctor, just play your tile already. Bringing up philosophical questions right when I'm about to win? That's cheating, and it's way too obvious, you know!

Blaze went home, and brought Miss Ning along? Ah... Good for them... Shh... nope, I didn't fan the flame or anything. Oftentimes, what matters is who sits around the table, rather than what's upon it. All I want is for my patrons to enjoy their meals. The land is home to many flavors, but nothing compares to the taste of family reunion.

I love the mortal realm. I mean, who would want to go back to that primordial chaos after tasting all these different flavors? Sour, salty, bitter, spicy... miss any one of them, you'll never master cookery. Likewise, joy, sorrow, separation, reunion... if you don't understand all of them, you'll never learn how to truly be a person. Yeah... Now, I've come to understand all the tastes.

'A nobleman stays clear of the kitchen.'... Hmph, I wonder which bitter scholar dreamed up such nonsense. Just because you ignore something, it ceases to exist? People eat five grains, and then they have six desires and seven emotions. Nothing could be more natural. The work of this kitchen is, if you ask me, the most significant thing in this land.

I'm laying low on Rhodes Island to dodge my debts? Who said that? I owe Ji a little rent, but he's had plenty of my cooking! My siblings only ever think of me when they're hungry. Doctor, now you know who's the dependable one in the family!

I'm fairly confident in my culinary arts, but just as there are those who indulge in exotic delicacies, there are those who prefer bland flavors. You can't satisfy everyone, and it's also a matter of whether fate allows for a chef and a diner to cross paths. So, do you find this dish to your liking? If you want any special treatment in the future, you'd better nod right now.

Doctor, I don't know what Nian told you, but I must emphasize this: I. Don't. Cook. Without good reason. A chef must be particular in his prepara... Wai-wai-wai-wait, That bag of snacks is your lunch? Tch, aiya... stop eating that, I'll whip something up for you.
Ah, I see this is a fine location. Alright, then… 'Daily desserts, fresh out of the oven, in limited quantities.' Heehee, there we go! Oh, Doctor? Nothing special here. Don't let me keep you.

Hehe, what a crowd! It calls to mind some sights in Dahuang. I would take you to enjoy the local opera, if we get the chance. In the old days, its people numbered no more than a hundred, but today it truly is a city. I see you've gained a good number of new faces too. For tens, hundreds, and thousands of years, the ancestors led our way, and newcomers joined our path. And you see, we are never alone.

Happy birthday, Doctor. You want me to tell your fortune for the year? Hmm, I see a prosperous one in store for you. Your effort will surely bring you gain, and all your wishes will come true. Truths or lies? Like I've told you before, the answer's in your hands.
Doctor, come over here for a bit. Let's see... Hmm, the crops cultivated in Jiangqi this year are indeed taller than a man.

'The third nine days after Winter Solstice, all lakes and rivers frozen to ice. The fourth nine days, we can still walk on them.' Soon those ice surfaces will be thick enough to carry us, and the coldest time of year will arrive. Did Nian's hotpot warm you up? If not, you could ask Ling for some of her drink. Come on, let's go out and see if it's snowing. An auspicious snowfall tells of a bountiful year, and perhaps the new year will bring us a good harvest.
Hm? You want to come fincatching with me?
You want me to plant you in the soil too, Doctor?
Now let's see... where's a good spot for my fincatching tools?
Fortune and misfortune are two sides of the same coin. What you have sown is not necessarily wicked, so why lose heart?
Perfection is a tall order, just as our crops may suffer from inclement weather, Catastrophe, and pestilence. These problems may not be solved in ten thousand years. You tried your best, Doctor.
Good, good. I had no idea you were so clever and learned. I was going to ask you help me make maiyatang, but with such a good head on your shoulders, I'm feeling a little bad now.
Seeds are now in the field—another season full of hope.
I'll plant you into the soil to grow anew.
Branch and bone bear weeds; mounds and ruins bloom fields.
Sow the mountains when summer leaves a white dew. Seed the plains when equinox paints russet hue.
Clear skies for Qingming, rain clouds for Guyu.
'War'... A word I've not heard in a long, long time.
Spring breeze, timely rain; now we sow the grain.
If you're really incapable of settling this, then let me handle it.
I wasn't supposed to act, but…
When were the seeds of this tragedy planted?
Reap not what's sown by malice.
Just don't get yourselves hurt.
A day of fine sun and gentle breeze. I hope everyone makes it home safe.
The fertile fields stretch to the horizon, the fragrance of rice spreads from the golden ocean... Day after day, year after year, with constant work, it finally draws near.

The people of Dahuang pray for a year of peace and harvest with this jade cong. The ceremonial artifact also serves as the source of the one I hold in my hand. Summon wind and rain? Hehe, of course I can. Want me to demonstrate?
Sow no reason for retaliation—point your blades at one another, and strife will never end.

Nian should have already told you my name—'Shu'. With my eldest brother, eldest sister, and my two younger sisters here, I feel as if I've returned home… Intriguing. Has that boy from the Sui Regulator not caused you any trouble yet?
In east sun lifts; in west moons fall. Spring cold foretells rain; summer chill, clear skies.

Our lives vary in their spans, and in their spans only. Just as how this landship holds so many people on its decks, a fallen leaf floating in that puddle is a sufficient vessel to sustain an ant for its entire life. Our burdens only grow as we gather more, yet you and I are naught but a single millet grain in our respective realms.

Doctor, there's a pond up ahead—Nian! I see you adding chili oil to Dusk's cup. The villagers tell of a huge fin—Dusk! Pouring ink into Nian's bowl is going too far. Oh, Doctor, would you like to go fincatch—Are you two still fighting?! ...Get over here, both of you.

Grain Buds is teaching some children how to make string figures? Yes, it's a Yanese children's hobby. A millennium ago, my younger brother had just arrived in Dahuang, where he invented this pastime to entertain the lonely children. A string in his hands could turn into countless hours of fun... Ah... it's been a thousand years.

A pity? How so? Petals fall to the ground, so the soil may be nourished, allowing new flowers to bloom the following year. Rivers flow into the sea, but the water will condense into clouds, raining the drops back onto the mountains and streams. Even if this great land is to meet a snow-white end, the cycle continues. When spring comes, there will always be buds sprouting anew.

Doctor, give me your hand. I'll read your palm. Hmm... Your heaven, earth, and human lines are really impressive. Your past is dim and vague. Your journey is fraught with peril. Your future is criss-crossed with conflict... I see, Doctor. You are an 'ordinary one' who 'stirs up a storm fighting for a good end.'

My eldest brother Shuo guards the border all year round, while my eldest sister Ling sleeps her days away clutching a pot of wine. Without me worrying over the rest of us, we would've ceased to be 'siblings' long ago. Hmm? Of course it's my duty to look after them—I'm the sixth out of us twelve, making me a big sister to five.

I am no fin, and yet I can reason what one is thinking. You may say I've spent the whole day idling. But you are not me, so how can you tell I've not been swimming freely with the fins in the ever-flowing streams? Yes, I know you think this water jug is too small for fincatching, but who's to say I can't drop a line in?

Who am 'I'? The answer lies only in all that I've seen. The same way seeds are inanimate, and yet they germinate after you put them in the ground. I too lodged myself in a seed once, to feel the growth of life. You wonder what it's like? Hehe, take a deep breath and you've more or less felt it.
Doctor, all life requires both sunlight and water to grow. While this potted plant seems to have its needs met, I don't think you've had your ten cups of water yet today.

Londinium, Gran Faro, Trimounts... Rhodes Island has played a role in many crises. The Sui Regulator knows that you are not a simple pharmaceutical company, of course, but you have been doing everything in your power to prevent invisible disasters. And so you may stand shoulder-to-shoulder with us.

I was a fairly mischievous boy. I once leapt into a sand wheel in Yumen, nearly costing me my life. It was my birthday, so my father had me wear this mask for the entire day. Happy birthday, Doctor. Rhodes Island won't be stopping, but would you like to hop off for a look? Don't worry, I'll fly you back.
Good timing. You must have something to discuss with me... Yes and no?

The northern mandarins are busy, just as farmers have little time for leisure... My duties have me traveling all across Yan. The Yanese are always busy, but this time of year, they come together to eat, to beat the drums, and to enjoy their reunions... The shadows have yet to fade, but likewise, the fireworks will never cease.
Doctor, how about a game of weiqi? Or perhaps a capture-the-flag rematch?
You must have urgent need of assistance?
I've lived in tents, and I've slept in fields. I'm not particularly demanding.
The Sui Regulator has contingencies for all possible outcomes, of course. Leave the cleanup to me. I have good qinggong. I'll catch up.
Man strives for perfection, yet flaws remain in every plan. Doctor, the deed is done. Let's not dwell on it further.
A unit never takes the same formation, as water never takes the same shape. Such extraordinary planning and execution... Doctor, I cannot fathom your past.
Seeking total victory in peril. You are truly of extraordinary talent and courage.
Even the shortest candle may exorcise the longest dark of night!
Let there be order in Yan, and may Heaven safeguard our hunt.
How dare you?!
Go no further, this road is closed.
Not even the slightest stirring of grass will go overlooked.
When chaos abounds, the most minute adjustment can change everything.
The more complicated the situation, the simpler it is for me to act.
From here on, your wish is my command.
The thrust of a blade takes no shape, take no comfort that it lies stowed.
The arrow has been nocked, why hesitate?
To choose the right man for the job is a virtue, to choose a talent is more virtuous still. I, Zuo Le, shall do my very best.
I hope my meager assistance will prove fruitful.

Each megastructure coursing through Catastrophes has a meaning unique to itself. Shangshu transferred its mountains and waterscapes to its nomadic cities, while Yumen fends off sandstorms with its Wind Aegis. And so, what of Rhodes Island? On what convictions do you sail?

My sincerest apologies, in my capacity as the mandarin Zuo Le, I'm afraid I cannot accept any form of 'promotion...' Ahem, what I mean is... we will forgo the titles, but I can accept the other benefits.
To think that a pharmaceutical company has made such a competent analysis of battle records.

Doctor, I am Zuo Le. The number of proxies aboard Rhodes Island has almost exceeded that of those in Yan. The Sui Regulator should have sent someone here long ago. In fact, it has been some time since we sent you an official notice, but it would seem your company may have forgotten to reply?
The beast walks with the generous earth, as the Candleholder walks into the long night...

This is a handbook that all Candleholders keep on their person. Yes, I recorded some observations about you... I'm very sorry, Doctor, but for what it's worth, I am now sure of one thing: You are the guiding post of this ship, and you are indeed ordinary. I will shred those pages, and I will ensure your safety.

On-deck capture the flag is a challenge of mobility. Even though I was the first to climb onto the bridge, the Vulpo lady rode her staff and breezed past me to snatch the flag... Doctor, that is blatant cheating. How could you accuse me of being too competitive and unsportsmanlike?

I'll keep an eye on the siblings, but I can't simply stand by and watch when Nian plays mahjong. You've seen those exaggerated casts that Nian conjures up, and you think she's... only a little obnoxious? You're not playing dumb. That's the trickiest part.

My father sent me to Dahuang in hopes that I would improve myself. But decades ago, he and the Grandmaster worked all night forging a blade at the Sword Forge, making them late for work the following morning. Of course, one should avoid deviating from the proper path, but I think my father wanted me to hold on to that spirit.

That woman just now... was that Lord Wei's niece? No, I don't know her, but when I was little, my father told me to learn from her example. We later discovered that Miss Ch'en resigned her position. Father did not say anything to me that day. Thinking back, I indeed find her admirable.

Yes, I do know Lin Qingyan. We held different titles, serving the Sui Regulator and the Central Judicial Office respectively. I've had some doubts about Rhodes Island both before and after I arrived here. That being said, I shan't pry into the matters that 'Operator Leizi' is investigating.

My father forged these blades for me in Yumen himself. 'Exorcise the shadows of the Feranmuts, and ameliorate the plague on our land.' A Candleholder's work is not so simple that we can manage it with force alone... Um, of course, I've also been training as diligently as ever.

Doctor? Let me join you... Oh, Kroos and Mr. Nothing said you'd take me around for a 'bai shan men' today to meet all the operators on the landship. They've been very warm, much more so than when we first met... Hold on, are you going to tour the entire ship?
