When I first became a Candleholder, it took me three whole months to finish reading all the literature in the Sui Regulator's library. The paperwork you have piled up here... is no less impressive in size. I will have time to familiarize myself with my duties, right?

The relationships you build on the battlefield are not something you can fake. Hoshiguma seems pretty concerned about your relationship with the L.G.D., but I know why she's beating around the bush. Hehe, next time, I'll drag her to Rhodes Island to join the parties.

Happy birthday, Doctor! Over the last two years, I've come to realize more and more that only shallow friendships need all that shallow pretense to maintain, so I didn't get you anything this year. Doctor, take the day off. If there's anything you want or anywhere you want to go, I'll keep you company.
Good morning... Hm? Just saying hello. What were you expecting? Rawr?
Happy New Year! Perfect timing. Come carry these things for me. I've got gifts for all my friends here in Rhodes Island—Oh! Be careful with that! Pure gold's very heavy!
Oh, you like this fashion brand? I can pick out an outfit for you.
Doctor, do you know the consequences for attacking a cop in Lungmen? Don't worry. I'm just teaching you about the laws there.
This place hasn't been redecorated even once this whole time? You serious?
Let's wrap it up here. I'll take care of the mission report.
If you can take care of something in one go, it's best not to do it twice. Keep your costs under control.
Don't get cocky. This is barely a pass mark by L.G.D. standards, but if you manage to keep this up, I guess I could still commend you.
That's all the men and wares accounted for. Let's call it a day here.
Freeze! Hands in the air!
Be good, be cuffed, I'll hear your motive after taking you in.
Where are you trying to run?
The moment you break the law, your back's against the wall.
Start the operation.
Wait for my orders.
Follow your orders…? Fine.
I haven't taken orders in a long time… feels kinda weird.
I don't really want my holiday mood ruined, so hurry up and stop resisting arrest.
Let's try to take up as little of our holiday time as possible.
Just follow my command and it'll all be fine.
Really? Not making me captain?
Alright, alright. I get that you can't do without me anymore. No sense beating around the bush like that. If you need my help, just say the word. I'll always be here for you, as your friend.
Exceptional talents earn exceptional rewards. That's just how things should be.
It's been a while, but that's quite the improvement—Excuse me!? Why must you emphasize that this happened when I wasn't working here as an instructor?

Long time no see, Doctor. Ahem, let me introduce myself again. Beatrix Schwire, soon-to-be Chief Commissioner of the Lungmen Guard Department—I really am the chief! Whoever said the L.G.D. chief can't take holidays?!
Rawr... Ahem... You finished your work?

Is this the last document you have? Alright! You really kept me waiting this time, but finally, time for supper! I know this new place that's not so bad. It's on me tonigh—Oh, You don't want me spending money? Umm... alright, then it's on you. I know some other places.

Things are looking up for the trading company I'm running with Bison. Transporting one country's goods to another, sharing the cultures of places afar, these are the charms of commerce. Many are afraid of breaking barriers, but, Doctor, I'm sure we can find common ground.

The new Siesta's an interesting place. Even without its beaches and volcano, it's still worth a visit for its sky pools and natural springs. My investment there has resulted in pretty decent returns too. Doctor, if you find the time, you should go and see for yourself. Heading back to a place you haven't been in a while... might be just like a reunion with an old friend.

I may have left my family's company, but I still deal in business every now and then. It's a way to build Lungmen, so there's no need to avoid the subject. And now that I've figured out what I need to do, I don't find my grandfather so scary anymore. Hmhm, Once you've made use of your fears, that's when you've truly conquered them, right?

It's not really a big deal, being L.G.D. chief. I've got a little more on my shoulders, a little more to worry about, and I can put myself in Ch'en's shoes a little more now... Oh, let me reiterate: I'm taking over the L.G.D., not taking over for Ch'en! If that stupid Lung came back right now, she'd have to call me 'Chief.'

Ahem... I've taken a glance at our recent mission records. Looks like Rhodes Island's tactics have got more professional over the past few years. Not bad, not bad... Excuse me?! What's wrong with your former training consultant checking your operators' records? I absolutely have not been looking at Ch'en's files!

If Rhodes Island's looking for business partners, you can definitely trust these companies. Hey! Why are you looking at me like that? I'm just genuinely listing off my recommendations. You're making it look like I'm plotting a hostile takeover of Rhodes Island. If I'm actually planning an M&A... I just need to talk you round, right?
It's a holiday, so of course I gotta dress a little more casual. I may not have taken as many field missions these past few years, but I still passed the L.G.D.'s physical exams, in high heels.
Alright, chop chop. Finish your work during your coffee break so the rest of your day is all coffee break!

Working for Rhodes Island has been valuable practical experience for me. I've learned a great deal. But I think I need more experience still, before I can decide whether or not I should stay. Whatever the future brings, I believe you and I are fighting for justice.

Doctor, happy birthday to you! Please, take this present. It's a wooden dummy. 'When seeking the way, the greatest fear is to have no master nor opponent,' so to us who wish to be martial artists, it's both an opponent and a master. Alright, let me teach you how to train with it!
Care for some tea, Doctor?

Doctor, happy holidays. I—I was just taking a walk. I haven't had Hung's food in forever, so the moment I slip up... It really does take a strong will to resist temptation, I still need more training... Doctor, it's not too late yet. Let's go train together!
You want to go for a walk? Sure, let's get going. It's safer to have me with you.
An ambush...?! ...Doctor, don't you ever sneak up on me like that again. Now let's get you to Medical first.
At least it's better than some old, messy detective agency.
Father... I'm still... not strong enough.
That was not enough. I need to train more.
A strong will conquers all.
Foul intentions lead a foul life. Repent now. There is still time.
The mind directs, the fist executes!
Behold, the power of the Song Do Bart Cham style!
Pick on someone your own size!
You have turned your backs on society!
All right!
No other choice.
Go ahead.
Like cutting weeds and pulling roots!
Fight evil with the fist of justice!
I have much to learn, but I won't turn down the responsibility.
More evil to fight against?

I often witness injustices in my life. If I ever find myself unable to stop them, I reflect on the moment, and force myself to get stronger. So, if ever you need me, don't hesitate to say so. I'll be there, with all my strength!
Thank you very much, Doctor. You placed your trust in me, and I won't let you down.
If I can fight like this here, I can definitely knock them out.
Is this Rhodes Island? Nice to meet you. I'm Waai Fu, your new part-timer. Please don't go easy on me. I can handle anything you ask of me. Yes, just give me the word.
Falling asleep at a time like this... Oh well, I'll just finish your work for you.

Doctor, did any mail come for me? It did? Great. They included my grade report inside... I need them for a lot of things. It's been straight A's for me, so far. If I don't work hard enough, I'll end up regretting all the things I wasn't strong enough to do.

My rotten dad said he had to go find the true meaning of kung fu before he went off, and I still don't know where he is. Please! What year does he think it is? Find some common sense and learn some responsibility before you get yourself killed. But at least I haven't forgotten what he taught me: 'Martial arts have martial virtue, humans have human kindness.'

You think you just saw me? In downtown Lungmen? That may have been me. I just finished class. Hm? You saw me beat down some thugs who were harassing a passerby? And then slipped away before the police arrived? Must have been someone else. Heh heh. Definitely. You were just seeing things, that's it.

Just like how people value morality, martial arts have yin and yang, right and wrong. To right those wrongs, to defeat evil, to counter bad kung fu, these are all second nature to me. The world is dark, and someone must stand for justice.
You wonder where I learned martial arts? Well, I have my nasty old dad and his weird education to thank for that. Not that I resent kung fu. A hero must uphold justice. Martial arts are a part of me.

Did I ever tell you about my other job? No? Well, I won't. Don't look at me like that, Doctor. There's just not much to say. If my other office worked a tenth as hard as Rhodes Island does, they'd probably have become the only detective agency in Lungmen.

I color coded all the documents to be sent out, the backups have already been delivered, your schedule is right here. I bought your late night snack and put it in the refrigerator. Don't forget to heat it up. And last, oh, do you need me to change the light bulb in your office for you?

Sorry, Doctor, Rhodes Island is just a part-time job for me. I have to study hard to make sure I have a nice, normal future ahead of me. If you plan to have me aboard and on 24-hour call… Well, I'll have to ask you reconsider that.
Doctor, where are you going? Shouldn't you be working? Lunch? Well then, I'm coming along. There's a few things I want to buy, and I can also keep a lookout for you.

Does it matter that much? I don't really super-mind the kind of man I turn out to be in the end, but it's like Waai Fu and Hung keep having these hopes of somethin'. And Rhodes Island's a little better than I was thinkin' here. So no duh, I'm happy to keep goin' with you guys.

Heheheh, here's a cake, fruits of my research! I assure you, it's pure cake, nothin' but the same stuff you find in every cake! ...You heard weird laughing from the lab yesterday? My dude, there was no such thing, and I think your ears might be goin' funky. C'mon, a bite of cake'll fix you.
Hey, my dude. What's cookin'?

Happy New Year, my dude. Hung just made a bunch of food, wanna try? I don't really do holidays myself—big rowdy pointless time, when you could be sittin' here takin' the breeze in. But hey, want some tong sui? I got it from the dining table, and man, it's not half bad.
Yo, my dude! Found any new experiment samples for me?
Yeah, what?
Let's see here, which of these rooms is my new lab?
Don't worry, my dude. I can fix any injury as long as the patient's still breathing.
Letting 'em get away like that? You are a saint.
Could we capture some enemies for a little experimenting? It's not violating ethics as long as no one sees it. Not a chance? Aww.
I doubt I can make the world a better place on my own, but at least I can stop it from gettin' any worse with your help.
Medicine, a box you wish you've never opened!
My potion might give the bad guys a new leaf to turn over!
Just take the shot. You will be amazed.
All lives are equal... while yours is a deviation.
Learn to treat yourself with kindness, or regret when sickness treats you.
Time for a clinical test of my new meds.
I ain't one for battle, but treating peole is so much fun!
When prescribing, I always go double-down on the dosage.
Simmer down, guys. With me on your team, none of you's gonna die even if you want to.
Once I start an operation, there's no stoppin' it.
All right, team, gimme your thoughts on my new meds after this is done.
We goin' on a mission? Sure, let's do it.

Honestly, I dunno if I'm helpful or not. The way I see it, you've gotta be nice to be helpful, and I'm not blind to how people perceive me. But in any case, if you ever get sick, you know who to call.
A promotion? Almost too good to be true, man. I knew my agency has been exploiting me all along!
Huh... Does this mean I might get involved in combat scenarios like this? Surely not, right?

So you're the Doctor, eh? Nice to meet'cha. My name's Aak. That's right, two A's with a K. Anyway, I'm here 'cause the agency got some business here at Rhodes Island. A quick question before we start: does the phrase 'medical mishap' put you off?
Aha! You Feelin' tired? Then come try this new compound I made! Free of charge, of course!

Have Waai Fu and Hung left? Really? Aight, I'm gonna hang out in your office for a while then. Y'know, if anyone can make this land a better place, it's gotta be people like them. You, meanwhile... Well, guess we are simply two peas in a pod, aren't we?

My pops was an amazing doctor, and he was all about saving people's lives. But his colleagues slandered him, sidelined him, and framed him. That's how he ended up as a underground doctor, the nastiest among the wicked. Stuff like that ain't so unusual, but I'll admit, what happened to him really changed my own life.

Me, a cynic? You got me wrong, my dude. I simply pity all the people on this land. Everyone's got their own hardships to deal with, and I know that. But what's the point of curing pains and sufferings when we can't cure their source? What medicine saves a man who's being murdered? Terra doesn't need more doctors in suits, my dude.

I don't dislike Rhodes Island. Instead, I think you guys are doing your job just fine. People are dyin' in the world right as we speak, and with all those doctors cooping up in labs, waiting for patients to knock on their clinics' doors, diseases ain't rid themselves of these lands. Hardly anyone gets it, but you people seem to have it in mind... Keep up the good stuff, will ya?

The medical department guys are askin' for me? Man, give me a break. I don't dig those professional physicians. They firmly believe that being a doctor's this noble job, and are content with saving more lives... before everything just comes crashing down when their faith got shattered. I've seen that happen time and time again. Honestly, it makes me sad.

Yeah, I develop new drugs, do surgery, and nurture bacteria cultures, but those are all just fun hobbies to me. Doc. Aak? Nah, don't call me that. I don't save anyone, 'cuz I can't teach them the value of their lives. All I can do is just prevent 'em from dying.

Lemme guess, Hung's still tellin' you to watch out around me, ain't he? Oh, just to 'look after me'? Yeah, that sounds like him all right. But listen, Boss, I know your type. You're like me, and you just wanna do whatever you want, right? Then just ignore that guy. We can do whatever fun stuff we like.

Whoa, whoa, hold up! Is that vampire lady none other than 'Mr. Blood'?! Man, we've still not settled that medical score we had a while back, and this is the perfect opportunity! I'll have to set up my experiment equipment later... Heheheheh!
Oh yeah, my dude, when you're callin' my name to get my attention, don't forget to stress the K at the end. Or else I might assume you're stammering or somethin'.

Doc, congrats on making it through another year. Aak's a lot more steady than he was a year ago, and now he knows the right path to take. Waai Fu? She hasn't needed me to worry about her for a long time. By the way, it looks like Rhodes Island is holding a dinner party. Anywhere you might need me?

Doc! Birthdays are big days, you can't let them slip by. You've got to celebrate right! If there's anything you want me to make, I'll make it! ...Just sit and hang with you? I don't need to cook anything? Well, jeez, then I bought those groceries for nothing...
Morning, Doc.
Happy New Year, Doc! ...I'm in a good mood? Haha, of course, who wouldn't be in a good mood during a pleasant time like the New Year? Anyway, I'll be counting on you this year as well.
Sup, Doc? Anything I can help you with?
Are there any broken machines in here?
Leave patrol duty to me.
Hurry, Doc, climb onto my back! I'm getting you out of here!
Stay beside me, Doc. There are still enemies around.
You just stay here and rest, Doc. I'll clean up the battlefield.
*pant*... *pant*... Sorry, Doc, but could you give me a minute? I'm totally burned out.
A little scratch ain't gonna stop me!
You're not hurting anyone on my watch!
Anyone need healing?
You shall not pass!
I'm here to protect you all!
Get behind me!
Where am I needed?
I'll handle this!
You can all rest easy, knowing I'm here!
Stay close behind me so we don't get split up.
I personally guarantee everyone's safety.
A mission? I'm ready whenever.
Doc, don't hesitate to give me all the work you need done. I might not have the brain for many things, but I've got the brawn!
Thanks, Doc! I'll be giving it 110% from here on out!
Woah, your operators never cease to amaze me... I've got to work harder.

You must be the doctor that Mr. Lee talked about. The name's Hung, it's a pleasure to meet you. My fields of expertise are security and repairing machinery. If you ever need a bodyguard for a public appearance, or if your TV or fridge break down, just give me a holler!
Do– Phew, almost woke the Doc up... Guess I'll take this opportunity to rest too.

To be honest with you, I actually don't like getting into fights. I'd much rather we could all get along with each other. But I won't back down from inevitable conflicts; there are things I'll fight to protect. Things like the agency, and now, Rhodes Island as well.
Hey, Doc, If you need info on something or someone, just tell me and I'll ask Mr. Lee for you. Nothing in Lungmen happens without him knowing about it.

Me and Mr. Lee, well... How should I put it... I was a bit scared of him at first. He seemed like a clever guy who's got a lot going on, which had me on edge... But now after knowing him for so many years, I know I have nothing to worry about, haha.

I'm sure you already know, but with the intellect and talent that Aak's got, he's destined for great things one day. But personally, all that matters to me is that he doesn't ever go back to what he used to be.
Hahah, just between you and me, Doc, for the longest time I thought all detectives do the same stuff as Mr. Lee. You know, like investigating crime scenes, that sort of thing.
Say, Doc, do you give any lectures on machines here at Rhodes Island? I've got an interest in that stuff and was hoping I could learn something new.
Just call on me when you're hungry, Doc, and I'll make you a little something to eat. I may not be a chef, but Mr. Lee taught me how to cook a few recipes.

Doc, I know Aak's been a nuisance to you, but could you be lenient with him? He teases people a lot, but he's not a bad person. Also, let me know if he ever gets under your skin, I'll give him a lesson on that.
Hey, Doc. Have you eaten yet? You could have one of my cookies if you're hungry.

'Boiled cactus,' 'leaping Lungmen gate,' or 'river on a reed?' What should we try? It's hard to get a hold of these dishes at any other time. I'm treating you all today, you hear. It won't do to strain your mind all the time, you need to let go now and then. Thanks for your hard work, Doctor. The things you do deserve some real praise.

Happy birthday, Doctor. Eh? How did I know it was today? Haha, how could I forget? You're one of my biggest clients, a little human touch is the least I could...  Okay, okay, no more jokes, Dr.{@nickname}. Go ahead, please, accept this meager token. Friendship is friendship, and we're past all that other stuff.
Welcome to Lee's Detective Agency, do you have any work... oh, er? So it was you, Doctor.

I'm getting old here—I nearly forgot it was a holiday today. So, an auspicious word or two from me, for good fortune? Here's to Rhodes Island business thriving and—erm, no, that's not right. 'May our health be rude, and our pillboxes grow dusty,' there we go, best we wish everyone well. You want your New Year to be hale and hearty, after all.
No smoking here? But this isn't a cigarette, it's white stick candy. You don't believe me? Go on, try some.
I'm sure we can talk this out, nice and easy. No need for physical contact, right?
Doctor? Here, take this. Decorate your room with it. Ah, but not at the head of your bed. What does it do? Haha, now that would be telling.
Risky, risky. There's a terrifying fortune to get. Thank goodness we run fast.
Now, now, hold it! Do not press an enemy at bay. Let them run free.
Well done, Doctor. What, where was I just now? Well, given your capability, it was better for me to be your moral support. Cheered the whole time, you see.
My thanks. It couldn't have happened without you, Doctor... I owe you for this one. I won't forget.
*Grumble* I told you. Don't get so worked up.
My friends, I implore you to reconsider-- Is there REALLY no room for negotiation here?
Hey, buddy! Calm it down! You nearly spilled my tea!
Come on, man. Friendliness is good for business.
Time for a little telling off. But not too harshly.
Hello, friends, what are we talking about?
There, there. Put your worries to rest. I'm right here.
I'm sure you can sort them... wait, hold it. Am I up now?
Fortune favors the bold, but you still need a few tricks up your sleeves to win the battle.
It's like we're on a school trip here, eh?
Good. Follow my instructions closely, then. Alright, everyone, dismissed—wait, hold it, don't head off for real! I was joking! Joking!
Do I have to come along too? *Sigh*... fine, fine. Let's get going.

Life goes by in a flash. If you're always jostling for the lead, when do you stop to smell the roses? Don't think too hard about things. Enjoy the moment. No matter how paranoid you are, it'll happen if it's going to happen. And you've dealt with it, all's right with the world.
A promotion...? There's a first for me. Feels quite fresh, too. I think times like these call for some magic words—thank you very much, boss?
How about a quick scrap? No, no, I'm just joking. I'm no good in a fight.

Hello, hello there, you must be the Doctor? You've been looking after my employees for me. They haven't made trouble for you, have they? Oh, that reminds me, here's a card for my agency. Take it, go ahead.
Why a busy life when you can have a leisurely cup of tea. *gulp* Doctor, you do keep some good tea leaves here.

My hexagram says to avoid going out, so I'll pass on this mission today... what, I can't? I have to go, no two ways about it? Hah, I see. Then this is a special exception, once only! I'm lending you a hand, so dinner's on you tonight! Look, I'm all decided! This is the joint!

Everyone's chasing fame and profit. But after so many winning and losing, how many people get to end up as what they like? Living a decent little life of your own is sometimes a lot to ask for. Ah, what are we all doom and gloom for? I'll go stir-fry something up, so you wait for me, Doctor. A drink together would be even better, don't you think?

Why are the lights all on at this hour... oh? Ah, Doctor. Are you still processing battle records? Well, I never thought you were such a workaholic. I'm impressed. But! You'd better turn in sooner. It's not worth it to break your body doing it.

Under this heading, you had the third row on the left here wrong, so I patched that up, no need for thanks. Oh, do I come off very fluent? Not at all, this is still my first time accounting on a scale so small outside of the agency. Things used to be very—ah, I'm getting distracted, don't you mind.

How do you like it, Doctor? Jaye makes mean finballs, doesn't he? Old Tung taught that boy his trade and his way of treating people. It all combines for a flavor unique to Lungmen. Come on, have a try. It'll warm you up.

It's thanks to your patronage that the agency is still running smoothly, give or take. Lungmen's a place with the human touch—live there long enough, and sooner or later you'll know a crowd, find the right connections. We don't like spilling blood in our line of work—always best to solve things friendly.

Having Waai Fu and Hung around to keep an eye on that Aak boy really saves me a broken back. I'll admit, it's shameful, but I started out babysitting these kids, and now they're all taking care of me. Kids these days do more than we did when I was young, and that's great.

A job? Of course, I'm all ears. Or maybe you'd like something a little spicier than detective work? Some wet work? Haha, just pulling your leg. We don't do that sort of thing. We're fine, upstanding citizens running a legitimate business.
Sorting files? Whoa, I've suddenly gotten this headache. I can't take it, I need a break. Well, keep at it, Doctor. Such little paperwork should be a walk in the park for you, right?

I might not be extremely well off at Rhodes Island, no, I can eat properly and dress myself, that's already relatively well off... but basically, I'm extremely grateful to have a work environment that supports my R&D like this! I need to double up my efforts, and get results worth the experimental funding, before I can rest!

Doctor, happy birthday! Thank you for always looking out for me, I got you a present. Here's an ergonomic chair to correct your posture, and an automatic document sorter, I made them both myself. I know they're made of really cheap materials, but I can promise they're great quality.
Good day, Doctor.

So today's a holiday? No wonder the canteen has such an amazing spread. I can finally enjoy a proper meal, heheh. Speaking of which, Rhodes Island sure has a lot of holidays. If I take another job in the downtime, maybe I can make a little more money...
Woah, so this is what it's like inside Rhodes Island... I'm so envious...
I, I'll go salvage some damage parts, to at least reduce our losses...
Some enemies got away, sh-should we chase after them?
What a flawless victory - not a bit of waste!
As long as we work together, there's no obstacle we can't overcome!
My equipment's in good shape!
Stop moving around, it'll be easier this way!
Clawhook at the ready!
This is my first time being so close to a battlefield...
My clawhook won't malfunction, right?
I'll do my best!
I found the enemy!
Clawhook inspection complete! Take a deep breath... I can do this!
You want m-me to be the squad leader? I really don't know anything about battle though...
It'll be all right, as long as I work just as hard as I did during training...
'Heaven rewards the hard-working.' Wouldn't you agree, Doctor?
Ehh? A p-promotion? I feel a bit more pressure, but I'll be okay. This is the proof that I'm one step farther than when I first came.
Woah... This isn't something you can learn with more effort...
Oww... my head! Sorry... Oh, y-you're the Doctor? It's a pleasure to meet you. My name is Snowsant. Sorry, I shouldn't be walking with my head down...
...Did you fall asleep? Just let me handle the rest, though I am a bit hungry.

Money is very important. Before I returned to Lungmen, I refused a large retention fee from the research institute, so my self-funded research project went under... But it's more important to be home. I can always save up more money, and now I won't go dizzy from looking at all those large numbers!

After I become a great, world-famous scientist with lots of money, I swear I'll have three meals a day and dessert too, just like Jessica... And then, with the money I'm not able to spend, I'd put it back into making Lungmen a better place. Um... if a day like that ever comes.

You'd like to take a look at my clawhook? That's maybe fine... but whatever you do, don't push this button. And watch your thumb when you're holding the grip... W-wait, you're not winding the rope correctly, and... Ack! Sorry, don't mind me, you can keep looking at it...
Frugality is a type of virtue, but for me, it's closer to a habit... D-despite that, if you or my friends were in need, I'd gladly help out! I'm serious!

Oripathy... Hm, even though it's a bit beyond my field of study, it does seem to be worth looking into... But if I add another research project, I'll go from two meals a day to two days a meal... Ugh...

This is the Originium ammunition that Jessica ordered... Eh? D-Doctor! Isn't this dollar amount wrong? Or is this the currency of some small remote country? It's not? It's LMD? I, I, I, I, I see... Don't worry, I was just a l-l-l-little s-surprised.

Ugh, I forgot to turn off the light when I left the office yesterday... Hm? Rhodes Island has a power generation facility so there's no need to pay for electricity? Really? Does that I mean I get to eat dinner in the future?
My dream is to be praised sincerely by the entire world... Ah, um, maybe just Lungmen... Well, maybe I should start with Rhodes Island, or, um, just you! Yes, that is my dream for the time being...
D-Doctor! Excuse me, but could you please move a little? You're stepping on a coin...

So many doctors aboard Rhodes Island are Infected themselves. Rescue workers who can't protect themselves properly... they're not a rare sight to see. But these rescuers still choose to walk towards disaster, realizing the risk and taking it in. Their conviction is most precious. I hope that our effort can help more people live in peace.

Doctor, happy birthday... I'd like to ask, ever since I gave you that amulet, did any of your wishes happen to come true...? N—No? Then... do you have any wishes for your birthday, that I can make real?
Hello, Doctor. Do you have work today too?

Happy New Year, Doctor. Phew... I didn't expect to spend the New Year here at Rhodes Island this time. It feels kind of strange. Actually, because of work, it's been a few years since I've been home for the New Years. I really want to go back, even if I can only look at it from far away...
Doctor! I really appreciate it, but please stop trying to sneak any more amulets onto me... I have way too many already!
Huh? Ah! I'm sorry! I'm sorry!
Whoa, this is the staff dormitory... Um, will I need to pay rent?
It's not safe here! Everyone, please evacuate! Doctor, follow me!
Wait! It's not safe that way... We have to do something. I'll go fetch them right away!
Phew, that wraps up the operation. Doctor, was I helpful?
Report! All rescue operations in the area have been completed. Evacuation and escort proceeding without issue! Phew, thank goodness nobody's hurt...
It's my job to ensure everyone's safety!
Where are you looking? It's dangerous to get distracted!
I... I can do it too!
Everyone, please be careful!
Rescue team Mulberry in position!
Preparing rescue...!
Phew... Haah! Oh, I'm here! I-I'm not nervous!
Safety goggles... Okay, I have mine on. Let's go!
Watch out, everyone! There's movement up ahead!
Okay, we'll head out right away... Everyone, please stay safe. We'll meet again once this is over.
Huh? Me as team captain? Ah... Are you sure?
I'll do my best to support everyone!
This time, I'm not doing this to help someone else, I'm doing it for myself... Doctor, thanks for always being there to cheer me on. Now, I'm sure that everything that I've done is truly meaningful.
Huh? A promotion? Really? I get a salary from Rhodes Island as well as Chun-qian?! I... I'm so happy...!
Uhh..The mountain collapsed, and the ground crumbled...! They're not special effects from an action movie, are they?

Hello, I'm a member of the Yan disaster relief organization 'Chun-qian,' dispatched here as an intern. My name is... Oh, I-I'm sorry. We need to use our codenames here, right? I'm terribly, terribly sorry. Please call me Mulberry.
Doctor? Doctor? Sorry to bother you. Please lift your head up a little and sleep with the cushion. If you fall asleep like this, the letters from the report will get all over your face...

When I got infected with Oripathy, I knew I probably wouldn't be able to live the peaceful life my parents wanted for me. I don't regret it, though... Besides, if I hadn't made my decision, I would never have met you or anyone else from Rhodes Island here and now, hehe.

Uhh! Doctor, why would you sneak up on me like that? Huh? What am I holding? Oh, this is a letter I got from home. When I made the decision to leave, my parents were so angry that they said they would disown me, but there's a saying where I come from: Blood is thicker than water...

Doctor, sorry to bother you... I've been studying Oripathy prevention techniques during Catastrophe relief, and Tsukinogi suggested that I come ask for your advice... Um... Sorry, am I being a bother?

When I first joined the rescue team, I wasn't very used to the climate or the food there. I'd get too homesick to fall asleep at night, and I cried to myself many, many times, but whenever I see the people we rescued, I start to think that maybe I can keep at it...

The rescue team has to deal with the Catastrophes a lot, so it's only a matter of time for us before we become infected. None of us reject anyone because of that. The crystallization on my body isn't very conspicuous, and it doesn't hurt even if you press down on it... Sometimes, I even forget that I have this on my body.
Doctor, could you help me look for my little dumpling? It's the small black-and-white doll. I thought I'd left it here, but I can't find it... *Whimpers*, please, I can't sleep at night without it.

Sorry to disturb you, Doctor, but would you happen to know where Provence and everyone else went? My family sent me some goodies from back home, and I thought I'd share some with them since they've been taking care of me... Oh, there are some for you too, Doctor. Please have a taste!

I'm not very good at speaking any languages other than Yanese. That's why I was a little scared at first and didn't talk much. But everyone's very friendly, and there are a lot of people from Yan here. Phew... it really puts my mind at ease.
Doctor, I'll leave the files I sorted here. Oh, you don't have to thank me. I am used to it, and it's nothing difficult... Um, are you thirsty perhaps? Should I make you some tea?

It's been some time since Rhodes Island and Lungmen first made contact. It took a lot of effort for us to assuage the suspicion we had and build the trust we now share. Fortunately, time has proven that the effort was worth it. Right, I don't like talking about 'trust' per se, but Rhodes Island is an exception.

You think this glass ornament is pretty...? As long as you like it. It's not that hard to make, actually... Anyway, Happy birthday. If you have time tonight, how about I take you out somewhere for dinner? I'll take you to get real Lungmen food, somewhere Swire's ilk would never know.
I hope you didn't run into any trouble, Doctor.

Happy New Year, Doctor. My dad sends out greeting cards to his foreigner friends this time of year. I'm usually the one who writes them. Here, this is for you. You've been pretty busy this year. Good work.
Boh loh yau, fresh out of the oven, want one?
You'll need an explanation for what you just did.
I don't need too much room here, but this place could use some decoration.
There is always a way to correct a mistake. Don't let anger get the best of you.
The situation is still salvageable. Leave the rest to me.
Clean, decent. No one will ever find their remains.
It better remain a secret forever.
Shatter into pieces.
Give me a reason to let you go. Don't have one? What a pity.
You want to talk? Too late for that.
You didn't think. So this is what happens when you cross the line.
Let's put them six feet under.
Watch the shadow behind you.
Say no more.
It's time to make an example. They'll see what happens when they break the rules.
I hope I won't have to explain to you what we mean by 'necessary methods.'
If any of you have any doubts about the target, this is your last chance to pull out.
You tell me your ends, just don't ask me my means.
I know what I'm doing, and that's all that matters. At the end of the day, not all honors need to be made public, and not all roads need to be trod together.
I sometimes attend ceremonies like these just to make things go smoother. I don't remember how many titles I have. But in the end, I always have to return to the shadows.
There are many ways to deal with trouble, and direct confrontation is usually my last choice.

You and I have probably crossed paths before, Doctor, but we finally found time for a formal introduction. There'll be much more done on the problems the Infected face in the Lungmen slums, now that we're working in direct communication.
You can't let them see you exhausted, can you…?

The nightscape here is very different from my childhood memories. Lungmen may be advancing by the day, but it still has its unlit corners... How about we go for a drink together? You can't truly know a city until you've visited its streets during the wee hours.

I had nothing to do, so I trimmed the potted plant on your desk a little. No matter how busy life is, we can't forget our aesthetics. Why are you so surprised? The four arts, flower arrangement, tea ceremony... They were all part of my education. You would never have guessed? Whatever.

I've never seen Ch'en onboard Rhodes Island. She has things to do, doesn't she? Hmph, hardly see any merit in recruiting operators like her. It's true that we don't get along very well. But I must admit, she is the one who showed me a different path.

To certain people, the slums are a problem that needs to be solved. To others, this is their home. The shift from 'Slums' to 'Downtown' could take generations to settle. I don't know how far I can carry it myself, but I'll do what I can.

The coat my father always wears is a birthday present I gave him. I'm so used to the dignified airs he puts on, sometimes I even forget that... underneath the coat is an old man growing frailer by the day. Sooner or later, someone will have to stand up and take the weight off his shoulders.

I just saw Swire here. It surprised me how she was working so hands-on. If we'd followed the dreams we had as kids, she would've become the head of Lungmen's Chamber of Commerce, and I might be a university lecturer right now. You never know... Hm? No, I don't need to say hello. Given her status, it would be inappropriate for us to be seen in public.

I'm sure you've been working with Mr. Lee. You can trust the information you get from him, but there are limits to what a private investigator can do. If you need something outside his purview, you come to me. Don't worry, my methods won't send any trouble Rhodes Island's way.

Rhodes Island's work in Lungmen will remain confidential, but I know that your actions saved lives. I've spent a long time trying to gauge just how trustworthy Rhodes Island really is. As for my conclusion, I trust you had no trouble setting up your office in Lungmen?
I can offer you protection, and even handle a little business for you. But you'd better prove it's worth my time.

Yumen throws a banquet rather like this every year, to reward its warriors for their work the year prior. The men would clatter their weapons and sing along with the beat. But the next morning, they would still be up for duty, no matter how inebriated. Just like that, Yumen has traversed the lands and defended Great Yan's peace for a hundred years. Doctor, what is it that you defend?

Once I traveled through Sargon and taught the locals a few moves for their defense. From what I heard, they became very fierce and instigated many riots. Ever since, I have been careful who I teach. This booklet contains instructions on how to strengthen your body and health. Take it. It is a joyous day, after all.
Doctor, I did not see you at this morning's training session.

Nian, Dusk, and Ling are already drunk? It's not often Rhodes Island gets this lively...Let them be. Relax, I will keep an eye on them. Our sibling 'reunion' may be an extraordinary event to most, but this too is human nature. Who are we to reject participation in these traditions?
The times are changing, and man along with them. So too does the scenery change.
Doctor, have you figured out how to counter that move from yesterday?
This is much more comfortable than a military tent. Can I even manage a good night's sleep without the sound of drilling soldiers…?
All warriors must face defeat. Don't lose heart.
There is never a true victory in brandishing a sword and formulating a strategy, while looking for gains and losses is an even greater folly. So long as you leave no regrets, then all is well.
A thousand armies move at the beating of your war drums, with a handful of sand to clean the blood from one's armor... What a tremendous victory!
You calmly place your pieces to plot your victory... Doctor, a weiqi player like you is a truly rare sight.
After all this time, you still turn to war for solutions!
Strike, and sunder the tides cleft. Retract, and leave no peace bereft.
A thousand moves in one breath!
Unsteady posture, wavering intent. Much to learn yet.
Many intellectuals must join a battle before penning a decent verse, including that sister of mine… This too is an opportunity.
Look at this spectacular sight. Alas, it is now a battlefield.
At your command.
One should spar from time to time.
Warriors from afar rest scarce, the armor they wear spurs them to march.
The sunset weaves a silken river. Heaven and earth bolster me upon departure.
In that case, Doctor, will you beat the drums for me as we sortie?
Lit, quenched, then lit again… The signal fires never ever rest.
Battles we have fought, death we have braved. Doctor, no need to say more.

Often I think about those soldiers who traveled from all corners of Great Yan to Yumen. They risked their lives in battle until death took them, or their age crept upon themselves... yet never for their own ends.
The colors that once embellished the autumn grass, hues long buried by war.

Doctor, thank you kindly for taking care of my sisters. I hope you will excuse me for intruding upon Rhodes Island for a little while. Please call me 'Chongyue.' It's a name given to me by... an old friend of mine.
The spring comes and goes, leaving a lonely autumn.

The scholars at court seek perfect answers in everything. The kung fu practitioners who wander in jianghu seek revenge, status, glory, or a simple resolution. Their obsessions run deep, yet their time runs short. Often, they spend their whole lifetimes chasing a single ideal or undertaking... All those people, how woeful and pitiful, how respectable and regrettable.

'Who am I'... For this question, you need only gaze upon the water. Be it human, beast, mountains, foggy woods, or the reflection of the twin moons on the night sky, whatever it is you see, that is your answer. As for the distant, radically different future, whether we siblings will return to chaos and seek new answers, is an entirely different question.

That sword is an unwanted possession that must not be cast away. Huai Tianpei keeping it is an outcome that all concerned parties can accept. My duel with him, you ask? He trained for forty years, and landed a single heavy blow on me. But how many comings and goings of spring and autumn have I trained? All things considered, I was the one who lost.

The world is a vast place, and wonderful sceneries abound, yet man has limited strength and time. It is impossible to see all these sights, much less defend them. To those who practice the martial arts, all we can do is train day and night, from the depths of winter to the height of summer. It may sound like a clumsy and brutish method, but the result is giving every last drop you have, leaving no regrets.

Death is a daily occurrence to warriors on campaign. But the real challenge they face, is preserving their humanity and morality after facing such morbidity, rather growing jaded and desensitized. Indeed, conflicts and mortality have been the way of these lands for eons. But only those giant, terrible creatures are cold-hearted enough to think so.

I agreed to be a 'fight choreographer' for Nian's movie. It keeps her from making too much of a racket, or getting too lonely. Dusk is timid, and Ling is too fond of drink. I will look after them as well... We are far from a normal family. Nevertheless, we are siblings, and not the collective 'we' as we are often called.

As you can see, I note down only my experiences and insights, rather than any specific kung fu moves. What really matters to the martial arts is 'Yi' — your intent. If you let yourself be constrained by those gaudy forms, you will find it hard to break out of them. Take Dusk's paintings, for example. If I couldn't grasp the intent behind them, and sought to discuss techniques and styles with her, she would only shut the door on my face.

'Doctor.' Your title reminds me of the Yanese scholars. Experienced and knowledgeable, they see the forest for the trees. You feel like we've met before? It's true that after awakening from my dream of chaos, I have traveled to many places... Sadly, the more friends I make, the lonelier I feel. Perhaps we are alike in that respect.

You would like to be my 'kung fu recorder?' The way Rhodes Island treats its guests truly moves me. It is no wonder my sisters love this place so much… I misunderstand? No problem, I have no qualms with being your subordinate either.

I went against my grandfather's wishes by becoming a cop, but I believe it was the right choice for me, not that it's easy. This isn't just to take control of my own life. More than that, it's for Lungmen's future. Hey, don't think Ch'en's the only one who thinks about this stuff. Just like her, I have much to do in the future.

Look at you always wearing that outfit. You gotta at least change your shoes sometimes. Here, look what I've brought for you. Dark, flat, no design sensibility whatsoever. The brand I usually wear just got a bunch of new styles, and I picked out a few pairs for you based on your tastes. But looking like that, nobody will be able to tell they're luxury branded! What a waste!
Doctor, roar!

Happy New Year! Look at this crowd! So many people here! I brought some Lungmen street food with me... I-I didn't bring it for you guys! I wanted to have some myself! Right, if Ch'en has any, make sure she pays for her share. Call it a handling fee.
How... How about we go for dinner together? M-my treat!
Ah! How rude of you!
Not bad... No, I think this room could use some more renovation!
How could this have happened? How could I... How could I have blundered so badly?!
...Bad... just bad... You can do better, can't you? We'll work it out together. Don't give up!
Capital is all mergers and acquisitions! Victory is like investigation and arrest!
Fantastic! In battle as in business: high risk, high return!
Time to liquidate!
Lungmen has its own pride!
Hurry it up, let's move!
Time is money!
Business competitor or not, you will get a lesson from me!
This is far from my only battlefield!
I've seen through the enemy's strategies!
Let's finish this quickly. My time is far too precious!
Wipe them out in one fell swoop! It's cheaper that way!
Everyone, follow my orders to the letter!
Aha~! You finally need my wisdom!

Maybe it's that you want me to improve your relationship with Lungmen. Or, possibly, you truly need my talents. I suppose it could be something else you want, too... I'm not sure exactly what, and I can't promise it'll be on offer. But I'll be a stalwart with you to the end.
A promotion? Hmm? But it doesn't do anything for me back in Lungmen, does it? Well, if you insist, I suppose I will accept it!
Hmm, as far as tactical theory goes, this is a decent application!
Swire, Senior Superintendent of the L.G.D.. I'll be joining Rhodes Island as a training consultant. Dr. {@nickname}, I'm looking forward to working together with you for the future of Lungmen!
Uughh... I'm exhausted... Two shifts in a row really does... zzz... zzz...

You know, Doctor, Lungmen could use someone as talented as you. So, well... If you're not enjoying this line of work, there's plenty of opportunities in the banking and management sectors! I-I can get you a job! Oh? You'd rather we work with Rhodes Island? ...Fine!

Doctor, why is Rhodes Island's training course so short...? Insufficient capital? Unacceptable, I'm requesting an immediate transfer to the business division! It's-it's not as if I like business, but if you need me to do it, I'm... more than capable!

Lungmen bureaucracy is complicated, even for us. Keeping the peace, protecting the people, directing traffic, negotiating trade... Agh, it's absolutely backbreaking. But as long as what we do is good for Lungmen, I'll be—hehe—very pleased.

I've been allowed to set aside the family business for a while. But it's clear to me that the future of Lungmen needs both a stable public sector and security apparatus, as well as a healthy business and financial system. In both respects, I'm ready to be of service to Lungmen!
Exercise, study, training, researching my competitors and market shifts... Gotta keep them up!

Ahhh, that awful Ch'en isn't here, is she? Back when we were in the L.G.D. together, she shot me this dirty look every time we bumped into each other. It made me wonder if I've done anything bad! I just... kinda want to take over the L.G.D. myself. That couldn't be bad, right?

Hear me out, do you think we could redesign the instructors' office? At least add a bit of flavor to it, maybe a handmade rug or some atomistic art whatnot. It's just so bland now. Dobermann might say she doesn't care, but it really kills my enthusiasm...

They say Rhodes Island is a criminal organization, full of Infected people dirtying up the corridors. But that couldn't be further from the truth. Rhodes Island's Operators are giving their lives to make things better for everyone, just like the police force of Lungmen!

Doctor, we can't waste even one single precious minute! One minute could mean a loss of millions on the account with extra casualties on the field! Huh? Coffee? I take it with a sachet of sugar and heavy on the milk foam, thanks!

After I became an Infected, I thought for a bit that my career and my life were both over. Rhodes didn't just rein in my illness, but also gave me a fresh start. Standing up again in dire straits is exactly what the hero does, right? Doctor, Let's climb back to the top, together!

Doctor, happy birthday! There's this saying that 'life's a movie you can't reshoot,' so when it comes to a key scene, you've gotta live life like you're on fire! Any birthday wishes, Doctor? Gimme a wish as cool as the lead of an action movie, and I'll help you make it come true!
Did you have breakfast yet, Doctor?

Happy New Year, Doctor! Hehe, back in the old days, theaters would screen my movies this time every year, all playing to a full house!  Still, can't live in the past forever. I gotta punch ahead, and people gotta move on forward. Let's forget all our grievances for today!
Hey, Doctor, want my autograph? I'll take a pic with you if you want, too!
Stop that, I'm getting dizzy!
Now that's stylin'!
Aw... I just wanna go home and sleep...
Hey, it's no biggie. Just a few scratches and bruises.
It's over already? I was just starting to get warmed up.
Wow, it's over?
Who says a movie star couldn't be a real kung-fu master!
From flexibility comes power!
This is straight out of one of my movies!
Show time!
Here we go!
I'm FEater. Pleased to beat you!
This is gonna be exciting!
Huh? I'm the leader? Not sure how it'll go, but...
All right, it's show time!
This here's the perfect opportunity to show you some REAL kung fu!
Oooh! A promotion! Thanks so much, Doctor!
It's over? Come on, let's watch just a while longer. We're almost at the fun part!
You swear you've seen my face before? Probably saw it in a movie I was in! Call me FEater, and what I do from here is your call!
You're catching some z's, eh? Guess I'll slack off for a bit too. Man, this couch is so fluffy!

Doctor, look! What do you think about this script? Oh, who's gonna act in it, you wonder? You and I are gonna be the main characters! There's this scene where we leap from the roof of a thirty-story building and slide all the way down. Isn't that cool? Hey! Come back! Wait!

Am I satisfied with life at Rhodes Island, you ask? Hm, to be honest... It's even sweeter than what they show in the movies! I got cool opponents to practice with, top-notch food, and by working here, I'm doing something good for the world! What could be better!
There's a street full of food stalls in the neighboring city. And... a candy shop over there? And a theme park? Aww, Doctor, can I get a day off? I wanna check out these places!
Do I regret forgoing my previous life? Well, sometimes, of course. But the world ain't kind to us Infected. Lots of places I'm not allowed to go. It blows.

Reading a movie magazine...? Well, guess what? The 'hot kung-fu actress' mentioned in this article is ME! What? You don't believe me? Come on, look! This is me, can't you tell? C'mon, that's definitely me!

Hah. That boxer, Beehunter? She's really something! I enjoyed sparring with her so much, I had to throw out some serious moves. And she's got an amazing honey collection too. Wanna visit her with me next time? You gotta learn some kung fu first, though.
You remember fighting by my side before? Can't say I remember fighting by yours, sorry... I just fight for what's right, that's all.
These gauntlets aren't that heavy. See? Even a dainty little girl like me can carry 'em around real easy.
So... I have to just stand here and not do anything? Laaaame.

My master did tell me I was suited to martial arts, but she never taught of any place where you could use it, only that we shouldn't let down the conscience. Ah, I'm just thinking. If I'd not come to Rhodes Island, I'd probably be in Lungmen running a gym, I suppose? But all moneymaking aside, I fear I'd have never used this fan again.

Ah, Doctor, I've rustled up a divination for you, the grams are written here on this fan. They signify all will flow like water and wind in this fresh year of your... You don't believe me? Not unless I give you a performance with this fan? *cough* I'd be put at a loss, you know, given my mere modest speck of kickboxing artistry. But you are the boss, your word is law.
Well, if it isn't the Doctor! What a happy coincidence!

Now, everyone, don't miss it while... ah, Doctor. It's a holiday today, see? The rest area's full of people, so I thought I'd issue some secret little tomes to life, at low prices to boot! Good tidings to all, you know. Have you been sleeping well as of late? I just so happen to have a copy of 'Winter Sleep-Aiding Breathing and Respiration Techniques'. What say you have a look?
Doctor, what say I teach you a thing or two about some moves?
Hoh? What's this for exactly, Doctor?
Oh-hoh, Rhodes Island truly is a wondrous land. I feel quite dizzy just looking.
Go on ahead, everyone. No worries. My runaway act is first in class. I'll be just fine.
Pursue not the cornered. Suppose anything troublesome should happen, we'll just bear it together.
As they say, those of just ways have much support, and those of lost ways find little. Seen as such, our victory is assured.
More hands bring more fuel for the fire. When we concert our efforts together, yes, we truly can burn the sky a red to rival sunsets. Not bad, not bad.
Let's have you make a move first, now.
The moon waxes and wanes. The fan opens and shuts!
A perfect technique makes freedom to act!
Compose yourself. Collect yourself!
The Doctor, you are! What a sagacious decision!
Very well! Leave this to me.
Here! Right here!
Might you need me?
I'm witnessing fiends, one and all! Quite frightening!
As they say, all have their own methods, whether arms against a force or earth to a waterspout. There'll be a way!
Me, the captain? Hold one moment, just let me find my secret tomes for the art of war, now...
Very well! Doctor, I'll see to it that you have nothing at all to worry about.

Sooner or later, I plan to return to Kou-wu City and set every debt in my books straight. My only worry is I may invite trouble and sweep others up in its path. You know this, dear Doctor, and yet you still wish to bestow such partiality on me...? Your kindness toward me is a grace, and I will never, in eternity, forget it.

A promotion and a raise?! Ohh, ohh, I thank you, Doctor, in all respects possible! Be it for you, I would brave the greatest fires and waters, I would not hesitate to... well, that said, how much might my wages be growing by?
Ho, what a hundredfold bouquet of martial prowess. You've got my eyes wide open now!

My codename? 'Mr. Nothing.' The latter man of Tzu-hsu and Wu-yu; Nonexistent and Nothing indeed. And you, fine soul, are the Doctor? That is to say, my new boss? Well, then, would you like me to massage your back? Loosen up your legs?
Hmm. I've been pondering a fan for you too, but what ought we write on it?

Countless, they were, the ancient parasol trees about Kou-wu City. Oh, just reminiscing all of a sudden. I remember the leaves scattered across the ground come fall, when my parents would visit me from the country. Only then would my strict master speak nothing but good, and her other disciples, my brothers and sisters, wouldn't bully me. No, well, just reminiscing.

Say, Doctor, are people able to brush the past away as they live? Certainly not, hm? If the bonds you once left behind still hold fast, what ought you do? You've no idea either? Well, then. It seems we're companions in our misery. Here, what say we crack some sunflower seeds?

Benefactor Lava? Yes, I call her my benefactor. She once saved me, and as time went on, it became second nature. Throughout my life I've been saved thrice, and every time, I engrave it upon my soul. The gloompincer incident, you mean? No, not that. She showed to me a path, and that was true grace beyond all.

Now, now, Doctor, don't worry about me. I and the Infected do get along well. Back at my old place, a Catastrophe once struck not too far away. It frightened all of us, seeing the world go pitch black. My master remarked then that Catastrophes were Heaven's false charge against the human realm. Ah, truly a bitter thing.

M-Miss Dusk really did... come to Rhodes Island with us, then? My, um... what was it now? My recollection's quite fuzzy now, yet I have the vague impression that within her painted dreams, I had a peek into my own miserable future. Ah, let's never mind. Dear, oh, dear. You be quite careful too, Doctor.

Who was my master? Hmm, a question as complex as a showdown of Yan cuisines. Normally I'd refrain from answering that, as slipping up would get me beaten sideways. That said... you need only know, Doctor, I'm the last descendant of the Lien line. Ah, but my family name's not Lien. I'm a Ch'u.

D-Doctor, I was a little idle, see, and went to make myself useful at HR, and by carelessness glimpsed at a few operator files, and... er, well, could FEater be the very star of 'Fiends of the Gods Reincarnated Immortal' herself? Truly? Could I go get an autograph?

I'm no mere braggart! Beyond a little kickboxing in a scuffle, I can rustle up meals, practice acupuncture, divine with feng shui, work masonry, tend to rice and angle fish alike—I'm a maestro of all kinds! Doctor, you need only give the order, and I'll see everything through!
Hm. The office of the vaunted Doctor, then? Marvelous, truly. Allow me a brief moment to consult my feng shui crash-course guidebook...

I might not be alongside Rhodes Island forever, but the camaraderie we built in battle, that's something the L.G.D., my Hannya, and me will remember. My commitment to protecting Rhodes Island will never change. Doctor, when times are troubled from here on, give me a call.

Phew, arrived on time. Didn't ride all that way for nothing—I was almost speeding, actually. Anyway, Doctor, happy birthday! I brought you a special pre—uh, where's my bag? I didn't drop it on the way, did I...? Ah, shoot. Doctor, how about I bring you the present next time, and I'll treat you to some food for today?
Hey, Doctor.

Happy New Year, Doctor. Seeing as both you and I have the day off from official business, how about we head out and shake ourselves off? Want to ride on my bike and catch the breeze, or maybe let's find some place to drink? It's your call. Oh, but, hehe, can't do both. Never drink and drive.
Doctor, you should take a load off now that we finally got a break.
With my size... it's kind of hard to get through the door.
Fall back, now! I'll bring up the rear!
Are you hurt? I'm sorry. I failed.
Hurting my friends right in front of me? I'll make you pay!
The harder the journey, the stronger you'll become.
Hannya, unleash the rage your father poured into you!
Seeing is believing.
If you want to hurt my friends, you have to go through my shield first.
Hannya will crush you.
Not one step forwards.
Not one step backwards.
Yes, Sir.
If you've got a reason to fight, you've got a reason to die!
I want everyone to get home safe.
Protecting Rhodes Island is my responsibility too.
I will protect everyone.
No one tells me where I'm going, and no one can stop me once I make up my mind. And now—I've made up my mind to follow you, Doctor.
I'm honored.
It's all thanks to your teaching, Doctor.
Hoshiguma, Defender Operator. I'll be your shield, your blade, your fortress. Very glad to meet you, Doctor.
Hm? Heh. Nothing. Just guarding you, Doctor.
How about another shot...? Oh, you've had enough? Don't sweat it... I can carry you back to your room if you pass out. What? That worries you even more? C'mon, don't be a buzzkill.

Hannya's tasted plenty of Lungmen gangster blood. I never thought it'd win me many friends, but the ones who looked down on me started showing me some respect after all that had happened. Or maybe they're just scared of how big I am? What do you think?

This shield has a name: Hannya. I brought it from my hometown. Its 'father' and mine were old friends. Back in the L.G.D., my superiors would always tease me about it, but together we've proven that a shield makes a great weapon, and so do I.
I used to only get called in for the nastiest fights, but now every fight is a nasty one.
Rhodes Island needs more than just combat Operators. You need experts in education, PR, and all kinds of stuff.
I sound cold when I talk? I'm on the clock. I'm a lot less serious when I'm off.
If something happens, don't forget to use the emergency communication channel. Just call me and I'll come running.
Lots of new recruits lately, many new faces. Don't let your guard down.
Relax, Doctor. I'll keep you safe.

I'm still learning to use my gun, so I'm not touching Chi Xiao for a while. The more refined my swordplay becomes, the more I think it's not the weapon itself that defines right or wrong, but the one who wields it. So, are the moves I've made right or wrong? Do they have any meaning?

This party gets more and more impressive by the year. Last time I came, you didn't have a present pile like this. Maybe I should just keep your present for myself... Just kidding, here, take it, don't get it all mixed up with the others.
Doctor, you seem well.
A New Year's party? I'll be there. Hoshiguma and Swire are both here, and that's special. By the way, Swire told me she brought snacks from Lungmen, you and Amiya should try some.
Doctor, do you have a field operation next? I'll come with you.
You never learn, do you, Doctor?
Hm? Another new room? Engineering's at it for sure.
Stay calm and fall back! I'll bring up the rear!
Help the wounded, and if you got any strength left, I need a few of you to stand guard with me.
That was some beautiful teamwork. Great work, everyone.
Pure evil and a little torment is nothing to be afraid of. But there's never anything pure there, that's what's terrifying.
Time is limited.
Laying suppressive fire!
Don't let them get away!
Great spot.
I will take care of this place.
Ch'en here. Ready at a moment's notice.
Enemy spotted.
Are you all ready? Let's go, then!
Buck up and get ready for battle!
No need to fret. I'll take care of it all.
Orders received.
To tell you the truth, I never thought my shooting would get to this level. I'm more used to fighting with a sword, but shooting is indeed more convenient in certain scenarios.
You're giving me a promotion as a Sniper operator? No problem. I'm sure I can set a fine example.
There is always someone out there who's better than us.

Ch'en, reporting back in from my holiday in Dossoles. I have a lot of reports to write about my trip, so I'm just passing by to say hello, Doctor. Let me know if you've got something. Now that the holiday's over, everything's back to normal.
Asleep again... You've done a lot of work already, so I'll let you have ten minutes.
The events in Chernobog and my experiences in Dossoles both proved one thing—Whether fighting or saving, I must first understand my target. I need to broaden my horizons and open my eyes, Doctor.
I've got a lot of people relying on me, and I used to take that trust for granted. It may be harder than ten sets of advanced training every day, but I'll be worthy of their trust.

Doctor, it's been a while since I left Lungmen and came on board as a Rhodes Island operator. It's about time you treat me as an operator too. It's hard for me to do anything if you are always on your toes around me.
When I left Lungmen, I thought there was an answer to find, but now I get it. There's no such thing as answers, only actions and results.
My roots are in Lungmen. That will never change. The world I knew there will stay with me wheresoever I go.
I heard from Amiya what you went through in Siesta. Sounds like you had a tough holiday. What about me? It was terrible. Maybe not terrible. That's all I can say.
The way operators are supposed to see things and deal with problems is nothing I've known before. It'll take some time to get used to this.
I won't doubt Rhodes Island anymore. Your cause, Amiya and Dr. Kal'tsit, and all the other operators here are worthy of my respect.
You're not the type to sit around the office. It's easier to guard you if I dress more casually.

I left Lungmen in search of something. Something that I can only find on my own... But you Rhodes Islanders, you have the strength to win people over with your ideals, and I hope you won't let me down. Me? I'm not there yet, I need to be faster.
Here I am, what do you need…? Your birthday? You have time for stuff like this? What are you waiting for, am I supposed to sing for you? In your dreams… Happy birthday, I'm leaving.
Oh, it's you, Doctor.

Doctor, about that last report—You're still working? That's unexpected. With all the commotion out there, I thought I'd open the door to find a room full of celebrating operators. Happy new year, and here's a printout of the report—
Doctor, you're in a good mood. Is it because that operation went well? Same here.
Hey! What are you doing!
So this is Rhodes Island's base? Bigger than I expected.
Tactical retreat. Don't break formation!
The wounded wait here for a medivac. The rest of you, stay on guard.
Where did you find the courage to challenge me?
Your evil must be stopped. I will do so by any means necessary.
Don't force my hand!
Take them out fast.
Moving out!
This is Ch'en.
Ready? Stick to the plan.
Everyone! Prepare for battle!
Listen up! We'll be much more efficient if we work together.
No problem.
Roger. Just give me all the missions your usual Operators can't handle.
A promotion? I've been through these things before.
It's all in the service of more efficient operations.

Ch'en. Leader of the L.G.D.'s Special Inspection Unit. For my own reasons, I'll be joining you for a while. Seeing as we're already well acquainted from our prior work together, I'll ask you to take me to my workplace now.
Doctor? You fell asleep? Hmph. No nerves to keep you awake, then.
I've... I've never been able to rely much on anyone, not even...
Amiya trusts you completely. When I see you two together, it makes me wonder... what if I had someone like that by my side?
Maybe one day that man will take note of my efforts, but until then…
Things around here have deteriorated lately. I'll be on guard, but I'll still need you to be careful.
I know every nook and cranny in Lungmen. The docks, the neon signs, the winding paths, I can see them all in my mind, clear as day. I'll never forget them.
Why are you staring at me? Nothing better to do?
I've always had my suspicions about Rhodes Island. Still do.
I will be your bodyguard, Doctor.

Yea, they are my writings over the walls. A fair accompaniment to your feastful merrymaking, I would tout. Why would I write, you ask? And what would be writ-worthy? Nay, it is but that the drinks flow free and spirits run high. To speak of which, your arrival is just so. I would still essay to hear from you—of much of Rhodes Island.

A birthday? Though all life and death's abundance makes but a farcical dream... Nay, should you be free at ease within, then a toast from me to you is only becoming. You may not be the old friend that lives in dreams, but that we lock eyes and converse apiece here is no misfortune to me at all.
Why, how are you, {@nickname}?

Nian can have her boisterous way. I see Dusk, for all her reticence, has brought out her scroll's creation to join the children in play. Heheh, what troublemakers they are. I will say it charms me, that we siblings tint in this human nature as we live each to our own.
What is it? Would you like a cup? You wouldn't? What a shame.
Hm? Do you need me?
Rhodes Island's interior... I'm lost as to whether I should say it's reminiscent or curious.
Victory and defeat are commonplace in war. As we have freedom to maneuver, this is not a complete loss.
Mm... things disappoint on occasion; there's no need to blame yourself too hard. Leave the rest to me.
Duly satisfying, as a cup filled to the brim. We should remain level and humble, yet... we ought to sing your praises, yes. You did well.
Another song, sublime and majestic. {@nickname}, perhaps you and I truly are as two entwined friends.
Speak as your heart wills, and be as your intoxication wishes.
When will the hate sunk beneath the battlefield disperse?
One word to address all beneath the heaven, one scope to spare none upon the earth.
The split halberd sinks in the sand, great aspirations unrecompensed.
For the marching, a warsong. For the fallen, a lament.
And thus has autumn made reckoned her arrival.
Truly evocative.
Has it come to my turn?
To gaze the fire from afar, knowing not its heat.
Plotted schemes, waged wars, crossed arms, shed blood. An eternity, unaltered and unfailing in its challenge.
To scatter the fill of a brimming cup, to share the sip for a soothed sorrow.
The river bends a thousand times, a city lone in desolation, vivid in the mind's eye.
Nian was not wrong. This farcical dream of a thousand autumns is only right to wake from.
Hm... 'General, I heed thy order,' should I say? Ha, do not take it seriously. I only suppose that if you were truly a field marshal, then I may not mind once again serving as a strategist.
Though antithetical at a glance, your nature is quite similar.
Ling, you can call me. Have my two troublemaking sisters vexed you any? Hm? You've seen me before? Ah... perhaps so, in a dream.
Clouds ranged as billows, distant-run roads withered. I, departed of the vistas, sailed a ferry in late autumn.

Last night I dreamt of you. Nay! Perhaps it's you who dreamt of me. Oh, can you not recall? A shame; it delighted me so, yet I cannot share this revelry. Delighted how? Hmm. That eight thousand years of springs, eight thousand of winters, all dreamt, were no more than a brief handful of autumns. That is all.

I am drunk? Hah... I have not yet seen the sky throw wide, moon rise, seas race, ice break, to wait true for all the world's sobriety would be but the withering of a bud, to want true for deep intoxication would be far too early still... {@nickname}, now, why do you say I am drunk?

{@nickname}, would you want for me to compose you a verse? Hm? Nay, I'm simply in the mood. I need not write it, nor record it. Ah, wait, if it were a song... that would be quite good too! But to dance a song, I fear I would need some preparation. Good! You sit there, and await me a short while.

Nian is too impetuous, Dusk timid, yet to see the two as they are now, it seems they already know what they like, and want to do. So why probe at veracity or falsity or object or subject? To bicker and squabble every day, knowing emotion's gamut, is that not what a person is?

Poetry, speech, lyric, essay. Though they all differ as their own, they are common in places. A pity the people of now are, by and large unable to exercise patience. To listen to a song, to read a poem. I take no objection to it, but how must our present scholars suffer.

Where the heart is as will, and its utterance is as verse. If wells your chest with depths manifold, wouldn't failing their writing be shame to meet yourself? Hm? My tail? Ah, so too do I make use of a common brush, naturally. But it is at times inconvenient, as an extremity would be. My body is an unfettered one; who says I can't use my tail?

I was of the mind I would finally meet someone past, an old friend. Never did I think this is how you now present yourself. From knowing not one is one, isn't this like a dream? However, {@nickname}. It is fine to be as yourself. Long have I contended with myself; myself I shall prefer to act.

Yea, when Yan scholars speak of Sui, that is us, and It too. Facts hardly worth covering up; Nian's worries are not mine. After all, I am only me, and my death, no more than death is. The only shames would be this wine and world, for at day's end I love them long.
Evocative so. Years and an age ago, the very palace rained and drizzled in the whisperers of consultants.

I keep saying, don't bring me out for nothing. You want to celebrate together? Celebrate what, me being trapped here this long? Get out, get out, honestly... No, the decorations on the wall were me scrawling randomly, and I didn't draw them just because Closure asked me to. Once again, I don't take commissions.

What? You wanted me to celebrate your birthday? Don't think I came all the way out here just for that, I'm only getting some fresh air and happened to run into you. Oh, and here, a painting I messed up and stopped caring about, so now it's yours. What did I draw? Why don't you go look in a mirror and compare.
What was your name again? Oh, {@nickname}?

The New Year? A human's life is brief enough as it is. It's like partitioning a tiny dot on a scroll, thinking what to draw here, what to draw there, coming and going full circle, living and dying in exhaustion. But whatever. A moment of laughing and feasting is valid enough, I suppose.
Hey, don't get paint everywhere.
You'll spill my ink!
Do not bother preparing the room for me. I will handle it myself.
Slipped on a stroke? Start over.
Hm... a failed painting must be destroyed. It will bring shame.
Once, painting and war were quite different. But with this power, battle is art.
I am rather attached to you. Most of the time.
Copy the infinite with the tangible, bring the intangible to life!
With the setting of the sun, the brush draws up the peaks!
Too difficult to explain, let me paint it for you.
This battlefield would do well with a splash of ink.
Would any of you like to be my paint?
Better leave the fine brush at home.
Don't go too far.
I'm in a good mood today. I'll give you this one I've titled 'Bones on the Sand'.
Let's get this over with.
Captain? What does a captain do?
Don't keep me too long.

Ahh, to make it this far with me... I should paint you a scroll. But be careful! Do not get caught up within it. The world I paint is much more fascinating than this one. How many have been lost, since ancient times? How many have escaped?
Why use a sword? There is a reason. 'With an inkstone sheath, one may learn the annals. With a brush sword, one may paint the celestial.' Is it true? Naturally, I speak off the cuff.
Hm? A swing of an axe becomes rivers of blood. Do you mean... you want me to paint this?

Oh? {@nickname}? Another contract? Very well, please don't bother me again after I sign this one. Here... I should tell you here and now: I, Dusk, do not give out my paintings. Not to anyone. And I don't take commissions!
Dreams are like unto life, like unto the scroll. One sleeps this sleep, will one sleep for millennia?

Take a look at Nian's carefree expression. You know the truth, don't you? She cares quite a bit about our lives, and our deaths. As for me? I may not get along with the wretched scribbler, but neither of us care much. When people die, the paintings remain. When I die, my work remains.

Food? Oh, thank you. Hm, where does this drink come from? It's good. Quite good. But I feel like it's missing something. You want to know what I usually eat? Then close your eyes. Ah~ You feel nothing, yes? That's because if you don't look, the food in my paintings does not exist.

I took the time to partake of some contemporary works. Films are not bad, they are like paintings. The good ones all have a unique strength of character, with form, and with decent meaning. Right, poetry and painting have a legacy. Do you have time to help me burn Nian's mountain of garbage? She is denigrating the very concept of cinema. Please.

An opportunity to watch me paint in earnest comes but once in a lifetime to one in ten thousand individuals. 'When the time comes, the strength of heaven and earth are one.' Ch'i, bone, shape, color, method, pouring out as a vast river, fine like the shadow of mountain bamboo, such is my brush, and it will not stop.

I loathe the word 'taste.' What gives these people the confidence to demand something good just as they open their mouths to lock the gates to others? It is unbecoming. If you are satisfied, you are satisfied. Should you enter, you must not bar the gate. Do you see the twin moons thinking only of themselves?

I'm not going out. Don't try to make me go out, I don't want to go out. I no longer care for the world outside. Do I dislike it? I like it fine. The mountains and rivers, the flowers and feathers, the pools and forests, the common folk, young and old, I could paint forever, I could watch forever, and yet, I will not go. It does not hold my interest forever.

Haa… I'm trapped on this ship. If anyone asks, you tell them so, and you do not let them into my room. I'm taking up space? I'm refusing to perform my operator duties? Hello, I am Dusk, the great painter trapped in this room.

You want to see my painting? You may. For you, I could even give you the painting. But if you like it, I won't give it to you. You don't like it? Huh, then you wouldn't want it anyway. This is who I am. Deal with it.

Hm? Did I not explain that you were forbidden to enter without my express permission, after knocking? Oh? This is your office? You're working? Then have I not come out of my room to work as well? What is the meaning of 'your office'? Get out! I'm still sketching it out.

The food was bad, but a fun time was had, sort of... Well, I know they had fun, but I just couldn't enjoy myself. All I see is Rhodes Islanders putting down their weapons, and coming to munch on spice and play mahjong with me. And when the party's over, they pick those weapons right back up. It makes me think, damn, what a shame. Hey, what are you gawping at me for? C'mon, let's take a walk.

Birthdays, huh? Yeah, heard of those. You guys know where you came from, when you got here, so you like to celebrate the day. Here, this hammer's for you. Can't lift it? Hehe, of course you can't.
