I like to see people live and grow, you know. If after all these years, all we've forged is weapons, without honing our people, then the weapons are just some lumps of metal too heavy to wield.
Yo, Doctor, you had lunch yet?

Aww, yeah! Today's the day I've been waiting for! It's time to release my brand-new masterpiece! That's right. Unlimited Showdown in the Siege of Monster Doomsday. My blood and sweat went into making this one a special effects blockbuster. You're not gonna watch? Wait, wait, all of you got the day off, right? Why aren't you coming?
Hold still! I'm making you a little something for your ear. It'll look great, just don't move!
Dude! Stop it!
Mind if I do some redecorating in here?
Terrible... If I really let myself loose, things would get a whole lot nastier... for everyone involved.
Man, you sure messed up. What'd I tell you about air bubbles weakening the iron?
These small fry ain't even close to quelling my hunger.
Not bad! I see some faint promise in you!
Why do I gotta waste my precious time on the likes of you third-rate amateurs?
Even a virtuous king must, from time to time, look to the sword.
My body burns at over 1,400 degrees!
You dare strike my shield with your spear? That's gonna end with you in pieces!
Let's just get this done with.
'When 'tis a choice of life and death, why shouldst thou lay down thy arms?'
A knife, a life; weapons are the basis for society.
Oh? You want me to handle this, personally?
My sword's gonna cleave your bodies and values alike.
A smith's gotta be ready to pay the debts accrued by the weapons she forges.
Say what? Lead the team? Never led anyone before, but I guess I'll try.
Guess one thing's never gonna change with time: swords will inevitably clash.

People are like tools; you can classify 'em. And you, you're an interesting one... Or should I say 'unusual'? I could forge you a good sword, but since you ain't gonna swing it, let alone fight in the first place, it'd just be a waste of metal.
A promotion? That takes me back... I got something like this once before. Anyway, that's cool, I guess. You have my thanks!
Huh? What good do you think this stuff's gonna do me? Skills like these are only useful to people who value them.

Anybody home? Heard from one of your guys that I can make a comfy living here! Something about free lodging and food, with plenty of free time left over... Hm? This area is for staff only? Don't be like that! You make it sound like I don't belong here!
You're sleeping AGAIN? Wake up, sunshine! We're going shopping! C'mon, hurry!

Blacksmithing may just be a regular old occupation, but it was also a part of early civilization. I'll keep metallurgy well and alive, even if everything else dies out. That's the future I chose for myself long ago. And you, you've made important choices before, haven'tcha? Don't ever go back on them. Stay true to the end and see it through. That's what it means to complete something.

Your dreams turn to haze when you've lived as long as I have. But I've got better stuff to do than dream all day, and that's why l feel so alive. Sure, life is suffering, but seeing people carve something out for themselves is incredible. And as for you: think you got what it takes to be the anvil to my hammer?

If you're out of touch with reality, you'll end up crushed beneath its boot, sooner or later. You'd think that's common freakin' sense, but some of my siblings ignore reality for what it is. Their dull lives are only gonna get harder for 'em as time goes on.

Rituals get passed down from generation to generation not 'cause they have any inherent meaning, but because people find their own meaning in them. A performance has its rewards, and a wish has its fulfillment. And when one of my favorite stories is involved, you bet your ass I'm gonna participate.

I used to just focus myself on what I needed for daily life, but I'm the type to really absorb my surroundings. And somehow or other I keep getting into fights. So I guess I could say it feels weird to NOT carry a weapon around. So it goes, I guess.

Lungmen's a pretty chill place, but their cuisine? It's got no kick to it! How can they eat that flavorless baby food? Listen up: spice is a way of life. Once you taste a little pleasant pain and feel that explosion of heat on your tongue, you'll realize what you've been missing all this time.

Maaan, I'm so hungry... But as they say, gourmet food takes a gourmet cook. My brother's a great chef, you get hungry at one of our family reunions, just call him up and he'll take care of you. Now that's what I call service! Rhodes Island's food tastes like crap compared to his.

That lame look of yours is grinding my gears... Here, have a toy to lighten up. You're busy with work? Who cares about some boring-ass work? Just one thing: don't lose sight of this little doll, or it'll vanish in the blink of an eye.
Man, I'm so bored... Might just go shopping... You know what, yeah, we're doing it! Come on, put your shoes on. Yeah, we're both going out, that's why I said 'we'!
Finally, I can leave the commanding to others...
Hear the voice of justice.
Pay for your sins with your life.
Death? You've never lived.
Don't blink.
This will be a disappointing day for our foes.
You need a hand?
Ran into trouble?
Welcome. Now, please leave.
Watch your surroundings. Do not get ambushed.
I have nothing to say. But remember this one word: survive.
Give your orders. I will work with them the best I can.
Victory is yours, as always.
I will decide your ending.
It's over.
Art's free, fire at well.
Initiating sweep.
Waiting for target mark.
Awaiting coordinates.
Operation is a go. Keep your support countersign in mind.
Move up and stay frosty.
Attention casters: set comms to operation channel.
Handoff complete. Awaiting orders.
It's always reassuring to carry out your orders, Doctor.
I can handle this on my own.
It'll be fine.
I trust your judgment.
I prefer to keep my fight quiet.
Know your jobs? Then let's do this.
Read the briefing? Good, now here's your assignments.
Your commands were my thoughts as well, Doctor.
No more suffering, no more pain.
We make our own luck.
War is a plague, and I'm the cure.
Relight the spark of life.
Initiating medical treatment.
Originium Arts ready.
Orders received. Initiating field command.
Stand by for action.
Aggression is all part of the plan. Returning to base.
I've got a clear shot on target.
This surge of energy has only one place to go.
Don't worry, you won't escape the storm.
Don't disappoint me.
Leave this area to me.
I know the difference between sparring and a real fight.
On your mark.
The enemy's moving as expected. Brace yourselves.
Target confirmed.
Alright, squad, keep your status updated.

What exactly are angels? And why am I on a quest for them? Why do I play music? People love asking me questions, but they hate complicated answers. So, on this beautiful day, I've decided to give them the same simple answer—it's all for apple pie!
Cyan, it's actually your birthday today! Look, I got the apple pies and cider here all ready! Don't give me those eyes, hey—what's wrong with taking the chance to indulge a little? Happy birthday!
Cyan, here's an apple, catch!

Wow, so lively. You can watch the magic show if you want, Cyan. I'll join you in a bit. It's a sacred day for me, so my lyre's music has to linger on the wind a little. Leaves, lakes, and light! Oh—save me a glass of cider though!
Yo! Yet another perfect day for an adventure!
Woah! I just styled my hair, you know! Don't chew it off!
Not a bad spot to practice my lyre.
Run, Cyan! Oh, take my lyre with you! It's worth more than my life!
Our client's still plenty happy, heheh. Cyan, let's go wrap things up and grab some grub!
A perfect curtain drop! Cyan, got that ad-libbed victory hymn written down yet?
I was glowing? Dunno, I was just strumming my lyre and saving lives!
Honey apple pie!
Music notes!
Evangelium!
Holy Oracle!
Let's recreate the legends, right here and now!
Now this is my stage!
And what bardic tale are you in the mood for today?
Let's send a little melody over to our friends!
Ssh—The breeze's brought bards a new epic. Listen carefully.
For the stories yet untold—we move!
Follow my lyre if you get lost, for I am the heraldic spearhead!
Friends, let us add a new chapter to our story!
I always feel like there's some special power in my lyre playing. What if… singing the angels' songs will turn me into one of them?! What's with the look, Cyan? A girl can dream.
Wow! What's this? A mysterious amulet that can double your luck? Or a map that'll bring us to the angels? Thanks, Cyan!
So you mean, I should use my abdominal muscles to swing my lyre…

Yo, li'l cyan. This entire city calls me a fool on a quest for the angels, and you seem to be the only soul who doesn't hate me. Guess you could call this destiny? Alright, I'm calling you Cyan from now on. Want an apple?
It's not seeing that's believing… it's because you believe… that you can see…

That King of Eternity said only stasis can resist oblivion. Heh, I don't think that's true. Let's go, Cyan, we'll tell Him—Apples, melodies, light, and flowers—are all way better than His lifeless soldiers for making everyone feel alive!

The ashen mist's on its way here. It's scary, seeing every shade of color pale along with the land turning desolate. But that's where I'm headed anyways, because the angels of legend can light up every inch of this land—you wanna come with? Alright, hold on tight, and don't fall off my scarf this time!

I probably would've melted into the dark that night, if you hadn't licked me awake. That's when I got this halo and wings too… huh? Wait, did I actually lose myself in the abyss, and you're a god who saved me? Hey, don't gnaw on my lyre! I was wrong, you're the cutest, fluffiest Cyan I know!

The dragon's snore, the elf's laughter… even the wind is no more, wonders of the land all gone from collective memory—Cyan! I was being all serious, and you're trying to sneak off with my apple collection?! Not that one, it's my precious!

Cyan, remember that quiet dragonslayer? I doodled a little flower on her sword when we left the tavern yesterday, so now she'll hear the lyre whenever she swings her blade. Nothing wrong with cutting a little loose, no matter what sort of quest you're on! What'cha looking at? She's headed our way? Let's skedaddle!

The singer opened her mouth and all the clamoring dust turned to dew, like magic! I think a farewell ode to the statue is all I could've managed with my lyre. Well, should I drag her with us on our journey?
In a swampy tavern, the flightless 'Emperor' stood atop broken bottle shards and declared: 'Paradise lost? Simply mold one from the mud!' Sheesh, that moved me more than any poem I'd ever heard.

I made a bet with that crafty merchant, the one with the shield, that neither my lyre nor my voice would hold up until I sang the angels' tale to six hundred and sixty-six people. If she wins, the lyre's hers to keep, but if I win, she'll have to travel with me—Hah, whatcha think, Cyan? How are demons so silly?
Cyan, wanna come with? The road ahead's filled with bad apples and worse people, but since you're such a fan of my lyre… just stick close to me.

I owe much to you, that by now I've more or less mulled this dream through. All that remains, remains until we meet far ahead upon Rhodes Island. Doctor, Yumen's beacons have lit again… I say that this realm deserves that we witness it with waking eyes.

Read carefully the start of each line… Heh, a fool you've been made indeed. No hidden acrostic at the head or tail, but now I've already poured your wine. A birthday is but a finer day than most to drop inebriate and dream farcical. Coupled with a fine friend and a verse of poetry, what more could one ask for?
Doctor, I think tonight's password for the sentries shall be 'hot water kettle'. What say you?

Be puzzled no longer. They're soldiers from Jiangqi. It's said they sing that song as they race rowing boats, back in their hometown. This is the one day we soldiers dare to long for home. It was only after I first saw them in Yumen that I started to dream of those siblings of mine, and felt I wanted to leave something of all this.
How did your clothes get so much ink on… Oh! Apologies, my tail must've just swept past you.
Perfect. Strip my armor for me, Doctor.
Everything in camp is plain and frugal; just put up with it as best as you can. It's funny, back in Jiangnan, I had never noticed just how beautiful the moonlight was.
The rear shall be the new front. The ranks will retreat as ordered. I bid you move with, Doctor.
You see an odd look on my face? To tell the truth, I'm reminded how the matter between 'us' and Sui can only end in total victory or total failure… A fine hassle this dream poses.
'...Dr. {@nickname}'. There. Our record of merits keeps a tally for your name now. Nay, stay, did you not see me pouring your wine out this whole time?
No matter all the battles lost and won, these mounts and rivers ever move the soul… This stream does cradle safe the sun and moons; at ease, my heart all sole fends armors cold.
All ye with killing arms, you mean to beg and pray when war descends?!
I took this edge cerulean as my brush; why cry now that vermilion does it write?
The drums' third movement deadens. Mists and all begone, the night is cold.
My wine is in its cup, my scabbard holds its sword. So water not my mood.
In snow sleeps blades and bows, all horns gone mute. How desolate the sight!
The Heart sinks south in deep Lunar July; sets baleful low the autumn chills.
Bid I take it 'pon myself to seize the general's head.
To fell them, fell their strategy. I am, of course, prepared.
The sands stretch flat. Their beacons burn far.
Now the day's hue gloams. How the clouds burn bright!
When I speak thus, the ranks pay heed.
Your junior general abides by her orders.

You cannot hold your drink, and yet maintaining sobriety is your strength. It seems you, too, have much you can only do in dreams. So be it. Assist me, and in those future days when we are formally met on Rhodes Island, I will assist you all I can in turn.

Do you regard me as a tactician, or a general? Heh, Yumen has seen fit to drill me in all duties military ever since I came. There is naught in army affairs too great or small, and naught to be lazy about.
Turn that off. Listen. The military forbids wine. Therefore, you did not see what you just saw.
Even the great desert's winds cannot blow their way into Yumen, let alone your likes… Doctor, pray sit. Our time is little. Together, we are to create a farcical dream.
Let wind rise, brilliant in sharp anonymity. Let rain fall, tassels soaked within. And thus let the might of wine cleanse my heart.

Fail? And would the soldiers outside the tent flee in the face of a possible defeat? As humans have life and death, so the calendric Sui has spring and autumn. I take in sole the mantle of 'unfettered', and should I fail, then same as the sea washes and the ice melts, I shall never wake again, and that is that. Pray accompany me, Doctor, till this dream like no other is complete.

Have you decided, then? Within the dream, shall you be a speaking stone, or a water kettle of brew? With a dash of inebriation and a stroke of poetic spirit, one easily encompasses all the realm manifest. Ask yourself, Doctor, how could I ever mistake you?

It has snown in Yumen—the winds of spring a thousand li afar, pear trees through all the city blooming full. I could well sleep for six millennia here and now. Oh, this sight deserves a place in the dream—I'll write of it on these city walls with my tail, lest I forget. Hmm. And Doctor, take note of where this wall is for me.

I seem an old friend, you say? Were you once an enemy or ally of Sui? If you are curious too of the answer, then assist me. When the time comes, I may return to the primordial chaos, for in the dream must exist at least one beyond Its effects. *yawn* I bid thee now unto my dream, to play the elements in song…

Still Jie compiles her tome, and Yu is yet young… Our eldest brother frets so, and the basket of blunders has his own plots abrew, all in which I'm loath to interfere; thus am I trying my own ways. Oh! Say, what of the bickering couple? Come the dream, should we have Dusk painting in a hotpot restaurant's employ, and Nian serving as her underling? Good, nay?

Hurry now, lest we miss the morning roll call. Nay, nor could I stand all this regiment at first. But while our eldest brother exhorts I come to Yumen, still I stall. Stay a moment and you'll see why—for how heaven lights this sea of sand! We shall rue it if we miss it!

Seize it not! I don't mean to derelict my duty. Nay, you see, dreams are as this wine jar. Should I seek inebriation, its contents will never run dry—and this holds whether Sui wakes or not. In here, there is no hint of veracity or falsity, no fetter on one's ultimate freedom. Such is the highlight of dreams. Perhaps by this method, we can save 'us'.

Just who I wished to see; you fill the hole in this dream that stymied me. Yes, long will it be until we are met upon Rhodes Island, but this moment is no false one. Such is poetry's power, and wine's too. Pray, Doctor, serenade me, and be inebriated with me.

Which watch of the night are we in? Doctor, light my lantern. This sword, and these scrolls of verse… If we are to weave such a dream that even It cannot disturb, then the roads are profuse, the clouds are myriad, and we must take our time as we cast our eye.

When I look back on these memories, I realize just how tiny the seeds of those dreams are. Are you the same? Rhodes Island will head towards the future we all hope for, and this time, I will be there with you. Always.

Actually, you could've had all that makes up the universe. Heat, light, gravity, space, and the very order of existence. Would you hate me, if we didn't return to our original end? Even so… please accept my gift, whether you possess everything, or nothing at all.
Done with your break and ready to press on…? Doctor, if you were here, that's what I'd say to you. If you were still here.

The longer one lives, the shorter a year feels. The past grows, while the present shrinks—that's how it is. But truth be told, we're all easily deceived. Today will be the best year ever—will you trust me on this?
Actually, I remember the touch of your hands, but you've forgotten mine, haven't you?
I'm not sleeping. So you won't be able to wake me up.
If I stray too far, I'll… hm, I won't. I already know this whole place, after all.
As long as we still live, there's a chance.

Total victory does not exist. Trading space for time, retreating to drag on the assault, bleeding dry the western front to gain an inch in the east… Even Theresa began to calculate everything before her as battlefield resources, until… No, total victory does not exist, for every life has worth.
Someone must have considered what comes after victory. But, as Theresa set down her scissors, she did not yet realize who would take the crown.
After that, the flags of the coalition army retreated like a deluge, revealing the ravaged Kazdel to the sun. Just how many died in that flood? But we knew that day, nothing could have sunk our city.
What did you expect to extract from Kazdel?
You… are the ones who do not belong.
Laqeramaline, I will silence them. Outsiders will no longer disturb your songs with their music.
Theresis, kill them. Intruders have no right to brandish their blades here.
No more retreating. I'll stay here while you… contact Bertha.
Capture the high ground ahead. We need the Gargoyles to repair the fort.
The vampires are on their way? Very well, I'll hold the line here.
Is this the Patriarch's transfer order? Understood.
We have no other choice but to go against them. It's fine, we'll find our chance.
News of reinforcements? How's the Goliath doing on his end?
Well then, be sure to follow my commands.
I know. We can't rest just yet.
These precious, pleasant memories… the more I see, the more I feel a sort of emotion. I think it's called 'grief'. I'm grieving for… her.

If this is simply a journey through memory, it should be a delightful one… the hardest, strongest, and brightest threads are always tied to hope, trust, and love. I understand her wish. Of course I do.
Close-combat fights on the battlefield are a rare sight, despite having walked corridors built by war. Of course, she had no desire to engrave those onto her memories.

These Deep Dive records belong only to me. They are distant to you, and that includes the you from 'before'. This is a story from two centuries ago, the past of a Theresa from Terra. Yet, if one were to imagine a travel companion…

One time, I stayed awake for sixty hours straight, and Laqeramaline sang a lullaby to compel me to sleep… that was the first time I heard a Banshee sing something that wasn't an elegy, even if I only got to hear a verse and a half before I drifted off…

Theresis was never the type to smile. I'd poke his forehead so many times, but he never wavered. Though… on our day of victory, when we thought it was all over, when we could finally go home, I saw a smile on his face. The very next moment, that tiny crown hovered between us.

I've kept this secret for so long… When the guards changed shifts, my mentor's cloth got caught on the horn of a Caprinae, causing him to trip and fall. I didn't laugh. Really. Well… Until I told Amiya about it. She'd find out eventually, after all.

Bertha wasn't young anymore then, and my mentor didn't think she'd return. She smiled as she said it didn't matter if she died in Kazdel, for her sharp-tongued disciple had no way out. We laughed over many jokes together, but this is the only one I dislike…

When Kal'tsit was born anew from the 'cocoon', I hesitated for a moment. But the look in her eyes was familiar. After wearing the black crown, I would occasionally see my… I thought, perhaps we didn't have to become enemies. I'm glad I considered the notion.

We took the only opportunity we had. Kal'tsit did not originally plan to kill Yliš, she merely wanted to strip the black crown from the Sarkaz, but the 'Feeble King' still had a plan to thwart hers, and thus the war dragged on… until Theresis brandished his blade.

Only when the Goliath rushed out of the city gates that day and beheaded a Gaulish officer did we finally breathe easy. He brought back a Gaulish coat, but only handed me a piece of candy from its pocket, asking that I give it to a wounded soldier… But I couldn't do it, and I couldn't bring myself to tell him why.

Defending one's land turns a clothesmaker into a hero, and a hero into a King of Sarkaz... yes, this is where it all began: Theresis thumped on the door, and Theresa set down her scissors. Only when the door opened that evening, did she realize the heavy rain outside.

It's strange to perform a Deep Dive into Theresa's memory. It has lived within me since my beginning, but when I search these memories… I feel like a mere reader. It's very strange… I won't show you these Deep Dive records, Doctor.

A palace of memory, its structure more elaborate than a Leithanian instrument, its contents more incoherent than revenant rambling. Supporting this palace is perhaps as simple as enjoying a spoonful of soup—well, I'd say it is woven of thread rather than built of brick…

A single ark, along with the fate of millions, haha. Same little ambition as always. Though, I truly can't imagine what exactly you'll destroy and leave behind… I expect you to reward me with that pleasant surprise, Boss.

I get it, a wish you've pondered a thousand times, when spoken aloud on your birthday, will double the chances of coming true—ohi, my wolves and I are right before you, so why are you still making your wish with your eyes closed?
Friendly reminder—you're running out of time to boss me around.

Here, a vodka martini with five olives. Don't worry, just sample your employee's craft. Bravo. One more shot, and tell me all about your grand master plan to save or destroy Terra—this will be my New Year's gift to you.
Zaaro, bite down on the Boss's head. I want to see what's inside.
Olives for you? Yes, I've changed the specials again.
So this is the decor you're planning to draw crowds with?
When will a new Boss come…? Zaaro, why isn't this one gone yet?
Is this what you wanted? You know the price of boring me, don't you, Boss?
Not bad. I haven't seen the wolfpack so enthusiastic in a long while.
All drinks on the house.
It's happy hour!
Bartender's Choice—'Custom-made Quagmire'.
Enjoy—'Barrenlands' Special Brew'.
Here you go—a 'Civilizzato Classico'.
What a bore… Zaaro, Caesar. Sweep the place, quickly.
Interesting! Agnese, Vargo. Don't get in my way.
Haha, was that a yawn from me?
Ohi, Zaaro! Patience!
You want some ice to chew on? Keeps the pain away, and keeps you awake.
Earlier opening hours? You're the Boss.
I'm still waiting for you to tell me what 'order' means.
Ohi, Vargo. Get our thirsty Boss and me a couple shots of whiskey to wet our whistles.
My gratitude, Boss. You've instilled a passion in us for our work—for now, at least.
Congratulations! The wolfpack and I have not lost patience with you, for now.
There is nothing new under the twin moons.
Haha, keep your hood on. You're the Boss of this bar now. Lappland and her merry pack of wolves, at your service.
Still undecided? Haha, just a friendly reminder: The ice's melted—it's rude to keep a bartender and her drinks waiting.

An ice cube? Open your eyes, Boss. That's a roccia in your glass. Do you want to see its creator, your old friend? In this bar, you can do it all. Of course I know the thing, and of course I can do it. For the low price of… suffering? Haha, I'd be glad to oblige!

Yes, the Cyclops in the recording was a Boss once. He tried using the 'tragic future' glimpsed through his foresight to change my rules, but what a pity—just five minutes before his shift ended, he threw up blood and died… Oh, you're an expert in this field too, no?

Done thinking, O savior of ours? Will you share a bottle with the Church of the Deep and the Yurodstvo, or perhaps consult the revenants on how to make Rhodes Island soar past the starpod? Haha, feel free to go wild—give yourself, and your employees, a challenge!

I said before I want you to be my enemy, but this doesn't stop me from realizing your wishes. Texas is no stranger to this either. This bar will be a valve for the swamp. You can decide to turn it off, or let the mud flow. Isn't this much more interesting than being boring old enemies?

Of course I like the bar. Without it, where would I find the inspiration for new games to play? It's lawless? Hmph, Agnese, why don't you tell our good Boss, how we've been waiting every day for the police to knock on our door with an arrest warrant? It can't be helped, we get either baddies, or poor things like you.

Done for the day! The place is yours now, I trust you have the time and space to tinker with your 'secrets'. Call it the Boss's privilege. Zaaro, is the car still not ready? Ssh—a word of advice: Don't ask where your employees go after work.

Try it. It's a 'Demon Sunrise', brought here by your predecessor, a refugee Snowpriest from Sami. Good stuff, no? I know you won't disappoint us—even if the wolves tear you to shreds, your legacy will only grow.
An unlicensed bar, an omnipotent bartender, and one simple rule: You're the Boss today, free to dominate all that you see. Haha, put all your embarrassing desires onto the wine list.
Ohi, Zaaro, still not done washing those glasses? Enough cracking the ice cubes, Caesar… Keep your hats on tight and ears perked up—we have to hear the new Boss's stirring speech before we open.

After everything we've been through, you're still thinking about that landship? If Her Highness and the little bunny were still around, what would they be thinking about? Hmph, of course I remember what day it is today. Today's a good day, whether you're keen to throw your life away or to put an end to everything. Get ready, Doctor, we're heading out.

Once this is all over and we're back at Rhodes Island, you can make yourself a giant birthday cake, and everyone'll be there to cheer for you. I'll cheer too, and ease up on the sarcasm, just so you can enjoy a proper happy birthday. How's that, managed to claw back a bit of yourself? Huh? Sing you the birthday song? Drop dead.
We didn't die today. Makes it a pretty good day, I'd say.

If you hadn't mentioned what day it was today, I'd've forgotten what it was like to celebrate a holiday. Take this, a shell-case flick, my treat. Get mad, then go give those rocks over there a treat of their own. Haha, it's settled then. Hey! A Happy New Year to you, my Originium friends! Bang!
Well, it's down to the two of us again. Am I still thinking about killing you? Hah! Good to know you haven't lost your sense of humor.
Still as curious as ever, I see, even out here.
Damn, how's this space station manage to be even bigger than stupid Rhodes Island? Ughhh.
Congrats. You win, probably. But you're about to see me really go wild.
Hmph, whenever I remember these monsters are just a bunch of shitty rocks, I can't find the energy.

Hmph, that's how we do it, and that's how we're gonna keep doing it until this stupid never-ending Originium's all bombed to bits! Then, I'm gonna go home and get some sleep for once! Home... Hah, gonna have to rebuild Kazdel.

The further we go, the quieter you get. I know, I know, you've got other ideas about the out-of-control Originium she left behind. I'm just wondering... She hurt you so bad you ended up like this. Is she really worth it?
Too bad, so sad. Not even ashes left.
C'mon, let's see what tricks you jackasses kept up your sleeves.
Look at you all. Destroyed half the world, but you never figured out how to beat me.
Get yelling, Doctor. Your friends are waiting~
I'll carve my name onto every little bit of Originium out there.
I'll make you shriek so loud the stars'll hear you.
The bad news is, we both might just die here with them.
The good news is, today, they're all gonna die here.
If they're making my life difficult, I'll make theirs twice as hard. It's always been that simple.
Hello, space~ Housekeeping here~ Ready to clean~
Who we're killing, that's up to me. How we're killing them, I'm open to suggestions.
Now where should I clean today~

Look at all the assholes we buried along the way. You won't find a more legendary Sarkaz mercenary than me in all of Terra. How are you gonna honor me? Oh, You'll remember me after I die? Hah, you better walk the walk, then.
Alright, as the Speaker of Kazdel, I hereby dub thee 'Destroyer of the World'! Don't like it? Then once you've fixed your mess, I'll give you a new title. How's 'Betrayer of the World' sound?
Doctor, if you keep mumbling battle plans in my ears, I'm gonna toss you out the airlock.

We're finally here, Doctor. Is this ship floating out in space supposed to be an old haunt of yours? What, feeling anxious? Well too bad, you don't have a choice. 'Wiš'adel', here to destroy your Originium project now that it's running wild.
This area all clear? Ahh... I think I'm gonna find someplace to take a nap.

Surface signals are gone, and our way out's cut off. In other words, whatever comes next, I'll be facing it down with you. Can't think of anything scarier than that. I'm gonna have to take a page out of Hoederer's book and write a memoir of my own. I'll call it: The Two Crises of Terra: Originium and the Doctor.

That little bunny gave me this bottle of nail polish before it all went down, said the color really suited me... Never thought I'd be reduced to sharing a sob story like that with you. What a tragic life I lead. But, whichever way you look at it, you're still alive, and chatting with you's much better than chatting with a bunch of tombstones.

Stop grumbling, Doctor. It wasn't my idea to turn you into a soul and stuff you into a gun. By the time I got there, you were the only one left alive, and only barely. It's cramped in there? Well, be a good little cannon, and once we take back the ship, I'll move you into something a little roomier. How's that sound?

You killed the most important person in my life, and now, it's my turn to go kill yours. That'll make us even. What, thought I was gonna say something nice? You'll have to forgive me, all the nice girls are dead. You mad? Good. That's the only thing keeping us alive.

Hey, why're you easing up on the firepower over there? Elite operators? Ugh, she really knows how to twist the knife. What, want me to give you some time for a high-five sesh with your old pals? Hmph, not like you even have hands. If you lose your nerve, oh right, no nerves left, how about—You'll do it yourself? Y'know, once we're done here, it wouldn't be so bad to let you yap for a bit.

Are those... Feranmuts? Huh, never thought I'd see a live one. If Hoederer was here, he'd definitely take the chance to babble on and on and on about them, then Ines would tell him to stop giving useless lectures with that sharp tongue of hers... Hmph. Give me a sec, will you? I'm gonna kill one, give you the chance to duke it out down below.

Steam Knights, Royal Guards, Spire Casters? Originium sure is something, able to copy all those losers. Hah, right on cue. Hey, you old fossils, weren't you screaming about vengeance all those years you were stuck in the Furnace? Well, here's your chance. Don't tell me you were all just talking shit.

Oh? From up here, you can see Terra really is round. Look, Originium's almost covered the whole thing. Wow, how lucky are we? We won't have to worry about running out of it. Not gonna marvel at your masterpiece, Doctor? C'mon, cheer up, at least we still have time to do something about it.
Oh, Doctor, your old flame really was no good at housekeeping. Look at all this 'trash' she left behind. I'm in a good mood today, so I'll clean up after her.

Rhodes Island rarely enjoys auspicious celebrations like these. A certain motion picture says, you should treat every day like the holidays. Before we can love our ideals, we must first love our own lifestyles. Which reminds me, Doctor, if you have time today, why don't we take in a matinee together? Or perhaps you'd prefer to spar outside?

Doctor, happy birthday. This, is a film print from a picture I was in. It's not worth much, but it's a treasured memory to me. You want to watch it now? I suppose I could borrow Nian's equipment… No matter. You're the star of the show today.
Doctor, you're early today. Don't forget to eat breakfast before you start work.

That's another year in the books. How time flies may feel somewhat woeful. But this is a new beginning, so we should be cheerful. What I am holding, you ask? I learned how to use a camcorder recently, so I'm filming whatever catches my fancy. See the fireworks? How beautiful they are.
Doctor, perfect timing. Come help me rehearse. Oh, just the lines, no kung fu necessary.
Doctor, this costume and makeup took three hours to finish.
Is that a wrap for today? Better check and see if you have left anything behind.
Life will knock us down, but we can choose, whether or not, to get back up.
If it is a masterpiece you want, you must seek perfection in every detail. Let's try this once more.
I hope the masses will remember these scenes on the silver screen, even after many years have passed.
You say it's over? No! It's NOT over! The real culprit is still hiding in the shadows. How can you say it's—O-Oh, sorry, the filming of this shot is indeed over.
Give it up. The whole building is surrounded by cops.
Something you just don't get. Some things are priceless.
Freeze! You're under arrest, but you have the right to remain silent.
Let the spar begin!
You take the credit. I take the blame!
I know what I'm doing. Don't stop me.
Always do the right thing, and stop the people who don't.
That's why I like being a cop. Because I think all human life is important.
I hope next time when we meet, we won't be fighting each other. Instead we will be drinking tea together.
Eenie meenie miney mo, that's the way I got to go!
You want me to be the director? I dare say I have a little experience.
Before the camera, one must embody one's character.
Seeing the audience enjoying the picture fills me with that very same joy. Thank you, thank you very much.
What? A Best Actor nomination? Uh no no no, as an actor, I am well aware that I still have a long way to go. Best Newcomer Award? That I can try to work toward.
I can feel that each frame of action in this one is a product of tremendous human effort.
Actors to their marks—Doctor, are you here for a visit? You want to help? Alright, hold this clapperboard. Now, stand a little closer to the camera. Yes, that's the right place. 3, 2, 1. Action!
Ah… Look at that cloud in the distance. It's beautiful. Director, let's get an empty shot of it.

I am both myself and a character in a story. Now I have left a fictional story, yet how do I know I'm not already in another, real story? If I hadn't come to shoot this picture, I may never have gotten the chance to experience a different life. All this is indeed very interesting. Would I like to try it again? Hmm... It would take much preparation for me to do so.

Nian, since we are shooting a picture, we must consider the influence it will have. No amount of drink will improve your kung fu, and you need not rely on violence in your struggle for justice. If everyone simply imitates—I can choreograph my own moves for the fights? Ahem-hem, Ling, I'll borrow this wine flask. You may have it back once the shoot is over.

And all of you hiding in a gloomy place like this! Why debase yourselves? Don't you know you're the scum of society?! Um, Director, I think as a policeman, our hero should reason with the lost young men, BEFORE engaging in physical combat with them... Ah? Talk sense into them as we fight? Very well, I'll try.

If you want your picture to be exciting, you must pour your heart and soul into creating it. If it's perfection that you seek, you must find a way through trial and error. All this blood and sweat, to turn a brief dream into one that lasts an eternity... Those who walk this path, are truly worthy of admiration and respect.

The fights in the movies are nothing like real combat. You must consider whether your position fits the shot composition, and whether your moves feel original. It's not just simple poses. It's a science, and I must learn everything anew. I should use my tail here? Hmm... Alright, let's try it again.

While we risk our lives out there, you're sitting back thinking of dinner. We fight criminals day and night, and all you ever think about is how to spiff up your reports. You got promoted at our expense. Have you ever thought of us? Oh, I'm merely rehearsing my lines. Haha. General Zuo is certainly nothing like this. He is a fine and upstanding man.

Let me see... I'm an L.G.D. officer, part of a special task force looking for artifacts. During a hostage rescue mission, I end up losing my memory when my superior betrays me, and in the end I battle a feranmut in the wilderness... Err... Nian, this is a little overwrought, don't you think? Fine, Director.

Doctor, I'm here to serve as stunt coordinator for Nian's motion picture. The actors here have never been trained in kung fu, but you will find that their diligent rehearsal is no less impressive or touching. What? The male lead is injured? Ai-ya... what should we do...? Ah? You want me to take the role?

Are you interested in this continuity log, Doctor? We film our shots in a shuffled order, different from how they appear in the final product. So if we lose this log, the editor will be in trouble. Uh... actually, I'm looking for a page that went missing... Could you help me check the back of that prop box? I think it may be hiding there.

Doctor, the possibilities that Fede and I perceive differ entirely, but the constant is that you remain here at Rhodes Island. If you are the single leitmotif that remains unchanged across countless variations... how could I bear to stray too far from you?

Doctor... did you already listen to the entire piece behind my back? Though it was but an impromptu session, it contained all the thoughts I had while waiting for you, as well as the emotions that should be expressed no other day but today. Since you didn't miss it, tell me—what did you hear from it?
Since music cannot supersede language, Doctor, there's still a lot for the two of us to talk about.

Happy New Year, Doctor! We can create a moment of shared emotion simply by circling an ordinary date on the calendar—look, people have always possessed the potential for 'empathy'. Though it is a far cry from the grandeur of the Movement, I am now fully convinced of its existence.
What are you trying to do? Even if I am not allowed to play, I can still make music resound within your mindscape.
Doctor? You have a pretty good sense of rhythm. 'Calamity' will not strike so soon, meaning you still have time to pick up a percussion instrument.
Listen to the breeze in the corridors. This vessel has its own true voice as well. What of yourself?
Doctor, I have awoken.
Joy, fluke, or mourning? We accept it all, so long as it is sincere.
We stand side by side. No calamity or unknown shall shake us.
We are unforgettable.
Feel each other, to your hearts' content.
Embrace the regrets, if you have any.
Sing with the cosmos.
Play towards the setting sun.
Behold, the consonance of innumerable souls.
Behold, the symphony of countless voices.
Let us hearken.
Let us lift our instruments.
Won't you open? 'Tis a visitor rapping at your heart chamber door—
We advance to every last corner of Terra.
A single cloud among countless others, dances with the wind and descends with the rain.
If the musical movement were not inherently prescribed, why do we adhere so rigidly to its interpretation?
In that future, we are each other's audience.
The future I envisioned has been set in stone, Doctor. It simply has not been elucidated yet, which is why I shall move towards it.
Not a single note shall fade.
I'm connected... This is the Movement that does not yet exist.
How beautiful... Humans are both the afterglow, and the sky that harbors it.

Doctor, can you believe Fede is still asleep? Now, here I am with my cello, and here you are in front of me—it would be a shame for you to miss what I've just experienced. Give me your hand—Yes, right on this string. Let's create this harmony together.

While 'Calamity' and the gathered crowds are both distant, a Sankta sounds lonely strings in this deserted monastery—is this to be my end...? Arturia, would you acknowledge life's meaning, even in its fleeting nature, if you were to return to that rain-soaked cemetery?

Yulia, the Witch King, Cora, Emmanuel... The audience will forever remember the sound of this cello. Do you still recall her words when your mother first taught you to play this instrument gifted by your father? 'Arturia, Mamma wishes you the most peaceful sleep, every single night.'

Are these possibilities inherent within 'empathy'? It has no personality, yet is able to suppress and manipulate human emotion—why did It ultimately choose to build a mechanism as singular as 'empathy' for the Sankta...? The music... why has it fallen silent?

I am listening... Fear and trauma persist nevertheless, but the strong will overcome them, while the weak find their own ways to fight—with no need to follow a Pope or a Lord of Fiends. In the face of 'calamity', all will play their own songs.

What is that vast, deep-blue expanse? The ocean, or the distant cosmos? Is it your origin, or your destination? Is it 'evolution', or the sum of all perfection and imperfection that you've carved throughout this process? You Many, is this your true voice? Life deserves a voice.

The Sarkaz are singing, and the Sankta play the accompaniment—who is this funérailles for, you ask? The nomadic monastery guides everyone it receives back to their homes, irrespective of life or death, irrespective of race or identity. Join in the chorus, and speak no more of this meaningless question.

The Tower of Revelations, the Notarial Hall, the Sunset Chapel, and finally, the chapel square—the halos over our heads are extinguished, yet the city remains illuminated as always. Please hold here, Sankta. And tell me, is Laterano not more connected to the rest of this great land, and less dissimilar?
Do you hear the music? It is a concerto resonating with countless individuals' emotions—we play distinctly solo, yet as a harmonious whole. What a magnificent possibility.

The possibilities that Arturia and I perceive are uniformly extreme; nevertheless, Rhodes Island, and you, as its commander, remain a constant variable. Therefore, Doctor, your assessment is required before 'calamity' arrives.

I am about to return to Laterano. The Notarial Hall's directives take precedence over your birthday celebration. I have, however, acquired this party hat for you... Is this inappropriate? If my understanding is correct, blue is a suitable color for such an occasion.
Doctor, please hold here. These possibilities require immediate disclosure and discussion. With YOU.

Even under such conditions, rituals of similar types persist. Wandering executors return to the nearest monastery to spend the day with their compatriots. I sense the existence and disappearance of each individual. I recollect that feeling, and know that it is not 'empathy'.
Thank you, my condition is now stable.
I did not notice your presence, Doctor. I am still processing this information.
All is normal.
The Commandments contain deficiencies. I will implement corrections.
Operation complete. Laterano will now return to the landship.
Annihilation shall not manifest.
All taboos are null.
All principles are breakable.
Purge, as the protocols require.
Fire, as the Commandments apply.
Laterano intervenes.
Laterano responds.
Emergency response protocols initializing.
Laterano has reached a conclusive assessment of the situation.
Assessing crisis danger level…
In which zone did the crisis occur?
Request received. Processing.
I am Laterano. I calculate every possibility, and remove every obstacle.
I see a certain future. Of Laterano, and of myself. The events that transpire within are far from inscrutable, but the question I find myself pondering is: why do they come to pass?
True. Our partnership agreement requires renewal—you represent Rhodes Island, and I, Laterano.
Archive complete.
Pathway locked. Framework stable. Connection established. This is Laterano.
Program running normally. Status: stable.

Arturia, cease your seduction of the Doctor. I am awake. I will share the possibilities I saw, as well as the limitations within. My head is still too foggy to begin the description, please allow me a look at the sky—it is a blue most familiar to me, Doctor.

Yulia, Clément—error; above names should not appear in the list of victims... Do you still remember? Federico, when your mother taught you to read and write, to play music. She whispered to you as you slept—you would come understand that you were just as useful as any patron firearm.

Emotional fluctuation detected; the six-year-old heir to the decedent does not possess the requisite psychological resilience. Processing; she demonstrates capacity to accept the decedent's status... 'Death'. Federico, you, too, stood in the rain at that cemetery. Did you come to understand it?

It possesses no personality yet maintains the capability to modulate and influence human emotions. Why did it ultimately choose to develop a mechanism as complex as 'empathy' for the Sankta...? What brought about such a question? I am thinking—Error, exception detected.

Owing to 'empathy', Laterano remains pure and efficient, even in the face of 'calamity'. When night falls, this place is the first to illuminate. Laterano will reconvene the Summit of Nations, and rally all forces when necessary.

The Many share similarities with present-day Laterano, but extreme approach behavior does not conform to the laws of evolution. Does this mean, however, that they are no longer sentient? And can such a life form come to a natural end? The nomadic monastery has arrived on the coast; You Many, your answers shall be used as reference for the conclusion.

The entity known as The Lord of Fiends is locked on, and I will help her shed the Black Crown. Civlight Eterna is too heavy a burden for a single fledgling. Laterano will share in this aura, and 'empathy' shall unite Sankta and Sarkaz as one.

From the Tower of Revelations to the Notarial Hall in Pagus Michaelion, then on to the Sunset Chapel in Pagus Saint Marcel, then the chapel square—the city is alight. I sense the existence of each individual, and their disappearance as well. We are one—as 'Laterano'.
'Calamity'. Deploying simulation sequence. Activating emergency response protocols. Queueing worst-case scenario simulation.

Mhmm... It's so quiet here. The sun is as warm as ever, and the breeze is always gentle. Professor, we may go on separate journeys from here, but don't worry. Even if we part ways for now, there will come a day when we meet again.

You've finally reached the top of the volcano, Professor. This is the view I've always wanted to show you... Why are you dreaming of me? Hehe, it's my way of telling you what I want to say. Happy birthday, Professor.
Professor, since we've shrunk and the desserts haven't... Maybe we can keep eating as much as we want?

I think it's snowing on those hills in the distance… Are you cold, Professor? The fairy tales say you can spin snow into nice, soft robes. Those who wear them will sleep the gentlest of sleeps. I hope you too will have sweet dreams tonight.
The lambs and I have matching bow ties. Aren't they pretty?
Hey, quit it, little lamb. Oh, it's you, professor.
Can I bring the cake in?
Oh my, who knocked over the cake stand? The lambs' faces are covered in cream!
Oops, be careful now. Sudden shrinking takes some getting used to. Try not to trip and fall, okay?
Ring-a-ding-ding, when the flowers gently fall, the berries you can haul.
Hand in hand we stride, singing atop the gentle clouds.
Sleep now, and fall into a sweet dream.
A refreshing breeze, mixed into bubbling soda.
A sweet-and-sour rainbow, dipped in golden sunshine.
A cotton candy cloud, drizzled in azure sky syrup.
A pebble returns to her hometown.
The lava surges on, never turning back.
The rainbow bridge rises between the clouds.
I hear fowlbeasts flapping their wings.
The little lambs say it's fun to roll around on the clouds. Do you think we can go for a picnic up there?
Come quick, Professor! There's still a ripe berry on that vine!
Yes? You're putting me in charge of the picnic?
The picnic's about to begin.
Look, professor! The hills are covered with Volcano Watchers! It's beautiful! Ah, mom and dad are there, too! Hm? You don't see them?
The flowers will not wither, and the sunlight will be forever warm. If only we could stay in this moment…
I wonder if anyone recorded the picnics, too?
Is this a dream? A cozy, cloud-white dream?
Shh... Listen carefully, Professor. That's the sound of flowers blooming... So soft and gentle. I'm glad I can hear it.

Cotton drifting on♪ We fly like clouds and chase the sun♪ Over the lava spout♪ We can't stop while the sun is out♪ Slow down if you please♪ You need to grant our wishes three♪ North Wind, make us rain♪ Bloom hot flowers from pebble grains♪

Phew. Looks like the sun's about to set. If only we could catch up with it, then the picnic could go on a little longer. How nice it would be if we could dance in a circle and sing. Pretty sun, warm sun, why you set so soon? Please stay, please wait, for time is such a boon♪
The little lambs can't wait to take us out to play again. What did you think of the chocolate lava in that volcano earlier? I much prefer the crystal candy from the thermal lake myself.

Do you like this cake, Professor? It's not just a regular cake. The base is made of love and dedication. The cream is distilled from our adventures. Various emotions are sprinkled as a finishing touch. And I've placed it in a box made of memories. It took me a long time to learn to bake a cake like this, Professor. I hope you'll remember the taste forever.

We've come pretty far, haven't we, Professor? A little fowlbeast brought me a rock from an acid lake. A little musbeast led me across an ocean of pink. And I even went aboard a great ship made of love and warmth. With these treasures, I don't feel at all lonely.

Hm? What was that, Professor? Sorry, I didn't quite catch that, please wait a second... My, how did this wool get in my ear? It must have slipped when I was playing hide-and-seek with the lambs! Go ahead, Professor, I can hear you now.

What do you think of my dress, Professor? Is the ribbon tied right? The lambs invited me to a party, but all they gave me to wear was a big ball of wool! Rather naughty of them, don't you think? It's been so long since I danced in a dress. I'm worried I might have some trouble. Would you mind practicing with me?

Professor, would you like to try this cupcake I made? It's got a small piece of berry, some cream I scooped from a bigger cake, and the plate is a vine leaf… Why is there a lamb hiding in your hood...? This must be one of Dolly's pranks.
Mmm~I smell whipped cream. Look, the lambs have started their picnic over there. Care to join them with me, Professor?

Beneath time's ashes, there lies the Elves' lost knowledge and forgotten tales... but even I can't really comprehend them. Digging through the past— it weighs down on you a lot more than healing a wound, or blessing a new life. Doctor, how do you manage to confront it all?

You can stop guessing now. It's the real me standing before you, not a flowing shape. You know I make the trip here every year, so why would this year be an exception? Alrighty, I lugged half a ton of investigation files here for Rhodes Island. So c'mon now, let's just head to the restaurant first.
Oh, you all rested up...? Look after yourself, okay? No vanishing into bubbles on me.

There's no trace of time in our strata of crystals, just as our people in Sami don't leave calendars in their amber. That's that— we're a race who can't see what's ahead, embracing lives so long that we can't feel epochs flowing by. Give your terminal a break for now, Doc. Don't you want today to be a one-of-a-kind day?
An exploration journey this endless isn't easy for me, no sirree. Did you really get used to it long ago? Don't work yourself too hard. C'mon, let's you and me take a little walk.
At least I can still feel your touch.
Same as it ever was, and honestly that's not bad.
Water will take us to safety. Hold my hand tight, and keep your eyes shut.
They're gone. Bet they know the way back home, right?
The leaf trembles. The stream murmurs. I understand how they feel now much better than I used to… Oh, no, they're happy. Simply all delighted, trust me.
Gimme your hand, Doctor! Uh, um... I just wanted to share my feelings with you. Don't worry, I'm not gonna get you wet.
But I can't go back. Back isn't the answer.
In promises coalesce.
In yearnings flow.
In dreams resurrect.
Miss Waterdrop… where will you land?
This... is how my ancestors welcomed the rainclouds.
Want me to help brainstorm?
I'm listening.
Lives head toward their demise. What can I do… before the end…
Just look away one sec, okay? I want to let the waterflow relax for a bit... the way my people did so long ago.
How do you understand them? And how do you make them... understand you?
All the pains caused by 'right and wrong'… How I wish the water could wash them away.
Look, the sun's coming up. How warm it is... Cozying up like this, hiding away from all that the years do to catch us... May be a good life too.
We've known each other for so long, but you just keep giving the same gifts... Of course I love it, c'mon.
This cramped cage we jail each other in.
The birth, the existence, the dying, the everything of my blood's origin… They are all here, nothing left but pieces now... If you're interested, I'll tell you every story of them.
Time is still mourning Her, so it won't slip away that fast. If your legs need a break, we can sit and catch a breather.

Everything of Her, everything I could ever find, I've got it all by my side. Thank you, Doctor, for accompanying me so long. Whatever comes next, we can save thinking about it until we get back. Oh... it's raining. Maybe it's time for us to leave too.

The environment's changed so quickly here without Her, and it's not in my power to do what She did. It's like a lifelong dream suddenly landed in my lap, but the caveat was it could disappear at any time. So life will always be on edge, haunted by suspense and fear. I don't wanna live such a painful life, Doctor. I'd rather take the risk.

You're right, no place suits me better than this. Problem is, I've been spoiled by modern life. If I seriously live here all on my own, the boredom is gonna shrivel me right up. Maybe the other Elves could deal, but... I can't... At the end of it all, I'm just a plain and ordinary girl.

The ever-wakeful spring wells from Her back, that its currents caress Her like silk cloth. And in sweet rains it waters the parched land, that it nourishes all life as it grows...' Your kin left that passage to Her in your recollections. It makes me think, I should draw Her. That way, others'll be able to see Her.

Pfahhh! Water doesn't get cleaner than this! You can take a sip too, if you're thirsty. I know, you're probably scared it's Her blood or Her tears or whatever, but don't overthink it. If you drink from this spring, it'd make Her the happiest person of us all... well, not person, Feranmut.

To get the information in this crystal, you have to 'communicate' with it. Yep, that's right, just like the kind we make when I hold your hand. Oh, actually, lemme borrow your hand a sec! How's that, can you sense Her feelings? No? Not one teeny tiny bit? Oh... Okay...

She's gone. She dispersed all Her Elves... then time carried Her far away, to a place farther still. But you know, just a hunch, I think She simply got sick of being a Feranmut. And just like some special Rhodesies we've got, now She's probably living up the human life, maybe? You think that sounds right, Doctor?

All trace of Her walking our land, all the names She was praised by… Everything is gone, evaporated like morning dew... Across our clan's recollections of Her, 'Muel' is the only thing that remains. A syllable now carried on in my name.
In a landward raindrop, in a humidifier's mist, whenever you need me, I'll hear your call.

Your wings have gotten stronger, and your scales are tougher now. I wonder how you'll look once you shed that robe. If only I could bend time to my will, the new, reborn you would be back at my side so much sooner.

Normal cakes and pastries can't satisfy your hunger, can they? Maybe we could go with some new ideas. Hmm... A frosted galaxy? A chocolate mountain? Maybe a candied fruit forest? You still want human pastries...? Alright...
Where are you flying off to today?

This is a holiday where humans celebrate their calendar cycle starting anew. You should go enjoy yourself. It must be very fun to swim among fireworks. Oh, and remember to save me a spark. I'll plant it in the garden.
Look into my eyes, and tell me the first word that comes to mind.
Let the fairies redecorate. We'll come back later.
Come with me. We will live on, together.
You missed them? They must not be important.
Fighting isn't complicated. You did well. You may have whatever reward you desire.
When you trust your instincts, victory is never far off. You use them well.
It was your determination that dyed my dress red.
The moment you leave, I will take these lost dreams away.
The red velvet of life props up this dead diamond.
This song will never stop, not until the melody is written…
Let me stir it.
Don't send a thread into a knife's edge.
Let instinct stain my name.
Flowers wither, and petals dye the land red.
Listen. The sound of a banquet.
Watch your shadow. Don't let it be stolen.
You already have the answer in your mind. Why follow the commands of others?
I will follow your words, and drift along the currents…
Fighting is the most primal of instincts, and there's no point in resisting it. If you're frightened, I can guide you forward.
There are no tasks or duties here. Our own satisfaction is the greatest reward. Indeed, I'm very satisfied now.
This screen is cold and dull. Why don't we instead relish some fresh, living memories?

Spread your wings and squall to your heart's content. Everything is permitted in these red plains. Spread your joy and excitement to the fairies. Let them sing and frolic with them. I'll be waiting for you here.
Sleep soundly. I will be the residual melody in your sweet dreams.

The fairies are talking amongst themselves. They whisper: the guardian of the garden is lingering in the borderlands, trying to leave the plains. Then go. Go where you like and follow your nature. Bring your dream and my heart with you. Only then, will the you I well-acquainted return to my fingertips.

I found a scale in the nest. Are you starting to shed again? I will sing to you lullabies, take off your gown, and rinse that filth with warm water. Will you... refuse me? I promise you everything... so please, just this once, listen to what I demand.

The fairies swallowed dreams, and so were shaped like those dreams. Plates roll and tumble across the ground; puppets chase one another;  seaflowers raise their instruments... Dreams become reality itself. If I were to become a little fairy myself, do you think... the distance between us might lessen?

Amidst the sea of impulses and desires, I opened my eyes. You did, too. That's why I'm bringing you with me: to unleash our desires and break these shackles. But it looks like you have other ideas... I'm scolding you? Not at all. This is what makes you different, and I like it.

Once in the past, you loved to entwine yourself among my fingers. You breathed like a great dragon, but let out only faint squeaks. Just when did it all change...? Now you only hover above my head, looking at me from afar... I want to see you, without having to look up all the time. That's very tiring.

Singing's not so hard. You only need to let your voice out of your throat. Your desires will shape sound itself, and I will write it into a score. Come, have a try. Sing the way you want. It'll be fun.

The soil on the plains contain all souls' desires. Those thoughts, regrettable yet magnificent, despicable yet delicious. They are your food to enjoy. Are they sweet? Are they Sour? You must've figured out how to share them with me, right?

No more rolling around in the frosting. You're an example to the fairies, the guardian of the garden. I won't clean you scale by scale, or wrap you in silk and put you in the clouds anymore... Of course, you can do anything you like. This may be my own wishful thinking, but I imagine you'd be willing to hear out my suggestions.

I understand. Some thoughts lose meaning when expressed with words. It's fine. So long as those thoughts echo in your mind, so long as you still need me, I will be here by your side, and nowhere else.
No matter when or where, there are always those shouting out their naive ideals. However, the idealists are not the only ones who can move forward.

Once you stop making wishes, you naturally no longer look forward to birthdays. Whether that's because you can already fulfill them on your own, or out of crippling despair... I'm afraid it's been far too long since the last time I said 'Happy birthday' to anyone.
Do I long for the old days? No. I simply cannot forget. That which I saw in the places untouched by light... and could do nothing about.

Let us pretend that today was the New Year. Who could remember dates, after having trudged the wilderness for so long? ...But I am not wrong about the dates, I know. Everything that happens in Kawalerielki is measured by how many days it remains in the paper, no more and no less. No matter the story.
Do not add any frivolous decorations to my sword, Toland... In the Grand Knight Territory, there are merchants eying the Nearl name. They will do as you do, and ridicule me in your place.
I can tell who you are. Speak freely.
I have no promises to make.
'Failure can be endured.' ... But the price is always dear.
From the windows of Kawalerielki's towers, my eyes have grown tired of those men and their unpunished misdeeds.
...Wake me up.
There is no one man who loftily sneers at the pointlessness of it all... Time speeds past us equally.
Even if there is but a sigh at the very end.
The sunlight will have to wait.
Face the tide? Hmph.
It will be over before you feel the pain.
All those... I have yet to abandon.
Do I need to repeat myself on the battle plan?
Blade whetted again… for but another battle…
It would seem they have yet to remember what to fear.
The sound of the wind in the barrens... Far too familiar.
Follow me.
To think they all still believe that blood is not spilled in vain…
How should I present myself...? As the one slandered by the papers and the groundless gossip in town? Or as the wanderer who once treated that vilification as a badge of honor?
Blank paperwork for promotion within the order, excerpts from the recon knights' reports on our movements... Schnitz often sent these things, as his way of saying hello.
Nearly the same struggles and sacrifices...
'Fear neither hardship nor darkness...' Hmph. A bygone time unworthy of remembering. A dream, far too lucid.
The sound of a rainstorm in the wilderness...

The Grand Knight Territory's appearance is ever-fluid. Today, the city exhibits no trace of what it was twenty years ago, its sunset-lit silhouette sunken and gone... Yet its nightscapes still spring up to my mind at times wanted and at times not. Often, I find myself thinking that I should at least... try to seek out and reclaim that past.

Margaret doesn't speak to me, but considering how she was back then... we had no need to. She is just like you were at that age, Yolanta, too much so. She will experience the same things you did, and she will never regret them. That I should tarry at her side more? Hmph, there's no point.

Forget it, Schnitz. How am I to tutor Maria in your stead? I am no knight, and certainly no father. No one would call me 'gentle.' Besides... I never once imagined I would actually return to this place... Why, Schnitz? Why am I the one to remain?

Golden plains, a field of wheat, the path of a nomadic city, and the wake of a Catastrophe. The manor's garden, the arena, and those who hand over their last coin along with their last harvest... Father, I've always tried to walk a righteous path.

Father, you once told me that longswords are suitable only for valorous young knights. But the National Council's miscarriage of justice, the General Chamber of Commerce's rise to prominence—everything I've wanted to stop, my blade was useless to prevent. I couldn't remove your lesions, and with it by my side I watched as Schnitz left... I merely became accustomed to its prescence.

Why are you still here? Our ideals have come to an end, and I witnessed their final moments... No, never mind. You wish to spar? Then pick up your spear. Entrust your future not to a failure, but to sacrifice, and the pain in your flesh. Come.

The rivalries in the halls of power never ceased, they've merely become a part of the opportunistic pursuit of profit. The only constant is the innocent being dragged into the cesspool. As vassals of a treasonous knight, your parents were forced to take you into their involuntary flight ere the fabricated incrimination could arrive... Czcibor, why? Why didn't you... flee even further?

I've never guaranteed your survival for following me, Toland. If it was their lives that your hunters valued, they shouldn't have stepped onto the battlefield or had their recklessness take over them in the first place... Their deaths are not what you need to downplay for your mockery. You will always remember. As will I.
Just another rainfall.

The lights of Rhodes Island once illuminated the night sky, and everyone aboard celebrated throughout the night, both on the bridge and in their cabins. Those were the good old days, yet now our operators can only shut off their electricity and drift to sleep even a moment sooner. All the effort we put in today is to allow civilization to shed light upon the lands anew.
I will return to the Ark tonight. I hope to see you through the anti-Originium curtain, just like in years past.
There is still much we can do, Doctor.
Holidays may not provide much joy to anyone anymore, but there is not much left to commemorate. Do not let Originium take away these precious memories too. These are the best wishes I can offer you.
Have you ever imagined a future where only you remain?
Seems you are still very fond of your little tricks.
The facilities are fairly well-maintained.
All personnel, retreat to safe zone. Comm permits are transferred to you for now. I will sort out the situation before us.
You should be more careful. We can't afford even a single loss.
All units, proceed according to plan. I will hand the report to the Doctor.
How much time do we have left?  I see… I trust your judgment.
On my mark, prepare to counterattack.
Follow my orders, Mon3tr.
Suppressing Originium activity.
Never let your guard down before the enemy.
Executing battle plan.
I will synchronize the battlefield data.
What's your plan?
Stick to the plan. Do not throw your life away for nothing.
All units, double check the status of your anti-Originium equipment.
Mark the area you need explored. I will arrange for the rest.
I will correct any flawed decisions that occur during exploration.
Mon3tr, these tattered lands will one day need you more than ever. Now, with your own voice, say hello to the Doctor.
Formalities are no longer necessary between you and I. You need only keep your promise to maintain the Ark's safe course.
Experiences from before the crystallization age are for reference only. Do not overly rely on them.

The anti-Originium communication lines have been activated... Signal received. Come in, Babel. This is Kal'tsit, exploring the former Leithanien region as planned. No coagulation point found as of yet. What about you, Doctor? What's the situation there?
Scanning... The atmospheric oxygen level is still decreasing... No, let the Doctor rest. I will check it out.

I can hear the crystal clusters surging. The Originium tides will soon dissolve me... Don't give me that look. Take care of Amiya and the city. We can continue to work on those problems the next time we speak. Well, then... see you again, Doctor.

You already know how 'death' functions for me. So there's no need to worry about the damage I take. Instead, you should pay more attention to your own condition. The sarcophagus cannot heal the trauma wrought by extreme stress and exhaustion. If there is anything you would like to say, I will listen.

We can no longer draw meaningful lessons from past experiences. The answers to our questions come not from our collective pool of knowledge, but from innovation and imagination. As you are more proficient than I in those aspects, there is no need to seek my advice on every single matter. Your insights are more important than my opinion here.

Under the curtain weaver, symptoms of Oripathy have faded into history, yet mankind continues to voice its dissatisfaction. The old order did collapse, but the minds of man remain narrow. Amiya must still go hither and thither to unite them. While she is now an excellent leader, you are still the only one she can rely on.

Originium soared through the skies and seized the twin moons, its clusters dispersing into the universe like spores, contacting and assimilating both the living and the dead— This is what is currently happening outside of Terra. Originium is swallowing everything into its body and incubating an all-encompassing chaos. But Terra can still be saved, and only because you remain by our side.

The people of today may still remember what trees looked like. That is why they can point to Originium clusters and call them an Originium Forest. But when we can no longer conceive of trees and woods, the word 'forest' will forever disappear from our languages. If things continue that way, 'these lands' will cease to exist as well.

Inactive Originium solidified and accumulated, while redundant information piled atop itself in layers, giving us a new home. Only because you were there by our side could we delay the awakening of the arrogant master of all creation. All those who survived rely on your aid. They are all very appreciative, and so am I.

With the Originium held back by the curtains Rhodes Island has drawn, mankind was able to build the Ark and drag out its feeble existence. Yet the pressures of survival cannot suppress greed and desire. Every faction's leader yearns to become the administrator who holds all the keys. I understand that you pity them for their predicament, but you must decide based on your own judgment.
The Ark does not have the resources to maintain unnecessary, extended communications. But there will be no restrictions on transmissions between the two of us. Keep the channel open.

The mission of Rhodes Island is clear, but you seem to seek something else. I know. What I seek could never be had, ever since the morning that I left Columbia. Do you remember Professor Thorne's voice, Elliot?

Seems that even time celebrates you, Doctor. Forgive me for not having prepared a gift. May your dreams be free of the pains of the past. Or perhaps, I will tell your future when the past eats away at you.

I dreamed of a future where all faded into nothingness with the changing seasons. No sweet dreams, no nightmares, only... darkness. That is where fate will lead us, Elliot. That darkness is no metaphor, just nothingness itself.

At New Year's Day, I guess many will come to curry the favor of the master of the black market? Is that so? I have forgotten. I only remember that science museum admission was free when the professor took me there that winter... So distant. The memory is so very distant.
Treasure your memories, treasure a time when you still had emotions. I understand. At least, I can still understand.
Do not wake him, okay?
Do you find Rhodes Island comforting? It's more the caffeine.
The days to permit mistakes are gone for good, never to return. We are fighting an enemy too powerful. Fate? No, ourselves.
Did you see how the punished fled? Yes, I did. I wonder if that was how those Columbians saw me.
Your machinations will claim all. Is this how you became the master of the black market? Yes, as will you, Elliot. I know that well. You will not let anyone escape.
There is no snow in the winters of the black market. Will I still see snow? Yes, but in that world of silvery white, nothing you know will remain.
Vengeance has ended.
Sentimentality does not bring victory.
What is there to be gained... by fighting in the name of my teacher?
I remember how each piece of equipment was born.
After all, 'Man' is the ultimate weapon.
My war machine will fulfill your wishes.
Do you remember the touch of quicksand?
In place of training.
I fought for a single purpose. Let war be the past, then, if the purpose is lost.
I recall the weight on my back as I carried my grievously injured teacher—it was the weight of my war. Most wars are waged for profit; mine is born from vengeance.
Elliot would have asked me: How does an empty soul lead others with sincerity?
Why do you not seek more companions? It will make things easier. In time, you will understand. And much more than once, I regret to say.

Will you see the Sargon's winter when you awake? Will you sleep away in the eternal summer? Must I become you? Prophecy is but fate in disguise. Sleep soundly, Elliot. You've shaped me, and I shall complete you, until the day the prophecies no longer foretell.

Oripathy has robbed me of my future. I hope that Rhodes Island can make use of what I have left. Wrong. Nobody in Rhodes Island can indulge your desire for self-harm. It is not that they are too kind, it is that you are too harsh. This is Elliot Glover's conclusion.
I see conspiracies from time to time... Yes, Elliot. The conflicts, the greed. They are everywhere.
Have I turned the pages of destinies past? No, it is but a dream you avoid. My future.
Sleep, my Elliot. Sleep and dream together with me. In our dreams, you will become me, and I will still be you.

A Vouivre, and the 'Doctor'. Are you begging for their pity? No, I simply want to learn about my future, or tell others about theirs. Nothingness without end is worse than any illness... Listen to me, Elliot. I feel a little tired.

Strange things, fabricated dreams are. What should I say to you, Doctor of the future? If I had met you earlier... No. The Doctor does not exist where we do. The Doctor belongs to my time. Let our special friend act freely. I have high hopes for this one.

Spring is when business is best. Summer is adorned by festivals. Autumn is the season to seek fortune away from Ibut. Winter belongs to war. These are the seasons of Sargon, seasons that you will come to hate… But in Ibut, I can see the stars shine bright on summer nights.

Tell me. Has Oripathy changed our lives? Do you feel pain? How will the illness transform me? Have the schemers behind the scenes miscalculated? You are trembling, poor Elliot. Never mind the cause, leave them in the past. Now, I simply marvel at the beauty of Oripathy's creation in the mirror.

Do you remember the first component of Thorne's Gift? The shoddy Arts Unit you obtained by burying your conscience in the sand? By exploiting and deceiving a guard who had just lost his son? Not to mention the irony in that name. What gift will a teacher give to a conspirator, Passenger?

Yet your expression suggests otherwise. Did you not throw all of the past into that big fire? There is a plaza in the black market with a view of the sky. Do you remember what the night reminds you of? I called it a cremation ceremony, but when my plan worked and the flames raged... What came to mind was not the face of my beloved teacher.

Sargon will leave its mark on you. To the employer, you are as feeble as a fledgling fowlbeast. I forgot how it felt to be put to the lash. Do you hate those people? No. I know their end. I know it from your eyes. Fortunately, you don't seem to regret it.

I detest everything there. I had to leave Sargon, even if letting a coin flip decide for me meant surrendering to fate. But I am still there, Sand Soldier. You can't escape what you are. Our destinies have already been written.

What did you find in time, mysterious master of the black market? The past, Elliot. I have always been seeking the past. Perhaps I will find a home among the patterns of the cacti and quicksand, but neither you nor I know where our fate will lead.

How much longer is this war gonna last? Everyone's doing their best to survive, even though life is nothing but suffering. Or is it more like you can only suffer when you're alive? Hm. Hey, Hoederer, I think I just came up with a quote you might like!
It's bright out, the weather's great, we just knocked out a big mission, and we'll be back at Babel for debrief by sunset. What a great day. Hey, Hoederer, what do you say to a feast?
Watch your step.
