'Traces of civilization among the stars', 'fleets wandering through subspace', huh… It's not that I don't believe you, I just don't understand any of it! Even if you were some crusty old man on a sickbed, delirious with fever instead of the Doctor, I'd believe you. The real question is, when are we gonna get to see them?

What? My tie's all wrinkly? Oh, that's because I used it to wipe too many of my clients' tears. Sad tears, emotional tears, happy tears… Travel has this mysterious effect on people. So, when am I gonna make you cry?

It doesn't have to be a restricted area, y'know. It's not like I'm into getting shocked by electric fences. If you believe an ancient secret passage is hidden in Rhodes Island's toilets, then I'd be happy to take you there. However many skeptics there are on this land is the number of places worth going.

Look, I might be a rulebreaker, but even I've got standards! Standards like, 'make sure the client comes out without a scratch'! If I didn't keep to that sort of ironclad rule, I'd never have thought to fight off a whole manglerbeast by myself, haha…

Doesn't matter how much money you've got or how hard the job is, I'm not gonna charge you an arm and a leg if you're feeling something like the Bleached Wasteland. If your idea's good enough, the only consideration I'll need is you bringing yourself along, buuut if you just wanna go into the restricted areas to snap pics with the warning signs, then that'll cost ya!

Eh, no biggie even if you didn't bail me out, that prison wasn't so bad. I accidentally ruined the reputations of enough travel agencies, I had plenty of companies trying to get me thrown in jail, but thanks to them, my Terran Travels 'Free Lodgings' Guidebook has a few new entries.

It's more than just cannibals banished from Rusthammer over there, we got Catastrophe cultists infesting the place, all in the name of the living Originium forest… Guh, most of my clients would be asking me to take them there by this point. Where's your sense of curiosity?! You wait here, I'll get us some water before I tell you more!
You're not seriously expecting me to give you a tour of your own office! C'mon, I'm getting you out of this place! I'll cart you out, if I have to!

Propeller Paradise, Rhodes Island, we're all relegated to roaming the barrens alone. But someday, there'll be a hundred Propeller Paradises and a hundred Rhodes Islands sailing all over the place. We'll be the great land then, and it'll be Max D.C.'s turn to be the languid lonely little dinghy.

C'mon, Doc, got a few hundred li'l fellas still waiting to meet you. Just you wait, they're gonna give you history's greatest firework show… What do you mean 'too much'? Too much my ass. Frankly, you should have your birthday every day, 'cause hunting for an excuse to do this is a pain in my tail.
What's on your mind, Doc? Penny for your thoughts.

Here's a toast to… eugh. Look at me, dredging up my old bootlicking ATAO habits. I'm throwing off our whole collaboration as equals. Okay, here's what we'll do. You serve as a tester for my new gear later, and then we're even again. Sound good?
Yeah? Wanna come fly with me?
Feels good, right? Pure stress relief in your hand. It's designer. I'm always touching it myself.
Wow… What a beauty of a base. It's gotta be either an earth-digger or a sky-flier, right?
Book it, guys! I'm Gordon Tannen and I don't fear a damn thing! I'll give my life before I give my tail!
Forget those runaways, tape, where's the duct tape? This is supercooled Originium condensate rustled from Sami! Every drop we lose, we lose forever!
So I put the cuffs on you and now you say you got duped? What, did you forget you had a brain at the time?
Oh, high-explosive Originite grenade, my beloved, did you see that smoke, that fragmentation? You're a success, you're magnificent, you're a hundred KG yield!
Quit playing dead! One more round, new weapon! It's called a control!
Get up! How do I test-fire if you're lying down? It's called responsibility.
No more hollering! What if I fill my data wrong? It's called courtesy.
Don't touch me! You gonna fix my hazmat suit too? It's called sense.
Stand a little further in, Doc. I can see your hood from here.
Keep it simple. Doesn't matter where you put me, I'm still headed for the skies.
What, got a report for me?
Don't sweat it, I catch your drift.
Get on your knees, now! What, never seen an ATAO agent lay down the law before?!
Oh, high-explosive Originite grenade, my beloved, you'll waste away in the warehouse no longer. I'll blow you up so good the whole continent's gonna hear you scream.
You guys remember one thing: When you kick the door down, kick like you mean it! I'll handle the rest.
You guys on the transport crew for my little fellas? Then I'll bring a few extra crates.
I tell you what, this Rhodes Island joint's got potential to become the next Propeller Paradise! A few more of those promotions and I'll bring you along to make it happen… *burp*!
This is a real deal promotion medal, and not my consolation prize for playing patsy, right? Hey, then this IS my first one ever. You wanna pop the champagne?
I got some bodycam footage from the gangs we busted back in my frontier days. Want it?

Want one, Doc? Here, I got a light. It's just an Originium firework, but you ain't seen nothing yet. Cut a deal today, and I'll get it to you tomorrow. Gordon Tannen, Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Arts Units, and Originium, at your service.

One of these days, I've gotta figure out a way to suck out all the wasted nutrients from the morons who can't use their brains, and then redirect them into you, so you can stop spending all this time sleeping.

Wait, what did you just call me? 'Friend'? Nooo no no no, I've used that word on a lot of people before, but not between us, you understand? I don't want to sully my most dependable associate with the kind of relationship that breaks down when you don't like the same food.

Back in Tkaronto, when I saw you squatting in the corner of your detention cell, chilling out studying the mushrooms, I knew the ATAO didn't get you, you were just playing the ATAO. And now here I am, business partner with a whiz like you. Goes to show I'm the real deal. And that I didn't put extra meat in your prison meals for nothing.

What am I doing hanging upside-down from the ceiling? Ha! Well, you looked hot enough to boil in that suit, and my propeller here pulls double-duty as a fan, doesn't it? Y'know, excuse me in advance for this, but it's geniuses like you that stump me the most. How come you've got the brains to study a terminal disease, but you don't think to install yourself a better air conditioner?

Check that out. The stars. Glittering like a blanket over the sky. Make fun of me if you want, but when I was a kid, I'd hold this blanket full of holes over my head, stand under a light, look up to pretend I was stargazing. It was dumb. But life's about feeling out one dumb idea after another until you hit on something and feel like you've got your future. Right?

It's not all eggheads at Propeller Paradise. Look at me, I learned all my physics from teaching toys. If I can make it in there, pretty much anyone with a brain can. I'm just out to match people with little fellas that work for them. Can you imagine anything better than that?

Get a load of this, Doc! I rustled up an RGB frill-wig ahead of the summit on Originium goods regulations! Look, this thing changes color on its own, it… what? The summit started half an hour ago? Pfff. That's fine, I still gotta dip into the toybox. I'll deal with the summit later.

Yeah, I deal in contraband, but think—what am I 'violating'? They'd outlaw toothpaste if you paid 'em enough to make it Schedule 1. What kind of system is that? I'm trying to rescue the nice stuff from a contraband warehouse, you're trying to sell good drugs on the open market. You and me, we work the same.

Let me guess. No, don't spoil it for me. Is this a smart head massager, or an autonomic pressure regulator cap, or a holographic environmental monitoring device…? It's just a normal hood? Well, dream bigger! Spot me some funding, and I'll do you a full suit worthy of the Head of Rhodes Island.

We're filing project papers? You're kidding me. Why sit here sifting through the stuff we've already done…? There're denied proposals too? Then what the heck are we sitting here looking at dead trees for?

A Banshee does not forget the Convallis that nurtured her, while a Pioneer will not forget the barrens she trekked through—it was how I joined Rhine Lab, and the antecedent to my future. Doctor, what does Rhodes Island mean to you, and how will you guide it? Our cooperation will continue.

You're still alive, so leaves are more suitable than bone for the whistle. A melody I know…? No, the Mama John's jingle wouldn't fit… Once upon a time, a group of Pioneers lying on a scaffold hummed a tune to the setting sun to welcome a Banshee into their group. Would you like to hear it?
You bumped into my 'branches'.

One last cable, and three, two, one, go… Times like these, the researchers would excitedly scramble over to the cable sparks and call them 'fireworks', but you seem quite calm still—Happy New Year, Doctor. We won't make it to the celebrations back on the island.
Don't pull on the mechanical leaf… Fine, I'll teach you to whistle Mother's melody.
'Stasis'—I consider this legitimate self-defense.
The elevator bulb was loose, so I changed it.
Angry? Why? Would you like to guess how many Rhine Lab blueprints I've had to revise before they were officially greenlit?
'Expectations' met. Expand on that? We always leave room for improvement.
Do another round of checks… 'Perfect' to us is but a standard to reach.
Project done. Good work, everyone.
'The realm has naught for your perch.'
'Elegies are no final respite.'
A confession? All I hear is the babbling of souls.
Listen again. Did you think it was just construction noise?
Don't trip on my tape.
You don't have to reiterate the project goals. Work has already begun.
An error message? Nothing out of the norm.
If the plan is too vague, I will revise it.
Ensure the construction site is safe before we begin.
Silent words work all the same.
Saria. She will break through the enemy's encirclement; and Muelsyse will manage any mediation efforts as necessary. Both are indispensable.
Rhodes Island's many Operators working multiple jobs is a common sight at Rhine Lab as well.
I'd like to thank Rhodes Island and you for the recognition, Doctor. Our cooperative efforts have been reassuring.
Are you expecting a speech…? Sorry, abstract topics only leave me feeling hollow.
Rewind three seconds. The terminal on the left was displaying incorrect data… Alright, problem solved.
So we meet. Nasti Lunorey, Director of Engineering at Rhine Lab. I've heard a lot about you from some of my colleagues. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
At last, the muddled dream is about to settle…

Look at the barrier above our heads. Do you think it's out of our reach? Or perhaps I should be asking if you know how it was formed, how to break it down? Kristen absolutely believed her choice held meaning, while I will see it through. Where do you stand on this, Doctor?

You must have misheard, I was not singing—if you take the Logos you know as a reference, I am no qualified Banshee, nor do I belong to the Convallis any longer. Though elegies still mean the same to me. You're tired? If you're unused to falling asleep to the rumbling of construction noise, I can write you a curse.

I invited you to dance on the sky bridge yesterday? *sigh* I see Muelsyse has taken to this impersonation game. Doctor, I will, for now, take it you failed to recognize that was a water clone, so—who is it you do not know well enough—Muelsyse or myself?

Correct. Countless Columbians bore witness to the fall, and the spectacle left them disheartened. Was there a need to cool their fervor? I have no interest in discussing this, Doctor… Fowlbeasts learn to fly by falling, and one day Kazdel will float in the sky.

The so-called 'Rhine Lab Ten' seldom came together, even when Kristen was still around, so the few empty seats at the round table now do not imply much of a crisis. As Director of Engineering, I know how much longer this machine we call 'Rhine Lab' can operate.

I won't join Rhodes Island's engineering optimization efforts—no, you wouldn't manage to steal Rhine Lab's tech either way, but as a fellow engineer, I know the look on that Vampire's face when she stays up all night drawing blueprints. This is no prime-time Trimounts home renovation show, and I have no interest in commentating on someone else's home.

Ho'olheyak? A K'uk'ulkan not even trying to hide her probes and provocations. She has a talent for making trouble. She calls herself my friend… Yes, I'm aware of such rumors. I will temper my hate for her as long as she doesn't interfere with my work, and the same goes for you, Doctor.

Please grab these 'branches'… good. I've obtained your height, weight, and bone density. In ten minutes, a robot will deliver safety equipment tailored to you. Why the surprise? Were you not planning to follow me to the construction site?
Here, construction project plans and data reconciliation sheet. Why the face? I share the same twenty four hours a day that you do, so there's no reason I should work for you alone.

It used to be hard for me to ignore regret. I tried, only to realize it wasn't really necessary. A rousing melody can stay in the climax, and a settled note is no longer noise, just as everyone on Rhodes Island has found their home.

Happy birthday, Doctor. My gift is imbued with musical Arts, playing back a song cover I performed myself. I'm sure the original is much better and… actually in tune. But I guarantee this song is more memorable than any other.
Hello, Doctor. Here's a special suite of music for you to play on deck. A little applause would make it even more pleasing.

The celebration can wait. I'm maintaining the musical order of the festival; those who work behind the scenes only get to enjoy the celebrations after the curtain falls. It's not that I don't like a lively scene; my blessings are with everyone, in each and every note. The tuner does not leave until the music has ended.
My horns are not a percussion instrument, Doctor.
I can hear you, you know.
Quiet, like a sheet of paper without notes or staff lines. I'll set it up.
Ugh! I need to wash my ears out.
It's not such a bad thing to rush through a passage that's out-of-tune.
This is an elegy for them to mourn themselves.
They gave up before we got to the cadence. Looks like the program doesn't need to be too long.
This is my range.
Let the arpeggio cascade.
Too low. From the top.
Ready, four-four time.
I'll give it a try.
Oh, it's my turn.
Eh? What did you say?
Here. I'm listening.
It's time to cut the noise.
The horn sounds. Now, beat the drums.
Do you need me… to give the cue?
I'll be in tune with you.

The journey helped me see clearly and understand it. The wonderful music of the cities comes not from god-given talent, but the concerted effort of tireless tuners. That's what I aspire to be—one whose work is ordinary, unremarkable, but indispensable.
I'm being recognized? Simply for doing my job? Okay. I have quite a few colleagues in Leithanien. I think they will be very interested in joining Rhodes Island. Care to consider it, Doctor?
It's very complex, like a passionate fugue.
Don't worry, I've entrusted my work in Leithanien to my colleagues there. I'm afraid you're mistaken, they're inveterate workaholics, just like me.
Sorry, I didn't mean it. Perhaps the duet was a little too hypnotizing?

Medical says they want to help me find the reason I can't sing in tune. I know it's not an illness, but the result of being scorned by those who live atop the spires. I don't like the feeling of expectations placed on me. Fortunately, it is possible to tune out the noise, and tuners never have regrets.

Shh! Can you hear my flowers? I added musical Arts to the flowers sent to Medical, and I'm one piece away from completing the suite. I don't want the patients to suffer any regret, because in their eyes, I'm a healer too. It's not always recovery that makes patients happy, if I am not wrong.

This group photo…? I… was troubled by my lack of talent at the time. I hung it in my room to remind myself to live without regret. Oh, I didn't explain why I'm not in the photo, did I? Well... I never graduated.

'Turning the marketplace into a splendid bastion of culture'? That's just the copywriter spinning words around. All I am is a humble tuner. But you can find so many examples of remarkable creativity cast aside in a forgotten corner, unnoticed by others. I do my little part in gathering them up and playing them for children to appreciate.

Can you take a look at this proposal? Basically, I'll set Arts to play different background music in different areas, which will improve everyone's experience at leisure and work. I've left this area empty, because I thought you should set your own playlist for sleepless nights.

I come from a small town where tourism is the main industry. I designed the music of every nook and cranny in the marketplace, so the melody will follow you with every step you take. Oh, there is even a famous blindfolded musical pathfinding competition with a decent prize pool. You should have a go, Doctor. Me? No, I'm one of the judges.

Sorry. Criticism of music is best left to listeners and creators. I'm simply a tuner with perfect pitch, and I know my place. They say one only understands the importance of talent once one has worked hard. Well, I know I have no talent, so there's no need for me to work that hard.

Are you looking for the source of the music? It's the musical enchantment on this cup. Most music in Leithanian cities are created with Arts. From statues to fountains to murals, virtually anything can become a device for playing music. Would you care for a drink? I recommend this song to pair with anything alcoholic.

Umm… Leave it to me. I'm used to observing the traces left behind by other people's work, and experiencing the persistence, joy and excitement therein. I can see the commitment in your to-do list, Doctor.
Looks like we're both a step closer to our goal. Let's celebrate this with a Columbian high-five! We've got a long way to go in the days to come.

Today is your birthday, and I think it would do you good to set work aside for a while and go out for a walk. The landscapes of Sargon are spectacular, but you didn't seem to have time for them. Come, consider today's excursion my gift to you.
What challenge do you have for me today, Doctor?

Happy New Year, Doctor. How would you like to celebrate the holiday? Are we going with Sargonian tradition, or Columbian custom, or do you have some other arrangement in mind? Either way, I'm with you.
Curious about my sword? Here, try it out. Oh, and be careful about the spring blade in the staff.
Be careful, or my horns might hurt you.
Ah… It's been a long time since I've had a solid roof over my head.
Defeat is but the herald of victory. Let's pull back for now.
No, I can't be content with the limitations of my sword. For the sake of my tribe.
Victories like these are what Sargonian warriors live for.
I always knew I would win a memorable victory someday.
Take this!
I have more than one weapon.
In the name of the wilds!
In the name of the Qarnsayf!
Do you know what these horns signify?
I hope it's a worthy foe.
What tactics do you want me to use?
My turn, finally.
Which weapon would you like to be on the receiving end of?
Is your equipment ready? It all comes down to this—time to fight!
Like the wilds of Sargon, the battlefield is more dangerous than it looks. Make sure you know what you're doing.
An opportunity to try out some new moves.
You honor my tribe when you honor me. Thank you for the recognition.
I'm still a very long way from my goal, but please accept my gratitude.
Sargon warriors say that combat is the way to grow, but I can learn in this way too. Let's get started.
Hello, Doctor. I'm Hadiya, descendant of the Sargonian Qarnsayf tribe. I've come to study at Rhodes Island in order to overcome the challenges that the wilds have set for me.
You can rest safely here. We're not in the wilds.

My dream is to host a martial arts tournament in Sargon, and gather all the warriors from all the lands, so they can share in the glory of the Qarnsayf. You should come too, and bring the best of Rhodes Island with you! Yeah, it's a promise, Doctor!

At first, there weren't many tribes who believed I'm actually descended from the Qarnsayf. Can't blame them, considering how the legend has faded from history. You believed me from the start? Oh… I mean, thank you…
Remember, it's vital to stay hydrated, Doctor. Once you spend a whole month in the wilds of Sargon, during the dry season, without seeing so much as the mirage of an oasis… you'll get it.

The padishahs and local warriors look down on Columbian composite swords, just because they're designed for urban combat. But I'll show them the potential of combining modern technology with traditional tactics someday.
That's true. I've lost a few fights with those ameeri guards, and sometimes it wasn't even close. But there's still time, I'll get my chance.
Uh… thank you. I'm having a hard time getting used to this Sargonian alcohol. I miss Columbian kale soda.
Isn't Kestrel's weapon just awesome? The way she wields it is so different from any other weapon. I'd love to spar with her, to learn her style, when I get the chance.
I bear a duty to my tribe, and I will see it through to the end. Tribal heritage is a pretty distant thing to a girl who grew up in Columbia, but the doubts of a few lords ameer won't discourage me!
Doctor, would you like to study the languages and lifestyles of tribal Sargon with me? It'll be harder than combat training, for sure.

This was the walking stick that I used on my pilgrimage to Mount Karlan with the Saintess. I took it to bathe in the purest lake water, and in the first ray of dawn atop the peak. May it keep you safe on your path towards the future you seek.

I don't know what a working adult like you might want for your birthday, but I gave a chain like this to my parents before, made from the tooth of the first quarry I hunted. They were very happy. This bead chain will keep you safe. Happy birthday, Doctor.
Doctor, have you seen the Rift Cloudbeast anywhere? I've been looking for it since morning. It ate my breakfast.

Thank you for letting me bring my siblings here to celebrate the new year! They don't get to leave Kjerag very often and they're really enjoying their time here. I'm taking them to try the special dishes that the other Operators have prepared. Thank you so much!
Oh no, the Rift Cloudbeast is chewing on your hood again…
Whoa! Careful, I strike back on reflex!
Mm… it's warm here. Almost too warm!
Let's go, Doctor! The smell of blood will draw more beasts!
Rift Cloudbeast, go find some herbs that can stop bleeding!
By Kjeragandr, we have our game. Let's go home!
I've never seen a quarry this big… did we really catch it?
One shot, one kill.
Set the trap, and wait…
Fresh dung, not yet covered in snow… it was here not long ago.
Broken icicles… we've got a big one.
Hide your smell.
I have bait.
Do you hear footsteps?
Do you see the game?
Look at the tracks they left in the snow…
Shh. Don't disturb the beasts.
Stay close. The snowy mountains can be dangerous to newcomers.
Do you need help hunting game?
I don't quite understand what the health exam report says, but I know I haven't gotten worse. You saved my life, and Kjeragandr's blessings will be with you.
What's this badge for? Oh… I get paid more when I have it? I see! Thank you!
Everyone's really good!
I came because the Saintess says you can treat my disease. Do you need a hunter? I can take out a beast three times the height of a grown man with a single shot!
Kjeragandr on high, hear my prayer… keep them safe, keep them healthy.

You want to go hunting with me? Alright, let me first step up my training… why? There's no way you can track anything in the snowy mountains on your own. I'll need to get strong enough to carry you on my back the whole way.

You get punished when you do something bad. The Rift Cloudbeast stole your snacks because I didn't keep a good eye on it. We'll banish ourselves, according to the rules of my house. Don't try to stop me—huh? You're saying the rule here for cloudbeasts is just three days of petting time with you? You're the master of this house, and you wouldn't lie to me. Here you go!

Doctor, help me put the strand from the left side on top of the one in the middle, then do the same with the hair on the right side and weave them together—no, it's all wrong again! This is completely different from how the Saintess did it… do you actually know how to braid hair, Doctor?

When I go back, I'll tell my siblings that Oripathy isn't something to be feared. Their big sister is strong as ever and still carries her heavy crossbow around. Oripathy isn't a punishment from Kjeragandr. She guides and does not punish…

The craftsmen know that Kjeragandr's eyes must be deep, for She sees a thousand miles. Her hands must be delicate, for She heals whatever wounds She touches. But these ideas were formed from our sculpting, one chisel at a time. At the end of the day, tomorrow depends on our own eyes and hands.

Legends tell of a creature that points the way for hunters lost in the blizzards. It is mysterious and beautiful—no, not this one on my shoulder. It got lost while following me, hoping to pick up scraps from my hunt. I call it the Rift Cloudbeast. Cool, isn't it? Wait, no, no, no, not the Doctor's hood! You can't eat that!

Apology Letter: I'm sorry, instructor. A hunter takes only what she needs. If she fails to kill with one single shot, it is not hunting, only meaningless killing. This is the rule that Kjeragandr set for the snowy mountains… and the reason I put a hole in the training target, I guess…

Whoa! Head up, chest out, swing your tail—good! Treating my disease is something that deserves the greatest gratitude a hunter can give. Look how this leporibeast snorts and kicks! It's the strongest that I've hunted. I'm not sure why the medics won't accept it…
You want me to watch over your work, like I keep an eye on my siblings while they do their homework? Sure. I'll make you run ten laps in the snow if you don't finish on time.

Anything that mankind can gain from these stacks of paper pales in comparison to the reality offered by planting your feet on the ground or gazing up at the stars. I look forward to witnessing more miracles in the mists of the unknown… both at Rhine Lab… and at Rhodes Island.

Happy Birthday! I have a present for you—a planetarium I made myself, by hand! When I was a kid, my parents wouldn't let me make them, and it took me so much work just to fix one myself. Come, switch off the lamp and check this out. It even lights up! You think it's a little cliché? Come on, Doctor. Don't say that, even as a joke.
Hey, Doctor. Do you have time to come to the lab and check out my latest breakthrough?

Hello Doctor. The lab's too suffocating, so I came out here for a little fresh air. Are you here for a break, too? Hm? Happy New Year? Wait, is it past midnight already?! I was gonna head out with Sia and get some snacks… Oh well, it can wait. Happy New Year, Doctor!
Don't let anybody know I'm slacking off—wait, you didn't know? Drat...
Let me set my alarm.
Oh, don't worry. Once we identify the source of the problem, we'll get this taken care of, easy.
Huh? This variable…
A victory meeting expectations after careful planning. Now we can all relax.
Incredible commanding, Doctor! Hm? My performance is incredible, too? That's giving me too much credit. I came prepared, that's all.
There is no limit to the power that mankind may realize.
I will stop you.
I have charge of this sector.
I convey my starlight to the darkness.
In position.
Same tactics as before?
Yep, I'm here.
In position to engage the enemy. Ready your weapons.
Don't worry. I know our departure time.
'Switching firing position!'… Got everything memorized. We'll be fine.
Long time no see, everybody. Time to work together again.
Nothing exists independently of us. Rather, we observe and change everything. That's why I believe in science.
Huh, still the same medals as before. So pretty.
There's still room for improvement. Looks like I will have plenty to do once I get back.

It's great to see you again, Doctor. I reviewed my time onboard and my workflow at Rhodes Island. I'm pretty confident I can handle anything that comes my way. Hm? You've always been satisfied with my work? Hehe…
Huh? Is the Doctor asleep? Then I guess I'll take the chance to get a nap in, too.

In Kjerag, I witnessed a power that I couldn't comprehend for the first time. The further I walk down this path of science, the more I am pushing the boundaries of the unknown... Don't worry. I respect all explanations for the unknown, and I know I will one day demystify it.

Hm… Oh, hey, Doctor. This is an astrological star chart I got from Sia. I wanted to make some adjustments based on the observation data I got at Kjerag… Since when have I been interested in astrology, you ask? This too, is a field that those who walked before us explored. It may be riddled with errors, but that doesn't mean it's completely devoid of value.

Not long ago, my parents sent my sister a long letter and a whole bunch of goodies from our hometown, meant for me. I may not have made up my mind yet, but… Doctor, do you have any gift ideas for old-fashioned types?

There was a researcher in Kjerag who told me he's afraid of new discoveries now, because of how they always shatter the framework of current science. I know not everyone who believes in science looks forward to its changes, but me? I always love seeing the new possibilities.

Pramanix's a really good friend. I doubt I'll ever revere Kjeragandr as much as she does, or anyone from Kjerag, but I can feel just how crystal clear and resilient their minds are. For real, this is god's presence.

My coworkers at Rhine Lab like to tell our new staff how I used to be, half-jokingly. Stuff like how I insisted on recording data even during a liquid Originium leak, but that 'just because something is dangerous doesn't mean it's important.' Gotta say, I'm actually pretty miffed about that. Whether it was actually important or not is something we'll have to wait for the future to find out.

Kjerag? I like the place. Everyone there takes really good care of me. When I was testing Originium samples with my local assistants, they all suddenly bowed their heads in unison. It kind of freaked me out, and it wasn't until later that I found out they were praying to Kjeragandr for me and the experiment.

It's so much easier working at Rhodes Island than the observation station. You have no idea how busy things get there! Not only do I have to pull all-nighters, but everyone's always coming to me for help. They even said they'd push for me to become a section director… You think I'll make a good director? Hehe, it's still too early for me to think about that.
I'm used to being your assistant, so I bet I can take care of any work you throw at me. But don't you pile everything on me just because I said that!

Rhodes Island's cause will reshape the fabric of this land. This point may be beyond the comprehension of most, but I am not most men. I believe we have both heard our fair share of similar comments, but remember: those who truly have the ability to change this land are often those arrogant and conceited enough to think themselves able to do so.

A meeting between Karlan Trade and the General Chamber of Commerce? You are frightfully knowledgeable about my schedule. But it is clear that today, I, SilverAsh, have much more important plans. There is no doubt you are worth a blemish or two upon the Silverash name. Happy birthday, my ally. How do you wish to spend the day?
You haven't weathered one bit, my friend.

Enya is very happy aboard Rhodes Island. With Ensia to accompany her, I daresay it might be the happiest time of her life… I shall avoid intruding upon them. I will say, you are the only one who could make such a suggestion without crossing a line. Let us head out to enjoy the snow. Happy New Year, my ally.
…I am awake.
If you are ever in the mood for some chess, I shall be happy to oblige.
A new beginning, yet not an unwelcome one.
Ultimate victory will not be decided by a single check. Do not miss the chessboard for the squares.
Am I to believe you did this intentionally…?
An astonishing result. And here I thought myself inured to you bringing home victory.
Has this battle left you unsatisfied? I eagerly anticipate seeing you dictate the flow of an even grander chessboard.
…As ice yields to gentle warmth's embrace.
Wait, for the snow shall bury this all…
Thy trampling of this hallowed ground shall beget bitter rue.
Hark! Ne'er hast thou questioned the road thou'st strayed upon.
Everything is under control.
The situation is crystal clear.
Make your decision, fast.
Great minds think alike.
The outcome has already been decided. They simply cannot see it yet.
How nostalgic…
They shall learn whom they face.
I have learned some new tricks, since the last battle.

How shall this cooperation of ours end? Will the two of us conquer all of Terra together, or will we face each other across a board near-finished, our conflict inexorable? No matter where the dice may fall, we await the outcome with bated breath.
When you accepted my proposal, did you not suspect Rhodes Island was becoming part of my schemes? Then again, you rather enjoy this sort of challenge.
I have always found Rhodes Island's methods quite… refreshing.

It has been quite a while. The land teems with misfortune, but neither Kjerag nor Rhodes Island have fallen to the floor just yet. Are you ready? I believe we can re-establish our old rapport rather quickly. I, SilverAsh, have joined your cause as a sworn ally.
…The snowfall hath relented. Let us go for a walk outside.

Ohh? You are worried. Those in power cannot take the weight of responsibility lightly, but neither can they allow it to hold them back. At times, you need only make decisions, then entrust the rest to others. There is nothing simpler, yet more difficult. A lonely life? No, though I do look forward to having an opponent who could stand shoulder-to-shoulder with me.

Ensia cherishes her friendship with you. Asking you to take care of her was, at the time, a somewhat unreasonable request of mine, but now I see that there could not have been a better choice. Let us not speak of the barriers between her and me. Rather than reaching any so-called understanding, I would much rather see which peak she decides to conquer next.

There is no such thing as a chessboard without uncertainty. In a sense, every move we make is a gamble. Only when maximizing one's odds of success do one's wits come into play. Ah, the burdenbeast I bet on crossed the line first. According to custom, you are to down your glass.

Kjerag seeks to build ever-greater institutions, but we shall not stand tall among the nations because of them. When we faced a true crisis, I began to believe in the strength inherent in the people of the Snow Realm. I must admit, Enya is right. It is not that I do not care for faith. I have simply long since found a belief of my own.

Those who seek power out of cowardice shall find nothing at the apex of authority. As for me? My friends and enemies both ensure I am unlikely to forget the importance of how I conduct myself. But I am dearly looking forward to the day I take the final step towards the peak, and find myself standing opposed to you.

I've met with the Speaker, yes. Those of similar ideals face similar issues, perhaps even similar… kin? When Father left for Victoria, he would never have imagined a future where that nation was to be our enemy. It was indeed a simpler time, one to which we may never return.

When I was surveying the land to find a suitable site for the observation station, I already understood the sight of it would attract numerous gazes. In this era of radical change, those timid conservatives and ignorant opportunists will meet similar fates in the dustheap. But I, SilverAsh, must ensure Kjerag is never again left behind by the times.

Gnosis and Degenbrecher have taken over my Karlan Trade duties. Since this was not what I originally promised for their careers, they understandably have some complaints. There is not always a clean boundary between method and aim, but when I used this sword of mine to cleave the bridges behind me, I saw it, clear as day.
Your time and sanity should be left to more consequential matters. Surely you can find someone suitable to handle these trifles in your stead? Very well. For you, I shall happily serve.

The snow atop the Matterhorn's peak did not fall in a single day. The road ahead is much the same. Rhodes Island has been following this path for so long, what could possibly be left to bar your way? Forge ahead. My blessing shall be with you forevermore.

I expect the gifts you receive will be enough to fill a small dormitory, so… Hold out your hand. The first snowflake to descend upon Rhodes Island shall fall into your palm. Before it melts away, it shall be my gift to you.

The same arrangement as last time. You don't tell anyone I'm here, and you provide me with a blanket… Oh, this one's my favorite. You actually remembered…? Haha… It's like we're of one mind, when it comes to sneaking away for a nap.

Happy New Year, Doctor. Old Kjerag custom dictates that I spend the entire night atop Mount Karlan praying for Kjeragandr's blessings, but… It's a rare day off for me, so let's not speak of work today, shall we? Hm?
Here, a pat on the head… A blessing? No, this is not the Saintess's blessing, but Pramanix's. It is, in a sense, the rarer of the two.
'Kjeragandr on high, smite those who play pranks by depriving them of snacks with their afternoon tea.'
Have you widened this place since last time?
…The snow shall cover our tracks, and grant us the chance to return.
…In the end, our gain is greater than our loss. Before the snow hides their footprints, we must discern which bad habits it is time to let go.
'After hard work comes a good night's rest.' The Saintess decrees it so.
Karlan has witnessed this victory. O warriors clad in frost and gale, let us return home.
Your struggles are feeble.
Behold the power the mountains pledged to me.
Ice and snow know not mercy.
Cold winds care not for whom they chill.
Pray with all your heart.
Hear Her words.
She cannot be sought.
She is omnipresent.
You shall go no further…
May the unclean be purified, and the blizzards dispersed.
I shall guide you in Her stead.
Victory belongs to the faithful.
'Of what has been gained, renounce it all. Of what has been lost, forget it all. We need only strive for truth and question ourselves, and in the end, we shall return to Her embrace.'
No, no more gifts or ornaments, please. A Saintess's garb is heavy enough as it is. You want me to feel light and breezy, don't you?
'When in snow, seek the footprints of those heading forward'. This is the simple wisdom of Kjeragandr.

Amidst the undying winds of the Snow Realm and the unending fall of snow, Pramanix of Kjerag now stands before you… How's that for a preamble? Now let me in already, we'll have plenty of time for greetings later.

Hm? Documents that need to be signed? Err… The Doctor is currently in an emergency meeting, would it be alright if these got back to you later? Alright, I shall pass them on for you… *phew* Getting an afternoon nap is no small task for Dr. {@nickname}.

'Merciful Kjeragandr'… She has clearly run off to that snowy mountain to fool about… Perhaps once Her spirit has recovered, She will awaken once more. How will Kjerag have changed in that time? If there really are gods, then please, help her find a way back home.

You'd like to help me comb my hair? Nmph… it wouldn't be an easy job. If it weren't for Kjarr and the other maids, I don't know how much time I'd have to spend each day caring for it. I've considered cutting it short, but I understand some of the people would be sad if I did, so…

There aren't enough funds for dormitory maintenance? Allow me to make a donation in the name of the Vine-Bead Court. The funds shall come from the personal account of the president of Karlan Trade—ah, no, no need for that. The medical support Rhodes Island has given the people of Kjerag is plain for all to see. Sir Enciodes won't utter a single complaint.

It is not that Kjeragandr taught us virtue, but that She is made manifest through the virtue in our hearts. So too does all sloth and sin find release through this understanding. She shall not scold you, for recognizing oneself is a difficult thing, and She will always show a path through the wind and snow for her children.

What is a miracle, you ask? Hm, who knows? Perhaps a gust of night wind, or a beautiful rainbow, so long as it inspires the devout and puts fear into the heart of sinners. When you feel troubled and know not what to do, pray, and the divine in your heart shall give you strength.

Why do foreign envoys still believe Kjerag to be a land of spirits and sprites…? Hmph, it leaves me no choice but to meet their expectations, and take on a most fearsome form. 'If you do not wish to be snatched away by the Tschäggättä, then you must show some sincerity.' That will make them good little ambassadors who sign our agreements.

Hm? Oh, this? This is something I knitted for Ensia's birthday in my spare time. It's like when I was little, Father and I would knit new cloaks or scarves for the entire family every three years… I know what you want to ask, but please don't.

During my days at the Vine-Bead Court I would clamber up and down ladders to consult ancient records and scripture as thick and heavy as bricks. Based on past Saintess selections, the girl who is to become Saintess must have a strong, healthy body. Hm, I believe I've figured out the reasoning behind these traditions.

Serve as your assistant…? Hm, from what I have seen, there is not much difference between administrative work and organizing the scriptures of the Vine-Bead Court. I know how to do it, but… are you sure there are not more important things for me to do?

Here at Rhodes Island, my research enjoys success after success, and the sick benefit from better medicines developed on my results. The fact that these things actually happen here has swept me off my feet countless times… Seeing my work come to fruition, and how it makes this place a better one, has left me greatly satisfied.

While I do think preparing a birthday present for my superior is somewhat odd, it is still something I would like to do. It was you who gave me the hope I needed to continue with my research, starting when you chose to enter that mine in search of remaining specimens… I have been grateful to you ever since.
Hello, Doctor. The experiment is proceeding smoothly. Here. I used hot tea to keep my mind clear and warm myself back in Ursus.

We never celebrated this holiday when I was at the research institute. The passage of time held no special meaning to us, aside from the little headway we were making on our projects. But now… I wish to believe it means the day I see results is all the more closer.
Would you care for a warm cup of tea?
Oh?! Sorry, I thought you were someone else. Forgive me for hitting you with that file…
Such a warm room…
A failure? No, no, no, how could this be? Please, a little more time! I promise no more problems next time!
I will begin investigating the error at once. You may put your faith in me.
The hypothesis holds. The report will be on your desk shortly.
L-Look, Doctor! We succeeded! Has… Has the day finally come?
Performing data derivation.
Marking significant trends.
Calculating standard deviation.
Removing outliers.
Initiating data collection.
Control group ready.
Do you have a new conjecture?
What is your hypothesis?
Remember, sample the data every twenty minutes.
Readings are coming through… Beginning recording and graphing.
I am to oversee this project? Understood.
The materials are ready.

I have been looking for you all day, Doctor. Look, my paper was published in a Columbian journal. My research is heading in the right direction! Huh? I am smiling, am I…? It seems I truly am happy now.
Receiving such a formal memo scared me half to death, but thankfully, it was not a directive to cease my experiments… You have my deepest gratitude, Doctor. I shall continue with my research.
It seems I am not the only one giving everything to survive. Everyone does the same.
I thank all of Rhodes Island, Doctor, for taking me in, and I also thank you for… giving me a laboratory where I will not be disturbed.
I am simply transcribing some data, and you have fallen asleep. Is the sound of my writing really so soothing?

Alcohol is a fine thing. It warms the body and dulls the mind, and you need not think about whatever is happening outside... It is too warm here, and I do not rely on it to get through the day now. What should I rely on next, Doctor? Can you tell me?

'The youngest of the genius researchers'. I once held such a title with pride, but if you were to swing a pick anywhere in the Far North and break the frozen earth, you would find the Originium dust the corpses of those geniuses have become. At times, I am glad I managed to escape that place... but have I truly escaped?

Back in Chernobog, Professor Ilia would try to cram knowledge into my brain as quickly as possible, Director Kal'tsit and the others would perform their calculations without rest, while every day I lived in fear of the punishments I would suffer for any mistake… Who would have thought those would be the best days of my life?

Back in the Far North, I thought that by following you, I would escape that endless expanse of ice and snow. Even if I were to leave a suicide note, it would have only made for kindling. I had to go with you. You people are mad for doing what you did in Ursus. But perhaps I, too, have long fallen to madness.

The polar nights of Ursus are near-endless, to the degree that even if I were to light every lamp, I would still find myself yearning desperately for the tiniest sliver of daylight, the faintest glimmer of hope. Perhaps I followed you here thinking only of proving myself more than a failure in life.

Do I need help? No, I am fine, I know how to key data into the terminal. It's just that… Once this data is in the terminal's system, others can delete it or classify it with a press of a button. Writing it down on paper allows me to feel a little more relaxed.

Oh! My apologies for bumping into you, my glasses fogged up suddenly… I thought I could walk back to my workbench like this, but I was carrying so many things, I had no free hand to wipe my glasses. I'll just stand here until they clear up…

Please don't mind me, Rhodes Island's laboratories are excellent, and there have been zero issues with the equipment. I keep rearranging it because… Ahem, I never thought I would have a workbench of my own again.

The data from Experiment 36? Second cabinet from the left, in the blue folder. The error report? The document at the very top of the pile behind you. As for the mathematical formulae, they are in the left drawer of your desk. Are there any other files you need? Please, feel free to ask for my help.

Since I was small, I always thought—I thought, pain wasn't so bad. Maybe I, deserve the pain. But—what about others? What about the people in places I've, never been? They shouldn't have to suffer. Rhodes Island… has given me a lot of 'painkillers', and I want to, share them with more people.
There are so many, presents on the table… ah, Doctor! When did you get back? Th-This necklace? It's an amulet I made, with colorful stones. I wanted to—here, for you. Happy birthday.
D-Doctor, you're right on time… oh, I, ah, just arrived too.

Towards, the left, da… ah, it's crooked again. Higher on the right… just a little—yes, perfect! Thank you, for helping me, put up these festival, decorations, Doctor! We'll get to, ring in the new year, soon, so… would you like to, give it a try?
Once upon a time, there was a… snowman who got, lost… have you, heard this story before?
Could you… l-let go, please!
This place is… so warm.
W-We have to go back, some of our comrades are still… out there!
Everyone… stay close to me.
C-Can we take a break now?
We… did it?
I-It's time!
Just, just hold on for a while longer…
Fifty-nine, sixty. One, two… deep breaths…
Seven hundred and twenty-three, Seven hundred and twenty-two, Seven hundred and twenty-one… live on…
D-Don't come any… closer.
Don't be scared!
I… got it!
I… can do it!
Watch out.
Please, be careful and… stay safe.
Sound… the alarm!
Oh, okay.
This badge is for—me? But I haven't done enough. There's still so many Infected… I will help… many more people! Um, yes. You're right, we're… all in this together.
I'm not scared of… hardship, or pain, either! I'll work hard… and train even more, you can… trust me on this.
I just… need to k-keep everyone safe… and that's all, right?
H-How do you do, Doctor! Everyone calls me… Vetochki, um—oh, yes! It means twig in Ursine!
You've been working for, so long… Do you need to rest for a bit…? I will remember… to wake you up.

N-No, I wasn't spacing out! I was counting… down until the sun sets. I don't want to… see it go away. In the north, the sun is, precious, and I'm scared it won't come back one day—it will, tomorrow? And y-you're, willing to stay with me… until it comes back up? Really?

H-Have you heard this story? Parents go out to shovel snow, but soon, someone knocks on the door. The child goes to open the door, and sees a manglerbeast standing, just as we do— I will never— no, it's not just because of Babushka Nadia. Y-You're right. Real family, wouldn't force me to, open the door.

This letter, and the wheat ear inside it, they sent it to me, from the border. Happy? Da. I thought, everyone would separate, and never see each other again. Strange, whenever I think about their smiles, my eyes... well up with tears. Huh? That's... not weird?

When you, speak into a cave, there's always a strange response. When I laugh, it laughs. When I'm mad at it, it's mad at me. Actually, some people are like the caves—Rankin, he saw too many… complicated things, and in the end… he became complicated too.

In the mines, it's very easy to, lose track of time. So I stay outside, helping them to count. They can't stay there too long, or they'll… die. One hundred and eleven, one hundred and twelve, one hundred and thirteen… like that. I count my numbers really, smoothly? Ah—whuh?
S-Sound, the alarm? You want me to, show you how we work in the mines…? Okay. Actually, it's not really a bell we ring, but it's… really loud. No, you have to, cover your ears. You must.

Wh-What's in my hand? No, not herbs, a, a kind of moss. The miners, they use it to light fires, and also, make tea. It looks pretty? Da. On the tundra, it's really easy to see, so everyone picked all of them long ago. This is… the last bunch I have, and I… want to keep it.
S-Sorry… I speak so slow. D-Doctor Warfarin said it can be, cured, but it will take… very long. It's okay, I'm already… used to it. Um, I just hope you're not… annoyed.
I-I can read these… let me help you.

I would not have stayed this long, if I only intended to repay Dr. Kal'tsit for what she did. Sargon's golden sands brought me up, while the icy Ursine snow tempered me, but it is Rhodes Island's sturdy deck that molded me into who I am today. And so I have decided to stay here to watch over the place.

I've booked the white noise room for you today. If you'd like to try a new relaxation method once the noise has died down over here, you may go over to take a look. The reservation log is already reflected on your terminal, and the frequencies have been adjusted to your liking as well. Enjoy your day, Doctor.
(After nodding to each other, the two of you enjoy a cozy moment of silence)

Bootlegging of pigment from Laterano, witnessing gold bars growing legs and vanishing into Kazdel… we Elite Operators are used to sharing stories from the past year's field missions on this night. I'm sure you've missed some of the stories, so I'll try my best to patch any holes along the way, Doctor. Have a seat, if you'd like.
Try again. This time I'll pretend I didn't notice you beforehand.
Need something?
It's time to rest.
I've jammed their tracers. Leave, now!
I've sent their remaining units' positions to our cleanup squad's terminal. It's over, Doctor.
(Nods in approval)
The enemy has nowhere to hide. An inevitable result, with perfect command.
Target detected.
Resistance is futile.
There is no rejecting my intrusion.
Follow my voice.
A carefully deliberated dispatch.
I will pass it on.
If we must be covert.
Let me know how far I should probe.
A clear battle plan.
If you must.

The promotion process for Elite Operators is still the same, the only change being our reviewer. It was the Speaker, then Dr. Kal'tsit, and now you. It may not be the best time to say this, but welcome back, Doctor.

Elysium offered to simulate the promotion process for me, claiming to be more experienced than me in this field. But now I suspect he may have been buying time to avoid training. Once this is over, I'll have a little 'chat' with him.
If Outcast were there, we would've routed the enemy much quicker… You want to see older battle records? I know where to find them.

Before the authorizations were modified, I would take orders from you directly. Don't worry, my communications support equipment may have been upgraded, but I won't intrude into your consciousness without prior approval.
Hello, Doctor. I did not mean to disturb your rest, but Amiya wants to remind you there is still work that needs doing.

Blaze and Rosmontis both keep mementos from those around them. When they came to me, I gave Blaze a signal receiver, while Rosmontis got a transmission disc. Me? I don't keep anything. I don't commit to saving a memory I never intend to forget.

Doctor. I'm not angry, just emptying my mind to recover some energy. I've come to the age where I have to gasp for breath every few words, after all. Alright, the last one was a joke. It was Dr. Kal'tsit who recommended this method, even if she didn't practice it herself. She always had too much on her mind.

'Beware the Caster who can make you writhe in pain, puking your guts out, without lifting even a finger.' This is true to some extent, but my squad members ardently objected and rushed to refute it. Elysium says it is very important to tell the truth about me… ah, the youth.

The departed connect our past to present. Only with this, can we have a future. Someone once said, 'this is the meaning of sacrifice', but I disagree. Do not leave your names behind in such a pragmatic fashion, do not turn your actual life to abstraction, and do not deify suffering and death.

A pair of wizened hands, comforting farmers, traders, soldiers, even lords ameer and padishahs. All those seeking answers only to fall into chaos without exception, suffering ceaseless fear or ecstasy, and descent into disorder. I know, the line separating me from the Yurodstvo used to be indistinguishable.

I can tell when perception fails to match words. Similar to how Raidian works, it's more detecting lies than reading minds. The difference is that I am a certified psychological counselor, while she is innately gifted in the comprehension and evocation of emotion.

These marks on my hand? They are remnants of my past, a senseless attempt to turn a human body into an Arts Unit. I grew weary of Sargon before these mystic Arts could cover my entire body. As they receded like the tide, so did my memories, with only these fragments to remind me of the place I once called home.

I've always 'filtered' the mental burden of using my Originium Arts just as Amiya does. You may visualize the process as looking for something stable to grasp while falling endlessly through a void. You've noticed her doing it? It was you who gave her the courage to fall in the first place, Doctor.
I won't abuse your authorization. From now on, I will listen in.
It's so lively outside. Are you sure you're not going...? You're staying in? Okay.
Happy... birthday. This is… your present.
Doctor. I didn't have any nightmares, last night... What about you?
I was on stage just now... No, not Ave Mujica. The Rhodes Island play. I was a tree.
I'm practicing.
What is it?
I'll be... right here.
I... messed things up again...
Thank you for... covering for me...
I didn't... fail this time.
Thank goodness.
Just do it like I practiced.
Just don't... think at all...
These enemies aren't all that scary.
I'll try...
I can't... fail.
I've got no... choice...
I'm prepared.
I'm... ready.
Enemies... they're coming.
Let's get started.
I think... Saki should be better...
You're... praising me...
I need... more practice...
I can tell... this isn't just for show. These people, they really died.
Mutsumi Wakaba... Nice to meet you.
Did I wake you up? Sorry.
Here, nobody recognizes... Minami-chan and Ta-kun...
Saki once said... we're all 'badgers in the same hole'.
So you... also waver, and can't make up your mind... I... do that a lot...
Heheh... It's nice to... meet expectations.
I got this fragrance from Perfumer-san. She says Gloria uses it too.
You want me to play the guitar? Okay.
Vegetables... could grow well here.
Since when was I in the Activity Room...? Since... before you came in...
If there's nothing to do, I'll... be here.
Must be the Nyamuchi influence livening up Rhodes today, no doubt about it. Where's my thanks, Doc? Thank me~!
Happy birthday~! Here you go, a present for you. Now, can I expect something nice when Nyamu's day rolls around?
Nice work out there, Doc!
Happy New Year! Another year of heading onward and upward for me! That's right, you too, Doc, onward and upward♪
Hey, chill out, chill out~
Oh, wow! This is a killer spot you Rhodies have got!
Are you gonna be a downer? 'Cause we need to think about what went wrong and why.
Grrgh... Next time, I'll nail it...
Total victory! This means time for an afterparty! C'mon, let's do it!
Ahahah! We make a seriously great team, huh?
Nuh-uh-uh!
Let's turn up the energy!
Take that!
I'll show you what I'm really made of!
I got this~
C'mere, c'mere!
Hmm? Need me?
I'm right here~
Ah, enemy spotteeeed!
Okay, showtime~
Wait, so I'm leading? Not Sakiko?
That's right, I've been putting in tons of work, yeah? Keep that praise coming my way, yeah?
What's this? Oh, I get it, you're in with the Nyamuchi fans now?
Hell yeah~♪ Can't stop Nyamuchi evolving~
Good morn-nyamu-nyamu! New hire Nyamuchi reporting in! Nice to meetcha♪
Huuuh. Doc fell asleep. Well, if you're asking to get pranked, who am I to say no? Nah, kidding♪

I keep thinking lately. About reaching my goals. 'Cause doing whatever it takes, grinding away all on my own, that's been me. But hey, maybe it's nice to detour a little too, once in a while. That might be because everyone at Rhodes Island is so nice.
So like, a ton of the kids in Medical are fans of me now! So I'm thinking, rule no.1, gotta give the fans what they want, right?
No way! Do you see all the cute ops here at Rhodes Island?! SO blessed! Just need to get them in a makeup vid... Ahah, I can see the views rolling in already!

Whaaat? You've got more work for me? Alright, but in exchange... No, nonono, I'm kidding! If you and Amiya-chan are gonna put your trust in me like that, what am I to do but nyam-up and work my butt off!
Why do I volunteer for practice? Obviously you give everything you've got for your dream, right?
You ever notice how Rhodes Island is just full of all kinds of operators? Everyone's got their own goals, their own talents, it's a real show. I kinda wanna get stuck in and interview around!
I'm kiiiiiiinda busy right now, save it for later~
Oh, my god! If I did a vlog in here I might rake in major views, maybe? No, c'mon, obviously I'm not really!
Ah, Doc! Say, anything need doing?

When I first got here, I thought I was practically useless. But Rhodes Island is such a warm place, isn't it? It takes in any point of view, it gave me a role that I could play―I guess what I'm saying is, maybe I've earned the right to pride myself, as a member of Rhodes Island?

Happy birthday, Doctor! That tape's got a couple of songs on it. We wrote them for you, and for everyone at Rhodes Island. So even after we return to our old world someday, you'll still have these songs by your side forever.
Good timing, I was just brewing coffee. Do you want some?
Back in our world, everyone makes a wish on New Year's. Like this―you put your hands together, and close your eyes... If you have a wish, give it a try. It'll be nice if yours comes true too.
Doctor! Want to go see the stars together?
One moment, let me put my guitar away... Okay, sorry about that. What do you need, Doctor?
It's really nice in here, isn't it!
It's okay, I... I'll always be by your side.
I just hope nobody got hurt...
We're really getting into sync here!
After getting back, let's take a nice hot bath, put on some relaxing music, and really unwind.
Don't panic!
I'll cover you now!
Saki-chan, everyone, I'll protect you!
I'm going to sing.
To our victory... a paean.
To your curtain fall... an elegy.
Doctor, I'm trusting you.
I'll help out!
Don't let your guard down. We can definitely win this!
Be careful out there!
I've never been a leader to anyone before, but... I'll serve as a good example for you all!
As the squad's frontwoman, I'll lead the way for you all.
I don't know when I'll end up home again. Is it really okay for you to pour so much into me, despite that...? Alright, thank you. I'll be sure to work hard to meet your expectations, Doctor.
Rhodes Island's training program is incredible! I feel like it's building every part of me up at once. This is going to make concerts so much easier too!
Are these all... actual battles you taped?
Hello, I'm Uika... Misumi. Huh? You already heard about me from Saki-chan? How did she describe me, can you tell me?!
Maybe I'll brew some coffee and wait around until the Doctor wakes up?

Ending up in a strange place and having to bond with strange people has taken a lot of energy, I'll admit, but getting to learn so much in exchange has all been worth it. I still barely know right from left here, but... I'd like to keep on bonding with the people of Rhodes Island, I think.

Ave Mujica has always meant so much to Saki-chan. And knowing how she treasures it, I want to protect it for her... I want to keep being Mujica's frontwoman, where I can live, breathe, and embody Mujica's world.

Ever since coming to Rhodes Island, we members of Ave Mujica have been spending a lot more time together. Once work's done for the day, we head to the studio to practice... It's kind of like we're all in a school club.

I'd rather heal us all through music than fight. But... I get it. Becoming stronger is how I stay by Saki-chan's side. That's why I'll always keep putting in the effort, whether here on Terra or back in our world.
Sora-san always has such a warming effect on people, even when she's not performing. It'd be nice if I could fill everyone with that kind of warmth too.

The cap and sunglasses? They're for wearing in crowded places, I guess. I work in the performing arts, so I'm kind of... a celebrity? I guess... Wait, Doctor, could it be you're a celebrity on Terra? Heheh. Look, you always have the hood on.
Huh? You want me to teach you how to write lyrics...? Wait, Doctor, don't look at my terminal!

Lately, I've been stargazing on the deck with Astesia-san. The stars in Terra's sky are nothing like the ones I know. And when I tell her about our version of astronomy, I can almost see her hanging on every word I say.
It's funny, Umiri-chan always handles these things for us in Ave Mujica. So here, I have to adjust to managing my own schedule.

You know. Little by little I've opened up, here at Rhodes Island. Now I can put my own thoughts out there without worrying what others think of me. I have the people of Rhodes Island to thank for that, as well as you. So thank you, Doctor.
There you are. Doctor, happy birthday. Here's your cake and your present. I guarantee it'll be good. I've had that store's cake before.
Hello, Doctor. Want to head to training?
Doctor. Happy New Year. I'm looking forward to our new journey ahead.
Yes. I'm here.
So this is the area I can freely utilize? Where's the training room then?
Let's hustle. We're not going to leave anyone behind.
That was a close call. We need more practice under our belt.
That was some nice leadership, Doctor.
Mission complete. Couldn't have done it without you all.
Excuse me.
This is easy.
Right on target.
I expected this. Let's go.
Let's get going.
You want me to lead? Understood.
I'm happy that everyone at Rhodes Island has accepted me. Perhaps they might even be able to fulfill my wishes too, don't you think?
I'm just doing what I'm supposed to.
I like the efficiency. I'm taking notes.
Umiri Yahata. If you need anything, just ask.
Hmm... Doctor, I see you're still working at it. Here, a chocolate panna cotta to keep you going.
A boatloads of squads requested for me to help them out with things again. I'll work through each task one by one for everyone at Rhodes Island.
I know everyone at Rhodes Island has their own troubles, but they all prop each other up through whatever they're going through. I really owe a lot to them, especially you, Doctor. I'm very thankful.
These honey biscuits Ceobe-san likes are good. It's hard to stop eating them.

The relationship between you and Amiya-san is a good influence on everyone else. Just one of those Rhodes things. The people here all think of each other as family. I'm just as honored to be able to contribute.
As long as Rhodes Island is going to look after me, I owe it to your people to help you out.
No need for concern. Practice time and rest time are both fully blocked out on my schedule, and I've given myself plenty of leeway in my work hours. I'm never going to collapse.
Vigna invited me to see her perform live. She's got impressive guitar skills. I'm really looking forward to it.

I've noticed Rhodes Island's ops don't tend to hold back on strength or personality. But nobody clashes with anyone. They're all able to treat each other with respect. I don't know what to make of it, honestly.
You can leave that paperwork, I handled it already. Any issues, Doctor?
I'm honored I could greet this special day together with you. Since the moment we first arrived, the sight of us all striving for the same goal has done wonders for the spirit.

'Happy birthday to you'... I was taught this song when I was still young. In the days after I'd learned it, I would keep playing it every day to my heart's content... I may have perturbed Mother somewhat with that.
Good morning to you, Doctor. There is to be a masquerade tonight. Do come if time permits. We have a special seat waiting for you.

I happened to be in the training grounds this whole time, and only realized it was past midnight once I heard the cheering coming from outside... Allow me to give you my first greetings of the year, then—a very Happy New Year to you, Doctor.
Might I be of assistance in any way?
What a sanitary workplace. Its constant maintenance is all but evident.
I... hate myself.
Just a little more...!
That was a spectacular battle—well done to all of you.
I must commend you on your show of tactics just now... Was this victory just one more surprise, courtesy of you?
In this twilight paradise, I will continue to reign!
Even so, will you still seek solace?
The moon will press closer and closer on you.
The doll takes on a temporal life.
I have no time to waste on feeling lost.
Time will not wait for us.
Doctor, your decision please.
I'm sure you and I are drawing up the same plans right now, Doctor.
How bothersome...
Now, let's begin... tonight's masquerade!
I will spearhead my members and see our mission through, as I ever do. It is as simple as that.
It is time for our teamwork to be put to the test.
To be given recognition comes hand in hand with greater responsibility. However, I am of course prepared for that.
Compared to the other squad captains, I have a great deal I must learn still... I will henceforth devote my utmost efforts to keeping pace with you all.
Are our everyday activities going to be recorded on video too?
I am Oblivionis of Ave Mujica, Sakiko Togawa. Until we find a way back, I would be much obliged.

You can't forget how necessary rest is to improving results. During the fledgling days of Ave Mujica's formation, I'd often stay up working throughout the night. But Uika gave me a talking-to, and that was how I finally learned my lesson. *chuckle* 'It's not good for your health!' Her words.
Oh, this doll? I received it from Bena-san. *chuckle* When I place it by my side, I feel this sort of warmth cozying up inside me, somewhere near and dear to me.

Doctor, this is that 'bridge' I was telling you so much about! Here, you can shout everything that's on your mind out loud, and it feels amazing. I'll demonstrate for you first, so would you mind following my lead after? Here I go―

I had a dream, before I came to Rhodes Island even, that we were all living here, working here. I can recall it so vividly even now, as clear as any memory... Hence, when I greeted Vigna-san with a 'Nice to meet you', I couldn't help but feel a twinge of estrangement. *chuckle* Do keep this strictly between us, please?

I owe it to the days I've spent on Rhodes Island for reshaping my outlook on Terra. This vast land is filled with people living cruel realities that far surpass the imagination... I have a new resolve to see if I can reach these people, with songs that might nestle in their hearts.

Memories of dreams all fade away someday, don't they... Don't be mistaken, Doctor. I don't rue the fact for one moment. I know full well it was a life I never could have had in the first place... The chance to at least dream such a beautiful dream is more than enough for me.
We as band members do have disputes from time to time, but it's all in service of raising the band to greater heights. Ave Mujica is unshakable, you know.
You don't need to tell me―this is a 'soda fountain', isn't it? When you mix different drinks together, you can get surprisingly refreshing results, you know.

As a work institute, Rhodes Island is just outstanding. Strict yet flexible scheduling, rational evaluation criteria, a clear promotion track... Where did I learn to see things this way, you ask? Well, my... relations are quite versed in the field.
Your decision-making acumen is a great inspiration. Would you permit me to observe you for a while longer?

Finally tracked you down, Doctor! I've composed a haiku commemorating the year we've shared, understanding and supporting each other... Hah, glib? Certainly not. What about my new tanka? A recited one you say? Tsk Tsk, I bet something's troubling you. Don't worry, I'm here. I'll hear you out.

Happy Birthday, Doctor. Here, a coupon for 90% off at my bar/restaurant/convenience store/food-cart, today only... Just my little joke. Look on the back. Voucher of Wish-granting. Rather generous, isn't it? Feel free to wish away. Considering how wide my network in Mitsukue is, I'll be able to find someone to make it come true.
Irrashaimase, Doctor. Here, your usual, at your usual seat.

Oh, you're here too? Happy New Year! I normally take this day off, but old habits made me an early riser. Habit has me walking down a long road and climbing some tall stairs, all to see if that little one's returned... But that's a story for later, haha. Since you're here, Doctor, how about climbing those stairs with me?
Bored? How about some hanafuda?
Don't bother me, I'm still on the clock.
Wow, this place is incredible. It's like you made it the perfect spot for me to set up a few food stalls.
Heads up! Don't chase them. Safety first. I do still have a little shop in Mitsukue. If things don't work out, Doctor…
It's fine, a few ran away is all. Don't worry, I let some fake news slip out. We won't be looking over our shoulders.

Tonight, we've got chikuwa, radish, burdenbeast tendon and boiled fowlbeast eggs. Have as much as you want, on the house! Here's to a job well done, everyone! Drinks, though, those'll be going on your tab.
Doctor, you... rest up first. To get us out of that situation in one piece, and win, even... Burning yourself out like this can't be how you normally do things. It's all thanks to your efforts.
These gatecrashers are no customers. I'll invite them to leave.
Why must someone always kill the mood when we're enjoying our game?
Your private room. Please, enter.
Err, is this place safe? Why do I feel like there's people watching us from the shadows?
Is it my turn? Don't rush me, this hand needs to be dealt slowly.
No need to be so pushy, boss.
What can I get you, okyaku-sama?
Nrmph—Alright, let's get serious. There's work to do.
I specialize in information gathering, I am no generalist. When it comes to fighting... *sigh* Well, since you asked so nicely, watch me kill another thousand on my own.
You want me to command? Command these mighty warriors who could all level me in a fight? C'mon, give me a break here...
Alright, alright, I'll take care of everyone. I will say, I'm not much of a fighter. If it's discreet inquiries you want, then you've got the right man.

Oh...? Another promotion? For me? D-Doctor, there's nobody else here, so be honest with me. What do you actually want me to do? Let me make one thing clear, I won't be able to sniff out the Northern Court's secrets for you!
Such kindness and magnanimity! It is my pleasure to be able to help you. Seems my part-time travails were not suffered in vain.
Hmm, an exquisite arrangement. I should be able to put it to use in my side hustles.

Irrashaimase, okyaku-sama. Codename Matsukiri, at your service. I am but a humble barkeep and proprietor of a wandering food cart, and perhaps also an individual skilled in the finding of things. So, what is it you need from me right now, Doctor?
Where is everyone? So busy they forgot what time it is? Hmm, what should I sample from the liquor cabinet next...?

I've had too many chats today. Heard too many stories, said too many words, so I'm a little tired. Oh, don't mind me. Getting to stand with you under a vermilion sky, lost in our thoughts, is rest enough for me.

When I first set foot in the underworld, I upset some people I really shouldn't have, over some nearly worthless clues, and lost an eye for my indiscretions. Hardly a tale of fantasy and adventure, just the story of an idiot. It's ridiculous how that sort of thing turned my life around. Heh, what, you interested? Alright then. It all began one rainy night...

Tsk, back then, numbers like these were so monumentally oppressive, you'd throw yourself off a high-rise just to catch your breath. But in today's economy, they're gained and lost in a matter of seconds. Alright, I've decided. Doctor, I'm going to set up an education fund, to help out people like me who never finished school—Hey, wait, don't go!

The whole time I was mirage-chasing, I thought I was simply experiencing another story to tell, but I ended up tying threads of fate that connected us together. With the proprietors and customers of Mitsukue, with Hoshiguma, and with you... Ahem. Anyway, I won't dismiss our friendship just because we met during a bank robbery!

Every year, I would make the same wish at that shrine, but I'm not too sure what to wish for this year. I really envy that priest. Walking alongside the kami-sama should make life easier, right? Then again, every kami-sama's got a different personality, so if you run into one that's a real pain to work with...

Special report! I suggest heading to the canteen early today, Doctor, something nice awaits. And remember to go to your physical later, or you'll suffer for it. Also, watch your head when passing through the upper deck. Alright, I'll take one thousand for my troubles. When did I learn divination? Why, I just happened to overhear some chatter is all.

Today, a student working part-time asked me about information science. I'm not much of an expert, so I shared a few stories showing how I wheedle information out of the clients at my various jobs. He did say it'd be difficult for him to include them in his university summer report, but he still looked pretty satisfied.

Yes, I lost my sight in that one during the Bank of Mitsukue robbery. Indeed, there were two or three thousand who took part. Verily, it was an absolute bloodbath. There I was, protecting my little food cart, and with a single bamboo skewer, I killed a thousand men... Don't sweat the details. Enough about me, I'm here to hear your stories, Doctor. C'mon, out with them already.

All these documents need now is consolidation. I've put the references on the table, listed out the specifics, and also left some notes. Phew, the work for today and tomorrow is almost wrapped up… If you don't mind, I think I'll have a little nap…
After today is tomorrow. After tomorrow another tomorrow—come find me again tomorrow, Doctor.
Hey, Doctor, wanna know the plan for your birthday party? For this low, low price, I'll tell you what surprise Amiya has in store for you, and what 'surprise' Elysium has…
Irrashaimase... oops, I guess I let the old habits slip in. What brings you here, Doctor?
The Lucky Star's open all night today! Not that there are many guests at this hour, but it's one of grandma's old sayings. When the Lucky Star stays open, good fortune comes often.
Wooo... Good timing. I was about to sneak out for a drink... wanna join me?
Hey! Take it easy... I'm not a broken vending machine you can fix with a smack, you know!
This is a nice little space. Maybe I can get a few arcade cabinets set up... no, you didn't hear me say anything.
Whoa, whoa, we pissed off the wrong guy! Run! Move those legs! Let's get out of here!
I guess we're done. Can I hit the pachi… Err, can I take a game break now?
Good job! Dismissed. Go do whatever you want, and see you next time!
*laughter* Well done! Did anyone get a pic of that? I want to print it out and put it up on the door of the Lucky Star!
Unerring!
Hope you enjoy this!
I don't need to aim!
The gun may be fake, but yeah, that's all it takes.
Something suspicious up ahead, two hundred meters.
Loaded... check.
Yeah, yeah, heard you the first time...
Hm? What's that?
Mm, just as I thought.
Come with me, I know a secret passage.
I'm the leader? Alright, better to work for you than to stick my neck out for someone else.
Breaktime's…. over, I guess.
Rest assured. You're always VIPs at the Lucky Star.
Wow, working for you lot pays so much better than the yakuza.
Real guns... they use them differently from gran…

Kichisei the Unerring, reporting in! Come to the Lucky Star in Mitsukue for all your needs, whether you need a gem appraiser, a fence, or an information broker. I am always at your service during business hours.
Huh? The Dr.{@nickname}'s not in the office today… Guess I'll have to find somebody else... who should I pick? Can't be a complainer, a miser, or sane enough to keep clear…
