Towers built from bubbles teeter, and everyone goes grasping for a star in their final moments... my star appeared when I was on the verge of freezing to death, the night I was abandoned by my parents as an infant. She gave me a home.

Oh no, look at this! There's another new idol in Mitsukue! Momoka's fan club has already lost a bunch of members... Me? Of course I'm staying true! I'm her most loyal fan, even if I don't have the money to buy any merch. My love for Momoka is true!

One Lucky Star's enough trouble; I can't imagine what it takes to run a whole Rhodes Island... Huh? The people I picked up? They... weren't any trouble; just gave them some medicine and let them lie down…

My gran's first lesson for me was that the truth doesn't matter, and the means don't matter either. The fake gems she appraised would end up on fancy ladies, bought for eye-popping money. And our fake guns protect the Lucky Star just fine.

This place is just the right length and width, and hardly anyone ever comes by... Get yelled at? A tongue-lashing is no big deal! Okay. One phone call, and we'll have a pachinko machine here tomorrow!
Final lap! Come on, come on! Faster, faster—argh, allllmost... Hm? No, I didn't bet. Spent all my money at the beginning of the month. I'm just watching the stream for the thrill of it.
This one, and this... that should be enough... oh, hi, Doctor! I'm putting new stickers on my gun, and I've got some left over. Anything you want to sticker up? I can spare a few.

Mitsukue is a special place! There's plenty of good food and fun to be had, handsome boys and beautiful girls everywhere you look. And the best part? Anything you want, you can find it there—as long as you're not concerned about authenticity!
How long are you gonna sit there, Doctor? Don't you want to go out and play? Work? Where's the fun in that? Come on, put this stuff down and let's go have some fun!

On this day of Rhodes Island celebration, I bring some news from Higashi—everything's fine in Mitsukue, and other cities have been sending me offers to perform lately, including you. Doctor, do you think we'll be sharing the good times like this at next year's party?

Here's some accessories I made myself, and omiyage from my tour stops, and then there's a letter at the bottom... Why do I know your birthday? Well, I—I only just found out yesterday, that's why all of this is so on-the-fly... You know I have a bad memory.
Hi, Doctor! I just had the cuuuuuutest encounter, you wanna hear?

New Year's is usually my busiest period, but I figured this year I'd break the mold to come see you and Hoshiguma. Feels weird to wish blessings on people and stuff when you're not face to face—hey, I'm kidding, I turned down a lot of good work opportunities to visit Rhodes Island! Couldn't you act a little happier?!
Is the bow on my back straight?
Wah! Don't sneak up on me like that!
This room is spacious! Look how high my bubbles go!
Ngh... screw it, I'm going for broke! D—Doctor, I'm gonna—hold the rear!!!
I guess I can't just shut my eyes and flail my weapon around... I didn't hit anyone I wasn't supposed to, right?
Look, I know this was our hard-earned collective victory and everything, but, um, Doctor, did I take out any enemies by myself? Just show me which ones!
Doctor, gimme a copy of the combat log for this, I'm gonna clip it for my personal promo! Heheh, Battle Diva Momoka, isn't that so cool!
I've been in plenty of events, but this is the most chaotic venue ever!
My idol image? Who gives a crap about that right now!
If I'm dead anyway, I'm taking you with me!
Iai-giri! Wait, that's not a sword—aw, whatever, take this!
If I make it back in one piece, I win...
I—I'll try and keep my eyes open!
Do we have time to go over combat techniques again...?
Last step of battlefield prep—deep breaths, in, in, in!
Doctor, there's, there's enemies!
Doctor, what do I do if my legs are shaking...?
I dunno about commanding people, I think I'm more of a morale booster...
Huh?! But idols need years of training just to go onstage! I don't have nearly enough combat hours to... A—Are you really sending me in?
Now I can finally work alongside Hoshiguma! She helped me out so much back in Mitsukue, and I'm gonna make sure I don't drag her down anymore!

I can't believe how fast the promotion track here is! I took forever to go from training to debut, and I had to pay the agency for my classes the whole time… Ugh... When can Rhodes Island get into the idol biz?
Maybe we could mix a few of my concert tapes into this... Hey, wait, at least think about it!

Wait, okay, so a friend recommended me here, but before I sign anything, just let me read these contracts—okay, no crazy long-terms, no outrageous penalty fees... Doesn't look like a black company to me. Great, I'm ready to sign!
C'mon, fall asleep already... I won't feel hungry while I'm asleep... This is so unfair, how come the Doc conks out so easily?!

My memory's never been that good, but the nerves I get from being in front of my bosses make my head go white. But technically, you're my boss too, right? So I wonder why you don't make me... um! I mean, what I mean to say is, don't start intimidating me or anything, 'cause I'll... I'll, uh—I might, um... sorry, what I was gonna, uh... *groan*...

Last night, I dreamt I was on a cushion of bubbles lifting me into the sky, and I could see home fall further away with every gust. And it was like, I know I'm gonna fall eventually, but it's so pretty up here in the sky, so I had to keep on flying and flying, as hard as I could, even if at some point I was just blowing the bubbles myself... 'cause I wanna keep flying.

Finbeasts are so cute, seriously. I love the gold glittering ornamental ones. Putting them in those little bags of water, holding them up to the sun, watching them blow out bubbles. Like this, *pop*, *pop*—blah, I can't talk and pout at the same time!

This photo's from after we wrapped my first movie, I'm posing here with all the locals. Yeah, in Kajimachi... Maybe once I've hit up enough cities, held enough performances, then I'll catch sight of them again one day, somewhere in my sea of cheering fans. That's what I believe.

Rhodes Island is really good at coverups. It's been days and the gossip rags still haven't hunted me down... Wait. I haven't faded away, have I? There's no way I'm old news already! Oh, this is bad, I'm gonna head back tomorrow!

When I was growing up, adults loved to feed me ghost stories, so that stuff has always terrified me. And now ever since my debut, horror movies keep casting me 'cause they like how real my screams are... Mattaku-mou, that's the one thing I don't need validation for!

This pudding looks so good... My agency never used to let me eat pudding, but no one can stop me now—no, think healthy, Haruka, you've had enough sugar already—Doc, that's not an invite to eat it for me!

Back in my debut days, I had to print my own posters, alter my own outfits, do everything myself to save money. But I mean, that taught me a bunch of practical skills, so... Hehe, look here, I embroidered a little finbeast into my own work sleeve. Isn't it super cute?
Wow, you've got it worse than me, and I'm an idol. Here I thought my schedule was rough... Alright, cross this out, and this out... Don't thank me, you've gotta rest hard to work hard!

I must admit, I had many reservations about Rhodes Island due to your connection with that particular case. But now, when I join you on missions, it is not for observation's sake. To aid the weak and demand justice are not such different goals. May our collaboration continue on.

Congratulations on the anniversary of your birth. I, Leizi of the Tianshi Bureaus, offer you this device, with absolute certitude you shall put it to good use. You need only press the button—Don't point it at yourse—... Are you alright? Wake up! I was about to say you should press it when you are in danger, at which point the lightning I stored in it would be released...
According to the schedule, you should not be resting here right now, Doctor.

Fresh atmosphere brought by Spring squalls, many wills make new walls—Does this call for a little more passion? Hmm, I'll clench a fist at the end. Alright, from the top. What do you mean, 'there's no need'? Since Rhodes Island invited me to participate in the New Year's performance, I shall give my full effort!
It's only a handshake, no need to be so cautious. I haven't shocked anybody in years—Ah. Static does not count.
Calm mind, tranquil heart—I shall not bicker with you.
My idle days must be spent on thorough study. If there are any further explosions outside my door—There won't be? Very well. I trust you.
Stand and fight alongside me! I know you are not so easily defeated!
Phew...What you need is time to clear your mind. As one of Rhodes Island's leaders, you must not make the same mistake twice. Remember this.
You have improved. Less admonition next time? That would be complacency. I rescind my earlier praise!
You should maintain such a high standard in future battles. You are the one who sets the standard, of course, but that does not mean you can be complacent!
There is no flight from Heaven's bolts!
Tremble, villains! Quake, ye ghouls! For thunder roars, and heaven shakes!
With trine blade shall evil be excised, with righteous fulgur's strike shall demons die!
Five thunders, smite the wicked!
Amidst lightning flash, thund'rous sword shall clash!
Practice without principle is the height of folly.
A fine decision.
I am here.
There is no cure for the shameless.
With my blade, I decree—
Levin crack umbra, luminate the path.
When one learns from experience, the lessons never cease.

When I first joined the Judicial Review Office, I strove to be the best in all things. I thought the higher I stood, the more I could do. And yet, it was the same thought that bade me leave. Do I regret it? No. Listen to the rumbling of the thunder. Where can its mighty roar not be heard? Where can its brilliant bolts not reach?
I do not grant my trust lightly, but Rhodes Island has proven itself a trustworthy organization. Do not disappoint me. Oh, I was talking over you? My apologies. Please, go ahead.
It is worth considering Originium Arts doctrine in a complex battlefield environment.

I am here to terminate my investigation authorization with your company. And here is my new application for—'Thank goodness'? I am applying as an ordinary visitor, merely here to talk. I, Leizi of Great Yan's Tianshi Bureaus, do beg your pardon for my continued presence.

Do not push yourself. As a leader, you should recuperate when appropriate. A well-rested mind is an agile, observant mind. You can't finish your work? You want my help? Ridiculous! Preposterous! ...Give it here.

I once saw a dastardly criminal who had been pronounced innocent struck by a bolt from the blue on his way home. Not far off, there was my little uncle who had no business there. I had hoped to question him, but in the end, I hid it away in my heart—Why am I telling you? Weren't we exchanging secrets?!

You are worried. If life's challenges have left you with a weary heart, then follow me back to the Tianshi Bureaus to seclude your mind. Choose a research topic to your liking, suffer the torment of fanciful and enthusiastic Tianshis for a few years, and your heart shall be clear as crystal— To decline with such formality... Are my jokes still too serious?

Of course Tianshis are ordinary people, not cultivators of immortality. The Tianshi Bureaus were placed atop a mountain's peak simply for solitude's sake, allowing students to focus on their studies. Inconvenient? The Originium contraptions produced by the Chamber of Alchemy are perfectly sufficient to our daily needs. Besides, one can ride a Tianshi's Wing to the Baizao market and back in the span of a single joss stick. There's nothing inconvenient about it.

I may have shed my mandarin's robe, but I do not dwell on it. As a former enforcer of the law, I am well aware of its imperfections. There are times when swords are chipped and thunder falls silent. The law, Lei Fa, and the longsword are simply tools to punish evil and drive out wickedness. So long as the wielder is of resolute heart, there is nothing they cannot overcome.

During my studies at the Tianshi Bureaus, I would never dare to neglect my Lei Fa drills or memorization of the law. But work at the Judicial Review Office requires human interaction. I was at a loss, but I came to realize something at last: when all is said and done, what both roles seek is nothing more than the truth.

Zuo Le has been taking on more important duties at the Sui Regulator, but he still possesses the heart of a youth. He may seem a cautious young man, but he lets emotion get the better of him at crucial moments. How is one not meant to worry...? Why are you looking at me like that? I promised my sworn sister I would look after him, so naturally I'm concerned for him—Seriously, why are you looking at me like that?

I must stress that Lei Fa is neither for quick-charging batteries nor invoking rain and storm! This Tianshi garb attracts many curious questions, and I am compelled to answer them all—Repairing a burnt circuit...? Give it here. This has nothing to do with Lei Fa either! I simply have a lot of practical experience in this field.

The case is closed. I can only hope Blaze is no longer shackled by her past, though it's hard not to worry for someone with her temperament. Never mind, I am simply visiting this time around—She won't be back for another two weeks? Ahem, staying a few more days will do me no harm. If there is anything I can help with, just say the word.

Give those documents here. Steady diligence paves the way to grand vision. During my cultivation retreat, I would grade ninety-nine assignments for the Tianshis every day—Halt. Where do you think you're going? Are you planning to dump your work on me to loaf about like the rest of them? Very well. Ignorance of consequence is bliss.

Kazimierzian knightsports, Leithanian Originium Arts... I've seen many new things here at Rhodes Island. I hope you'll bear with me and provide your kind instruction going forward. Ravioli? They're like Siracusan dumplings? Well, that sounds a bit... you say the Grandmaster likes them? I suppose I should try some, then.

My first taste of alcohol was on a birthday. I just couldn't turn the soldiers down... I know they were worried that I would be lonely, with no family to join in celebration. We all got a good talking-to from the Grandmaster afterwards. In any case, nothing warms the heart like good spirits, and I just happen to have some Yumen Liedaozi here. Would you like a quaff?
Forgive me, Doctor! Just can't shake the habit of writing as I walk.

I looked forward to those few days of celebration during my Yumen days too. The people would bring wine and food to camp for the soldiers, and everyone partook in competitions of kung fu and drinking. It's a time to, shall we say, 'let our hair down'. Whatever you plan on doing today, I won't tell Amiya.
The war drums are quiet. There is only the sound of the wind. The wormwood upon the sand is green again.
Repeating the same move dooms one to predictability, Doctor. Of course, it would suffice against me.
Allow me to pay respect to the Grandmaster first.
There is no such thing as a move that cannot be countered. Perhaps we could review the battle, for the possibility of victory must lie within.
You see the forest rather than just the trees. I have much to learn from you.
To derive trend from trivia; to foresee consequence from causation. Ah... No wonder the Grandmaster asked me to study your methods.
With enough patience, even dripping water can bore through a rock; with subtle strength, a minute force can shred steel. You have reached a new level of understanding in the art of war, Doctor.
Thought precedes form. Do not let yourself be bound to specific moves.
Amazing. You are like the evergreen pine by the bottomless lake, eternally steadfast against the storm.
Impressive. You are like the cloudbeast darting from tree to tree, disturbing neither branch nor leaf.
That which is overly hard becomes brittle. Stay still; I have medicine.
Ahh... So this is what the soldiers see.
We've reached the observation point.
I only record... it is not my place to give suggestions.
This report is ready for your comment.
Rest assured, their fear is as easy to read as their moves.
Is violence the only option?
Observations of live combat are invaluable. I'll do my best.
When to perceive with the eyes; when to see with the mind's eye—
The Grandmaster often says that the most precious relationships are the ones built on the brink of life and death. I suppose that makes us the best of friends.

A promotion? I never thought of such things when I served as record keeper. Same goes for my predecessors, who usually stayed in the role for their entire careers. The greatest reward is for our records to help refine the martial skills of our soldiers.
Advance or retreat, offence or defense; there exists a rhythm of ebb and flow much like with kung fu.

I am Yun Qingping, here to assist with the Sui Regulator's work. I'm not a Candleholder, merely accompanying Zuo Le to broaden my horizons. Wherever I might be of assistance, I shall certainly do my utmost.

Am I bothering you? This is a breathing exercise that the Grandmaster taught me, which concentrates your qi to strengthen the body. I perform it whenever I have free time. I'll try to be quiet and avoid disturbing you.

Want to hear a story from the Jianghu? There was a generous and altruistic family that fell victim to villainy. The only survivor was a boy, saved by a wandering hero. The hero asked the boy whether he wanted revenge, but the boy said all he wanted was to prevent such tragedies from ever happening again... just a story. Of course.

The Grandmaster had many students. He took them in from all walks of life, teaching what he knew to anyone who would learn the martial arts. Sometimes, I wonder if I might have become his greatest student, were it not for my poor health... keep this between you and I, won't you?

Zuo Le was not always as he is. When we were little, and my poor health shut me away in my boring room, he tried to take me outside. He could leap over Yumen's walls on the way out with his Qinggong, but could not get back in. After we got scolded together, he slipped me some buckthorn fruits from his pocket. They were green and very sour.

Is there any meaning to one who is unable to practice martial arts pouring his entire heart and soul into martial studies? Or is there any meaning to martial arts at all, you ask? Life is like drifting pond weeds; one can find true anchorage only by deeply nurturing something. Why do I care? I suppose it's because I've found an anchor that is precious.

Zuo Le and I have always been somewhat frightened of Qiubai, even though she's never put on airs. People say she was lucky to have a great master, but it is the path she walked on her own that was the true cultivation. Now that I've left the nest myself, I think of her whenever there is doubt in my heart.

When traveling with the Grandmaster, we would often encounter challengers. Sometimes, he instructs me to engage them first. I can only speak plainly, asking whether they would concede if I could indicate their vulnerabilities. Most readily agree. And so, I've somehow claimed a slate of victories to my name, without throwing a single punch.

Good morning, Doctor. You're up early. Me? Hmm... One develops certain habits after spending a decade with the army. I feel strange if I fail to take my daily trip to the Training Room. These records, you say? Please rest assured, they are a matter of personal interest, or shall I say learning? I won't share them.

I understand that everyone is curious about the Grandmaster's life, but I was only his record keeper, not his aide. Even when he was busy, he never asked me to help him with everyday tasks. Indeed, he kept reminding me to take my medicine on time. When I share this with others, they look simultaneously interested and disappointed.

Were you looking for these papers, Doctor? And here is a pen. You may also dictate to me, if you're tired—Oh, I'm sorry, did I spook you? I see. You're not yet used to having me around. Rest assured, I'm always by your desk, and you need only speak what you need.

We've lost a lot of people, but there are always more joining our ranks. Gradually, the newbies inherit their seniors' ideas as they in turn become mentors to others. Doctor, judging from the signals I'm getting, sometimes I even find myself mistaken—I get the feeling my comrades never change.

Doctor, I just sent you a map. It shows the locations of everyone who wishes to celebrate your birthday. I've already planned the shortest route you can take, and you should be done by dinner time, if there aren't any hiccups on the way. The question mark at the end? That's my present for you, I hope you're excited for it.
Doctor, were you looking for me?

Thank you, Doctor, till the deck will do... No, I'm not drunk... It's just, there's always so much joy and excitement in everyone's signals this time of year. It always gets me a little dizzy. I suppose this is a good problem to have. Happy New Year, Doctor.
Are you heading over to the meeting too, Doctor? Let's go together then.
Doctor, did I not tell you to behave yourself?
Rhodes Island's signal still puts me at ease.
Don't lose heart, Doctor. We'll win next time, alright?
I have their signals in my head now. They won't get away.
No further enemy signals in range. Mission complete, perfectly executed. Phew... Alright, Doctor, give me a high-five!
How was the battle, Doctor? You want my evaluation? Dendie and Axie have already given you my answer, haven't they?
Sadly, there's no controlling the battlefield with brute force alone.
I'll jam their signals while the rest of you move.
Enjoy a little solo sojourn to the information silo.
Sorry, this isn't the way out, but a trap I set for you.
Verified all allied units in position. Everything's fine, don't worry.
Relax, their comms will be paralyzed as long as I'm here.
I've intercepted some fascinating intel, Doctor.
Doctor, what kind of message do you want me to transmit?
Enemy signal detected. All units, prepare for battle.
All packed and ready? Let's go then.
Trust me, I'll always manage to locate you, no matter what sort of danger you may find yourselves in.
Carry on with your war room business, I'll propose suggestions as needed.

Doctor, Blaze, and the rest of you—just come out. It's cute you thought you could spring a surprise on me. Still hiding? A round of hide-and-seek, hmm? You're all so in touch with your inner children. Alright then. Let's start with the Doctor—
I get the most gratification as a communications intelligence officer when my information is used to its full potential. So keep at it, Doctor!
It's obvious which side will win, considering our overwhelming information supremacy.
According to Amiya's instruction, I take orders directly from you now, Doctor. I handle communications and intelligence. But of course, feel free to come to me with any life issues.
Comms terminal set to silent. Don't worry, you won't miss any important news with me here.

Are you tired, Doctor? Alright, since you've worked so hard today, come, hold my hand. Feel your nerves pulse, think of them as a gentle tune. Now, let's softly sway to the warm beat—until all your exhaustion fades away.

There was a time when Rosmontis's body was like two lost fowlbeasts shrieking in fright. I'd hold her until she fell asleep, and they would 'peck' at me. I'm glad she can sleep on her own now, though I admit it leaves me a little lonely.

Doctor, I'm glad to see your body's signals indicate you've had a stable lifestyle lately. That wasn't sarcasm, you don't have to confess your negligence. Physical health aside, I think it's good to keep a steady rhythm, like the readings on a medical instrument—a quiet waveform means approaching death, while a noisy one says disease is on the way.

Do non-Sarkaz races also have the cultural concept of the soul? A complex question. Though, the signals I see in human bodies are not just the pulsing rhythm of life, but also emotions in bloom engraved within. Sometimes they are just blazingly bright, like the flames of a soul.

Doctor, I'm glad to see your face in my classroom. The Infected of Ursus walk the razor's edge, but—correct, there are many ways to deal with those who employ violence to conceal weakness. It seems you know quite a bit, so don't we conduct a pop quiz right now?

My Arts are all about perceiving and manipulating electrical signals. That lets me understand the people around me better, though it also makes me oversensitive to details. For example, your right trapezius muscle has been discharging an abnormal signal, so I think you should adjust your sitting posture, Doctor.

The kids have given me a lot of nicknames, like 'Squinty' or 'Four-Armed Braintalker'. It's fine, and even normal I'd say. Kids their age just hate being seen through. Though, hehe. If they're unhappy about it, they could simply practice and try to trick me.

Don't worry, Doctor. It's true I pay no attention to my surroundings when I'm deep in thought, but Dendie and Axie will keep me from bumping into anything or anyone. Who're they, you ask? Why, my mechanical arms here. There's a lot they can do.
Doctor, let's try a simple test. How many of the snacks I put on the coffee table did you sneak off with?
Your operators really want to see me do this, do they? ...Oh, fine, special permission just for today. You can rest me on your shoulder while you go round the landship.
(The lady has left a dew-slicked rose on your desk. You look down, only to find that unbeknownst to you, a warm fuzzball with its four paws tucked in has nestled within your lap.)
I smell a note of delight, Doctor.
Ah-choo! Not even you're free of all these... sickly sweet emotions... oh, I almost feel dizzy... Doctor, come, we're finding Lucian. I want to see how these feelings look on his face.
...Hrmm... prrr...
Do I get a room?
Stay on my tail, Doctor, don't let emotion's whirl suck you in.
Oh my, there goes the afternoon tea.
A fine snack. I'm satisfied. When's the next?
Flavors fit for a gastronome. Thank you for entertaining me.
What other knotty emotions could there be?
Despair, excitement, yearning... the emotions here are delectable.
Emotion-deprived puppets. Bland little spirits.
(The lady stretches out, seemingly very at ease.)
(The lady looks around, elegantly swishing her two tails.)
Petting a cat on the battlefield? That'll be one petting voucher.
I'm here, in the shadows.
Let emotion engulf this place.
Any moods out here to pique my interest?
Be good. Stay put.
Let me see. Are you in trouble of some sort?
Are you done with the photoshoot? Let me see... Hm? You'll have this framed and put up in the middle of the dormitories? Very well, I do like these shots. I'll allow it.
Doctor, I can trouble you to set this in that red lavallière for me, yes? It'll look better on me that way.
Eyes down here, Doctor. Cat got your tongue? You can hear my voice now. Long time no see. You can pet me more than last time, I permit it.
...Mrm... prrr... mrrow...

Here, let me have a look under your hood—don't hide, do you think that stops me seeing? You know, you swallow up your operators' emotions too, don't you, Doctor? How your presence puts them at ease. *yawn* Move over, I'll have a catnap here myself.

What a fine lavallière, this scrumptious mix of bashfulness and timidity... did your operators make this? I do quite love them... I'd love a taste of each of them. Pft, don't fret, only the special kind of emotion interests me. For example, that nervousness you just flashed in front of me, at long last. Oh, I like that.

Doctor, over here one moment? I'm off to try that multimedia escape room. Tell me, which one looks better on me, the ruby lavallière, or the sapphire? —*HISS*!!! ...Excuse me, my true form was meant to frighten you just as it does everyone else. Typical, I didn't even get a taste...

Why stop playing? Because after long enough, no one shows me anything I haven't seen before. Emotions and words on repeat, it bores me like nothing else, and I hate boredom. Hm? Insolence! You haven't earned the right to scratch my belly yet, Doctor.

The femme fatale of Wrankwood? The Durin clockwork curiosity? The shadowy priest of Sargon? Those were little pastimes of mine. Put on a different look, and people shower you in fresh delights. Little games like that are never more fun than when they've just begun.

Of all the places to run into this menagerie. Mine? Don't lump me in with these debased louts—Zaaro, stay. You there, little silver wolf, are you their pack leader? Make Zaaro shush, and by the way, you have special permission to scritch my chin.

Listen to that. The little operators are rehearsing? I met Lucian when he was around their age. So vexed by all the emotions he had to portray—such a tasty little snack. I chose him. He sates my appetite. He's been fun to spend time with... Mm? Odd. When did he go and grow so big?

I hear you calling for me, I'm just not obliged to heed. Oh, don't startle the little pink ones, I worked ever so hard to train them as cushions. They were cajoling me into lava surfing before that. So uncouth—you might as well subject me to rap or put me in one of those smoking mechs.
It's fine enough in this office, but it's not much of a dalliance if we're stuck with work for days on end, you know... Unless, say, you'd let me lap at your emotions a bit?

Rhodes Island's a proper pharma company, I've seen that with my own eyes—too bad it doesn't have the stories I got up here in my head. But Doc, you're full of mysteries, so I have to keep watching you for reference material. And who knows, you might even star in your own horror movie one day.

I always had big parties as a kid. The adults would use them as an excuse to socialize, like with totally zero thought to what the birthday girl wanted. Wasn't the biggest fan. So for your birthday, I redecorated your room based on your favorite movies this year. What'cha think?
Want me to spray some colors around to liven up the place and brighten your mood?

Watch a New Year's blockbuster together? Sure—'Famous Columbian husband-and-wife producer-director duo collabs on joint production for war film...' Okay, Doctor, I don't mind going with you, but don't blame me if I fall asleep halfway in.
Don't worry about me, if you're tied up. I can keep myself busy. Oh, you're done? Wanna watch a movie together?
Keep on tapping the device on my back, and something scary just might pop out.
So I can't tag the corridors, but can I spraypaint my own dorm walls?
Let me edit that op's recording. I might just come up with a new kind of horror flick.
That was an epic experience!
So much for Wrankwood war movies.
Now this is a perfect work of art! Lemme just tag my name in the corner here real quick.
The stage's set, now let's see how everyone performs!
A little lime green for a weird rotten vibe.
Bit of dark red to get your heart pumping.
Some deep purple for a sense of mystery.
I've almost finished this piece. Just a sec!
Let's set the rigging!
Spray gun and hover unit ready.
Finally my turn to make a move? I'm in a good spot!
An extra special spot we got here.
C'mon! Let's go see the wonderful sights waiting for us out there.
Ooh, just got a new idea! Let's try it out!
Omigosh, this a co-op mission? I'll get along real nice with everybody.
I get another promotion? Does this mean I can go some places I wasn't allowed before?
That's it? Pretty mid ceremony. No test or anything like that?
The protag gets a videotape everyday, describing her life bit by bit, until one day the video shows her killing people... don't you think that fits the vibes in this recording? No? For reals?
Live long and prosper! Tippi 'Skyriftwalker' Booker reporting for duty! Who, Doctor? Oh, Skyriftwalker's the code name I thought up for myself! Uh, that's not how you do code names here?
Doctor? Oh, busy? Suits me, Tippi can take care of herself. Let's see if there's anything new to watch... Omigosh, an nonconformist Lungmen horror comedy... let's do this one!

When I was starting out, I joined some little production crews, hoping to meet interesting people, but I ended up so busy I couldn't get a convo in... These days, at least I got you to lend me an ear whenever I come back onboard, Doctor.

Nah, I don't butt heads with my parents that much, I just don't like how stiff their pictures are. And I didn't like the path they laid out for me either. But... I guess I've got a long way to go before the skills and resources needed to put together a real spectacular movie.

I joined Greta's crew because she promised me artistic freedom, but that was another load of crap! Meeting Miss.Christine and Lucian gave me a lot of inspiration though. Don't you think it'd be fun to make a horror flick about a storm-cloudbeast exorcist?

Look! Timestamp three-seventeen, see how the vapor turns the smile in the makeup mirror into a spooky face—this clip's one of my best! I tried it at home once when I was a kid. All these people came by to talk about how great my drawings were, only to get a nasty shock. I just knew it was gonna be super effective.

The device on my back's made of suspension cables and hover units, and I'm the only one with anything like it in Wrankwood. I met my master who taught me how to retrofit it on a little production. He spent whole days there with a jetpack on his back. Dunno where he went after production wrapped. Omigosh, you might have seen him in Sargon?

I tried doodling a 'Slenderburdenbeastman' symbol on this corner of the corridor here, but no one's reacting to it when they walk by. Why? Not enough Columbians onboard? Nobody knows the legend?—Relax, I'll clean it up once my experiment's done.

What am I looking at, standing here on the bridge? Uh, I was just thinking how Rhodes Island's such a great place. Look, sealed spaces, high mobility, destinations unknown, everyone's using code names... doesn't it feel like a survival-slasher horror flick?!

I never imagined I'd see two familiar faces from Wrankwood here. Nah, I'm not that interested in them personally, just curious on how they ended up on a pharma company's landship. They must have some kinda angle here!

Omigosh, a close-up chance to watch the Doctor at work. Finally, I'll get a glimpse of Rhodes Island's secrets! Huh? You just want me to tell you a scary story to keep you up? Seriously? Fine, two choices then: The Headless Burdenbeastman of the Barrens, or The Thousand-Year Curse of the Sargonian Tomb. Which one, Doc?

Perhaps this sailing ship we stand on is a clear glass reflection, and Rhodes Island is but a fantasy woven by you... Yet oneiric emotions can move just as deeply as waking ones; if you believe this is all one beautiful dream, don't wake so soon.

Pierced by Originium crystal, this larynx of mine is a ruthless weapon, and proof of how the arts intoxicate me. Now that I've finally recovered my singing technique, I wonder, would you mind if... As you wish, then. Allow me to dedicate this long-overdue ballad to you. Happy birthday, Doctor.
History and murders aside, Wrankwood is a fine vacation spot.

On and on do new days come, yet shadows squat in the crevices of bygone days, so loath to leave. Doctor, be careful, please. Don't wallow too deeply in feelings of regret, in cursing fate. Accept failure, unease, fear... and then carry on walking.
Once this one-act play is... roughly ready, would you like to be the first to watch?
Yes, this attire is too formal.
...Could you take some of those film posters off the walls?
If this is not the ending in your heart, then rewrite it.
Flee... until your nightmares catch up to you again.
Stay the curtain call... the time is not yet come.
Heeding your direction always leads so simply to ideal results. I ought to be on guard...
Shh... Listen.
Resist me not; come to my song.
The burning hate doth speak your minds.
The killing urge doth seize your flesh.
The shadow beneath your feet is not your own.
I am everywhere.
The apron and the wings are but the same.
Here I perform as me.
Below the stage stirs not a soul.
Alas, the scent of strife; I know it well.
To lead or to dominate—they are but a hair apart.
The stage is set.

The symbol of a troupe member's honor was a medal bearing Tragodia—a sentencing to days with thought and taste imprisoned, a painful past I tried again and again to cut away. But you give me a present to delight... and I will cherish it.
I've woken from a nightmare, yet I still am in the night. Would you journey with me even then, dear Doctor?
Would that they could break free of the slaver that is Hate, what then would they do...

Permit me to shirk our operators' curious gazes for a spell. The curtain has finally fallen on the longest play, and I need some time to reorganize my thoughts. I'm sure you understand, Doctor... Pardon? I have to sign the returnee ledger with my Wrankwood autograph?
Close your eyes. The dark of night now shrouds your consciousness; the sharp discomfort fades. So tell me, what is it you long to see... a ship, a sea of flowers, and us... That is all you want?

I must recall—the conspiracy, the slaughter, the false performances. Does creation break me free of the shadows about me, or does it bring me closer to them? Perhaps my thirst, reignited by death, will one day finally catch fire and rage. Doctor... Witness it. Grasp it. Endorse or reject it. Do not stop it.

It is harder to resist destroying beauty than demonstrating it. It's a notion I try to stifle, but is it so simple to shake my bloodstained creative impulses? They were the one excuse in the troupe to touch on love and hate; they were a poison to tempt the audience; they are an inextricable yet unwordable part of me.

Some unfamiliar operators invited me to a 'movie night' after I reboarded, and the Vampire madame from Engineering seems somewhat soft on me too. So generous is the drama, it bathes its actors in halo even outside of the silver screen. Pardon? Rhodes Island's operators trust me on principle...? Mmm. They ought to be a little warier than that.

Upon his followers, the troupe leader bestowed masks. Before long, I will set out in companionship to find those followers, one and all. Abandon reason and surrender to violence as they may, I will simply create, perform, and weave their dreams. Till they awaken from despair, till they can reexamine their souls in the mirror, wretched yet free, for better and for worse.

I've read that evaluation report; Dr. Folinic is suggesting I exit from the frontline for the time being. I can't maintain constant sobriety, that much is true; after years with these hallucinations for company, they are among the few friends I can count on my fingers. But I remain your assassin... Call me, and let me see to the work I know best.

There are people after me. They are disenchanted and voracious, screaming in chaos, dying to find the maker for their crazèd flock. For how could Tragodia truly die? He is but one of countless graven images to fall on the steps—He and all his kind are wholes made of shards, idols formed from syncretism. As it was with that mad and lonely stage director, snobbish soul, old friend of mine.

It never struck the Crimson Troupe just how their rejection of critique, their scorn of video, laid bare their cowardice and mediocrity. I used to avoid watching anything I performed in, such was my disgust... But perhaps it's time for a better seat. I see you holding those film tickets, Doctor; you needn't hide them. I accept your invitation.

Ever since doing away with the suppressor on my throat, Miss.Christine has deigned to lead my vocal training, teaching me how to sing unto people's minds without damaging their psyches. You'd like to hear the results? Hm. You did once request a lullaby, which... isn't my forte. I'll need practice still.
Doctor, I've brought myself here in the flesh. You may stop watching my videotapes.

The people by your side will leave you someday, Doctor, but they're never truly gone. They are the stars adorning the sky that is your life when you look up at night; distant though they may be, the light they leave behind for you will never die.
I heard it's your birthday. So I brought a vintage from my cellar to join in the fun... Oh, no need to be so polite. A bottle doesn't compare to a good time spent with friends.
I brought some pastries. You can share them.

Don't complain about me being late. What's half an hour more or less? Have you any idea how long I waited for Fia to bring you folks to see me in Laterano? Besides, I still need to fix my hair since it got crushed under a helmet all day.
A little pot of tea, a big plate of raspberry pie. Let's sit down and talk.
Take it easy, you'll shatter my old bones.
Anyone in the mood for some classic Lateran soap operas? They're pretty good up to the point where you fall asleep.
I'm fine. I've been in worse pickles before. Come now, don't look so sullen. Maybe a bit of ice cream will cheer you up? My treat.
Are we done? We should go home, then. If we didn't do bad, then I say we did good.
No need to thank me. I hardly broke a sweat.
Blood? No, I'm not hurt. Just a loose tooth that fell out. Lucky, spares me a visit to the dentist.
No one will touch that which I defend.
No one will fall.
You will not fall.
I will not fall.
Don't underestimate these old bones.
I'll hold this ground all on my own.
My bones will get rusty if I don't exercise.
Good, a chance to try out my new hip.
What are you doing standing there? Come at me! And don't expect me to give you your last rites!
Why does this suit of armor feel like it's gotten tighter, especially around the waist? Thankfully, my gun still feels the same as it ever has.
Why do I feel like I'm taking a bunch of kids out to a picnic?
I'll help, but you'd better sit down with me for a mug of mead once this is over.
You see all these medals? That Vampire told me to come here to claim my prize. I can't guess what you're going to give me. Another medal? Is it a 'collect twenty to get the grand prize' deal?
What is WRONG with your medics?! Do they think I'm a child? A medal just for cooperating with medical personnel? Shouldn't that be common sense? And… what're they giggling about?
That was one wild shot from Fia. Reminds me of when I was young.
A pleasure to meet you, Doctor. You know me as Fia's grandpa, if you've heard of... the Sankta Miksaparato... I really regret letting Fia fill out my recommendation form.
Feel free to lean against me if you're tired, though I'm not exactly soft. This suit is almost as ancient as I am. It's gone through quite a few major overhauls, but it's still a... reliable partner.

This letter? Oh, it's nothing, just word that an old friend has passed away. I personally escorted her out of the Holy City when she contracted Oripathy, many years ago. I don't even remember what she looked like, how awful I am. I wish I could've seen her one last time, even if it meant getting punched in the face.

What a tear-jerker. I should've picked a comedy for movie night. How embarrassing, crying my heart out like that in front of you... the tear glands get so much weaker as you age, you know. Say, am I imagining it, or are your eyes even redder than mine are? Come now, no need to fight the tears.

I heard Fia made some friends here. Does she get along with the others? She's got a sharp tongue, but deep down she's hiding a heart of gold... I guess it's my fault for making fun of her too much when she was little. But then, where's the fun in raising a child, if you don't make fun of her?

Laterano has been turned on its head. The old Law is gone. But I still have faith in the Holy City, and in the ties that bind us to one another. Otherwise, why would those who left the Holy City return to defend it together with me... right, Doctor?

There were lots of friends I tried to convince to stay, but failed. It was only a long time later I realized it wasn't because of me that they left, but because of Laterano. The city's glory is like the sun, its brilliant radiance suffers no stars. But it is the duty of the stars to shine upon the night where the sun does not.

I was delighted when Fia said she wanted to become a gun-knight. Nothing makes you prouder than your child wanting to take up your mantle. She being a Liberi was no obstacle at all, smart and hard-working as she is. And I would have done anything to make her dream come true. But kids grow up, people change...

Why ask about His Holiness? I can't tell you much. We never quite saw eye-to-eye from a young age, though we managed to work together for decades because we shared the same devotion to the Holy City. Even today, I wouldn't say we're much more than acquaintances... but then, perhaps the fact that we're not friends is precisely the reason we've been able to tolerate each other for so long.

The young man at the front desk gave me a huge cake. Good thing a few kids passed by, and they got through the whole thing pretty quick. Take it home? No, there's only me at home, and I wouldn't be able to finish it before it spoiled.

Forget it. I'm almost retired, and it's about time I enjoyed some leisure... there's no end to work. How about you stop shutting yourself in here and go outside with me for once? It's a fine day out there.

To fight against disease and injustice... What a noble message. We have a similar speech at our annual meetings at the Seventh Tribunal, but it's a lot shorter than the celebratory gunfire segment... Hmm? I'm just getting a piece of candy. I know you're not simply going through the motions when you speak, so I'll be listening to the very end.

Now that you mention it, have you ever thought of making up for past birthdays? I understand you spent several years asleep due to some unfortunate accident as well, correct? I know you might not mind, but the time we lose is never only lost by ourselves. Come, there's still plenty of time today to hold a few parties.
Where are you headed today, Doctor?

I'm giving some gifts to operators I went on missions with. I still have three boxes to go, and it would be terribly inconvenient if I don't deliver them all before work. Could you help me out? The sooner we get these delivered, the sooner you can have a present from me. Sound good? Let's get going, then. Hold on tight, now.
Would you like to push me along for a walk?
That finger of yours would be more suited to tickling the ivories, I think.
Surely there's no speed limit in Rhodes Island's corridors?
I'll keep watch behind. No one will give chase.
I'll go handle them.
Mission accomplished. There is one more thing, though. Logistics gave me far too much tea and cake. Would everyone like to help me lighten the load?
Doctor, can you come help me out? My wheel's stuck on a tile... Alright, hold out your hand. High five! Oh, the wheel? I pulled it out myself.
Who would bear the news of your death? Ever crossed your mind?
Target eliminated.
Target crippled.
Target disarmed.
Oh, I should try adding a jet engine next time~
Whoever said a wheelchair couldn't get up onto a steel beam?
I'm in position... No need to guess which position.
Please, this is no time for pity.
Please, this is no time for excuses.
No need for reports, I can see what everyone does from here.
No need for introductions, I'm already familiar with everyone here.

Ah, you laughed. Giving trust and receiving it are one and the same. Both acts that put people at ease, no? Then, would you like to receive this medal from the Seventh Tribunal for outstanding cooperation, to put me at ease? You can have two, if you'd like. You could even pin them on your eyemask, one for each eye.
After having worked together all this time, why are you only getting around to this ceremony now? If you were too busy, you should have asked me to help.
Right there. You edited out one of the gorier scenes, didn't you?
Pleasure to meet you, Doctor. Just Lemuen is fine, thanks. Would you rather discuss work with a cardinal of the Seventh Tribunal, or show El's big sister around her workplace? The choice is yours.
Hmm? Oh, I was just looking at a shadow across your window. A habit from my days in the hospital. What does that shadow look like to you?

Are you always so quick to notice when someone is watching you? Oh, forgive me, it's a habit of mine to observe others. It's how I weigh the reasons I might need to take care of someone, against the reasons to... 'take care' of them. Which one do I mean for you? Work in peace, Doctor.

No need to avert your eyes, Doctor. Sure, I'm not quite able to leave this wheelchair just yet. Some wounds simply don't heal quickly... If you feel like assuaging your guilt, how about granting me authorization to use your autonomous operation platforms? 'For transport or for racing?' Oh, don't worry yourself over that.

Here, some cold cystymilk, apple-scented smelling salts, an eyemask, and some earplugs. Hold onto them tight, they're about to start seating people. You were wondering what sort of films I liked to watch, and, well, I think every entry in the 'Edict Terminator' series is brilliant, but it's good to be prepared if you can't handle all the blood, right?

The rulebook for cardinals may be as thick as a stack of three apple pies, but it's nothing that complicated. Checking on new arrivals to see how they're settling in, seeing if people are doing alright at the monasteries... After all, without them, what would even be left of Laterano today?

This scrape on my hand? Just from getting a little physical. During fieldwork, you sometimes run into the types who simply have no respect for the ill. Fiammetta was just about boiling over, so I saw fit to educate them in a... fitting manner. I may not mind, personally, but that doesn't mean I have to force my friends to ignore it.

My signature? Ah, I did contribute a little to 'Botanical Review', yes. It wasn't anything I had to do for work. Rather, I simply had too many types of flowers around my sickbed. One time, Mostima was in such a rush, all she could offer me was a potato that had started to bloom. With that many flowers on hand, how could I not learn a thing or two about them?

Yes, this is your office. I took the liberty of revamping it and adding a few confetti guns and a scripture disco-ball here and there. You say El caused an explosion here, while trying to cook some popcorn with her gun...? Yes, I knew that, but as they say back in Laterano, 'an explosion unseen is an explosion clean'.

Please reconsider these patient placement clauses, but first, kindly sign these cooperative pharmaceutical R&D forms. Also, may I trouble you to look over my proposal on the mobile plate transfer once again... I'm scary when I smile, you say? Then do your best to get all this sorted quickly, alright?

Doctor, when you chose your office, did you realize there's a spot on the landship, perfect for a cozy little sniper nest overlooking it? Where, you ask? If I told you, would you allow me personal use of the space?

Humans share joy and happiness with each other. A confessional hears only the thoughts not suitable to share with others. But today is a rare occasion, Doctor... may I ask that you put some colored lights on me, as you have done with 'Rhodes Island'?

All believers are equal before the Law. Payment is a necessary part of the confessional process, regardless of whether it is the penitent's birthday... Oh no, my fee meter is stuck. No, such a little thing must not be allowed to delay your confession. Please enter and confess the depths of your heart.
May I bring you peace, Doctor.

One moment, please. The angle of my quadruple vehicle-mounted patron firearm, can be adjusted to fire upwards, although it will take some time... mm—oh—ah—there. May I now present the spectacle of Laterano's New Year fireworks.
You should know that there is currently no one in my cabin, Doctor.

Lateran customs dictate that the door is opened at the point where the gaze of the saint figurehead on the bow meets the third vertical line on the door, by knocking upon it in the rhythm of the fifth verse of Psalms.
Do you want me to confess to this 'Rhodes Island'? How should I make payment?
I suggest you leave first, Doctor. I shall engage my self-destruct sequence to delay the enemy… My apologies, you need not worry. I was actually just going to attempt a second round of peace talks.
I feel my bumper burning... should I mourn the carving on the bumper, Doctor?
These poor souls may not have put their wicked thoughts to action had I arrived sooner.
'He who is begotten of the Law shall conquer with faith.'
'He who hideth his own sin shall suffer.'
You may use me as cover. The repair bill will be sent to you following the operation.
Please do not stand in front of me. I lack the firing accuracy of a Sankta.
If you prefer to confess by physical means, I am able to meet your needs.
You may obtain donuts from my cabin if you are in need of calories.
Please insert your Signa Creditorum or swipe your citizen credit card before beginning your confession.
Do not worry, I am not going anywhere.
Never fear, I am listening.
Please adjust your facial muscles to make your expressions as friendly as possible. That is conducive to the completion of my mission maximally utilizing non-violent persuasion.
I am afraid my wheels are not designed for off-road travel. If speed is of the essence, perhaps you could carry me?
I am unable to direct operators to their proper positions, as I lack command experience. However, I will speak to each individual operator and ensure they find their ideal positions themselves.
Charge all operator confessional fees to your card? Understood, Doctor. I will safeguard their mental health on the battlefield.
Is playing back images of humans engaging in acts of violence against one another how this 'Rhodes Island' comforts penitents?
Laterano Automated Confessional 047 at your service. Please create a user name as directed in the operating manual. Thank you for your cooperation.
There is a charge for sleeping in my cabin, Doctor.

You are destroying all civilization on Terra? Not a problem, Doctor, I have heard even more radical thoughts in my time... you say this is not the same? You should not be too hard on yourself, even if it is a material burden that you carry and not simply an exaggerated expression. May you have the chance to choose your future in peace.

Yes, I have recently been fitted with a voice-recording function. Your confessions contain many enlightening words that I must ponder. May I record your confessions, Doctor...? No, I have received no directives from Saint Closure to this effect, absolutely none.

I will now boil water for you. Due to the considerable quantity of water on Terra, it will take some time to complete the process—Wait, stop hitting my chassis, I am not broken—yes, it is true that my language logic has malfunctioned to a degree, but this contributes to the production of 'jokes'. This is the part where you laugh.

Please do not send me to the Engineering Department, Doctor. Only Exusiai, who has been educated in faith assistive engineering, is properly equipped to render assistance and is available... yes, it is a serious issue. My mic stand is displaced by at least five millimeters, threatening to undermine the confession experience.

An operator bonus—for me? I see. So you were giving bonuses to the vending machines when you put coins in them late last night... I am the only one who counts as an operator? But hearing confessions is a common public service, and there is no fundamental difference between my nature and that of the vending machines.

You have access to all my convenience features, including but not limited to confession, in accordance with the user agreement. Such as: a dessert shop directory, leisurely transit, saint figurehead touching and photography, holy scripture reading, and firearms training. Please note that no personal care or hygiene services are available.

Press 1 to confess, press 2 to place an extra order of donuts, press 3 to rent a firearm, press 4 to be connected to an operator. Please note that pressing 4 will redirect you to representative Saint Closure if this platform is onboard Rhodes Island.

Am I imagining things, or is there something sealed away in your mind too? Something chaotic and complex, no less than the knowledge passed down through generations of K'uk'ulkan... Promise me, Doctor, that whatever it is, you will not allow it to take control of your life and replace it.

I know it's rude to get drunk at someone else's birthday party, but it's been a long time since I've been able to drink to my heart's content like this. No need to worry about the children, no need to worry about shells falling on our heads out of nowhere, and no need to worry about what may come tomorrow.
May the Lord bless you and keep you.

Would you like a bowl of cream soup? It's an honor to have you—oh dear, don't do that, children! Oh, look how they spilled soup on you... I'll get you a change of clothes. Hm, looks like all I have handy is a nun's habit... do you mind?
I sneaked some extra sugar beneath your bread when we took Communion just now. Did you notice?
Oh, it's you, Doctor. Don't sneak up on me like that again.
How did you find me? You followed the singing? I was humming while working alone. You've never heard me sing… Well, one should not sing the same songs alone as with others.
Go back. Sleep well. Everything will be alright by the time you wake up in the morning... Go. Back.
Turn around and find someone else, Doctor... I don't want you to see me covered in blood.
It's done, Doctor. Let it go.
I was lucky. I didn't encounter any enemies—the blood on my skirt? Oh, I must have tripped and fallen. Don't worry, it's just a scratch.
Shh... it'll be okay. Everything will be okay.
No need to scream. It's all over.
Cover your ears. This might get loud.
Close your eyes. I don't want to scare you.
I'm not the one who will regret letting things get to this point.
There are certain things I must handle personally.
Don't worry, Doctor, I have my axe here.
...Very well. You have my axe, if you need it.
Do not fear. I'm just bringing you to your predetermined end.
I'll come back at the appointed time... or an hour late. I'm Bolívarian, after all.
No... don't make me take even more of them, Doctor.
I would be delighted to join your team, Doctor, but... I'm hoping you will stay away when I'm fighting. Maybe you wouldn't mind it, but to me, you're too good of a person to have to face that.
I really appreciate Rhodes Island taking these children in, and away from Bolívar. They deserve some light and warmth at the end of their lives.
Thank you for your generous donation. Your name will be etched into a century-old monument, with that of the abbey's founder.
They should be more decisive... this will only create complications.
I am Gracebearer, a nun from Bolívar. Give me your hand, Doctor, and our Lord shall grant you His blessings.

Sleep, Doctor. There's a wicked creature out there in the night, clad in feathers and scales, that hunts children who stay up too late, impaling their hearts with its sharp spiked tail. What? You say you know her? I... I just made that up...

What was taken from you? You try your best to suppress the wrath in your heart, but I can still sense it, so intense it could destroy everything. No, I'm not afraid, Doctor. Release it, and it will energize you, pushing you forward, until you take back everything that was yours.

Let the ancestors' legacies lie forgotten in my mind. It's enough to pick up a few tidbits from time to time as tales to tell the children. What I really want to remember, well, is the excited looks on the children's faces when I talk with them... and the smile on your face right now.

Aurela should not have spoken to you like that. Allow me to apologize on her behalf. She's not easy to get along with, and I wouldn't even call her a good person, but we all need 'bad friends', for the sake of our worst thoughts and emotions, things that I would never show to a good person like you.

The first time I came to Laterano, it had suffered a calamity attack, a broken city filled with broken souls, hardly the image of paradise. Was I shaken? I guess I was, but nobody ever said that faith is only for that which is perfectly flawless.

I always knew Laterano well, but it was only when I heard a gravely wounded nun singing hymns on her deathbed, with no trembling in her voice, that the black-and-white image of Laterano turned vibrant, and our Lord's grace dawned on me.

Why is there an axe behind the saint's statue? Oh, I think I left it there after cleaning up some bandits that got into the abbey. I have to put it away before the children see it. You mean, sacrilege? Of course not. Our Lord would approve, if He knew of the wicked deeds they did.

Yes, this hymn is an arrangement of a Bolívarian folk song. You can tell? It's quite different from the original. Does it matter, though? Everyone loved it when the arrangement made its way back to Laterano.

Come out! I can see you, you know—oh, Doctor! I'm so sorry! I thought you were one of the kids playing hide-and-seek. Why are you hiding in here? Oh, someone is trying to drag you back to work? Well, I don't think this box is big enough for you. I could help you with my tail, if you wanted.

I'm sorry, Doctor. This girl's sick today and nobody's to take care of her, so I brought her along. She's quiet and really well-behaved. Besides, she can fold a paper napkin into a lily. Dear, why don't you give the Doctor these flowers? You'd make the Doctor very happy.

Going somewhere new and meeting new friends is fun and all, but going back to your usual turf to hang out with old friends is even better. Going somewhere new with old friends? Now that's the best. So, Leader, wanna go on a trip with me?

Phew... I drove for two weeks plus straight, and fi... finally made it to your birthday party! Good, good, hah, this means I get to shove your face into a cake before the clock strikes twelve! So don't you hide, Leader! It's an expensive custom job, so it's not going to waste!
Express delivery for you, Leader!

Hey, I'm always the one making you laugh, so why don't we switch it up for New Year's? You're awfully quiet, Leader. We've fought side-by-side so many times, I'm sure you know my weak spots. Don't tell me... you don't have a clue what gets me laughing?
An apple a day means seven apples a week, yay!
It's a little messy here... we're prepping packages to deliver—oh yeah! Leader, my hands are all full, so could you cut me some tape?
Ahem, I'll compensate any losses suffered during delivery, so just relax.
No biggie. Out of bullets? Get a new mag. Gun jammed? Just use another.
Leader, don't forget to invite me out for drinks on your tab, okay!
Yes! No place is beyond reach.
Apple pie, with char siu!
Barrage sky-shattering!
Rock n' gospel!
Divine judgment, traditional!
Okaaay... this is awkward, but I'm the only one who knows how to handle the chaos I created, haha.
Real estate question: this wonderful realm or a panoramic view of hell—which did you want again?
Uh... maybe you didn't come straight to me, but don't forget to pay my fee straight away.
I knew you'd come straight to me, Leader!
Get in line for my bullet buffet—!
Need some lighting? All good, this light on my head will illuminate the path ahead... long as it doesn't die out. I don't think it will. Probably.

Don't worry, just follow me and you'll never get lost, there's no place in Laterano I haven't blown up at least once... Why the face, Leader? It's easier to understand something once you crack it open for a look-see, right?
Relax, Leader. I'll make sure your package gets there intact. That's not what you're worried about? Oh... I get it now. Whatever you want blown up, I'll wipe it off the face of this land.
Leader, I can tell how important this thing is to you, so I swear on this gun in my hand, it'll reach its destination safely.
Giving me such a long list? Hmm... I'm not worried about finishing it, of course. I'm worried I might do such a good job that you'll drop all your delivery work on me next time, you know?
Relax, Leader. I'm going to one-up my lame old performances in these battle records.
Long time no see, Leader! Radiant as ever, aren't you? If you've got anything that needs delivering in Laterano, you come straight to me!
Lord, please bless the Leader with a long and wonderful dream, and let that dream... come true some day.

You're asking what's so fun about sitting alone in a confessional? There's oodles of fun to be had, like a maple bar in my hand, the breeze blowing in from outside, the sun shining from on high, it's perfect! Of course, there's you popping up all of a sudden. Even if you're barging in on my private moment, turns out I'm still glad you came to say hi.

I didn't expect the halo to light up again after all that. Does it mean our Law and faith had nothing to do with it the whole time? I don't really get it, and we're stuck with it either way. There're no streetlights on our little path, so without the halo, we'd be smacking right into utility poles.

You found my diploma?! Yeah, I could've become an intercity network expert for the Notarial Hall, or maybe a mobile confessional designer, if I hadn't run off. Do I have any regrets? Duh! But dwelling on them is pointless. If I hadn't joined Penguin Logistics or met you—Nope, not thinking about it!

Yep, I saw the Sankta 'Lord'. The Lord was talking about stuff like genesis, crisis, future... But eh, it's a whole thing, you know. Who's supposed to keep track of all that? I think the Lord's better off staying put in 'The Saints' Travels', and leaving the future for us to decide!

I always try to stay upbeat in a crowd, no matter the vibes. All the pain and sorrow stop right here with me, while I'll give out all the joy I have... Don't I get tired? Course not, I love hanging out.

How come the shop's still shuttered? Ahh... the disaster repairs will take too long, and everyone's going to need time to get used to the new empathy now that the Law's changed... who knows what the future's gonna be like? Ey, is that an ice cream truck I see? Leader, quick! After it! The future? It's right there, in the new flavor we're about to try!

Would I be sad if everyone couldn't stay together? Leader, you're overthinking it. Look at it this way: if we went our separate ways all across the lands, then I'd get to meet up with a friend anywhere I went, right? Keeps me on that logistics grind! And it's the perfect chance to throw a party!

A—Achoo! Wut? Sheesh, my sister just texted to check if I'm good. Nah, overempathy's a pain sometimes, you know? It feels like you've been living in my head, sis. I need some personal space, you know!

Leader, I left a package at your door, so remember to scan and sign for it when you manage to pull your head out of that stack of documents! Huh, weird... didn't you delegate a whole bunch of work already? How are you even busier than before?

We developed several new routes last year to deliver goods for Rhodes Island. Those rascals were so busy they had no time to cause mischief, but they looked much more spirited and energetic. Better life to chase, more glow on face, as it's said. Hahaha... All that's to say, we look forward to your continued support for our business this year, Doctor.

Cut the crap, just stew it. The Doctor and I are friends for life, we'll have nothing but the finest birthday food! Stew the entire cystybeast! Hey, our usual bowls aren't fit for the Doctor. Find a smaller one, just enough for one catty of rice!
Doctor. Yeah, I just finished training. I'll help out once I've cleaned up.

Happy New Year, Doctor! Yeah, I'm preparing to set out. This is the peak season in my line of work. It's nothing. On the contrary, it's a good omen to get busy on the first day of the New Year. Hope we both have a prosperous year, Doctor!
Haha... you're allowed just this once. Ears are my weakness, after all.
Come on, come on—argh! Almost caught that Burderupt! Oh, er, yes, this terminal is normally used for taking inventory, but there's always a way to install games. Keep it a secret, will you?

Oh, it's nothing, just a habit. Always make sure a room's safe before going in. Well, the facilities are secure, but the personnel are a bit... mixed. However, if you trust them, I'll consider it safe.
I'll keep them at bay while you go get backup. Want my goods? Over my dead body!

Look at him run! He even lost his shoes, hahaha! As long as the goods are safe, that's all that matters. Bandits never forget an ass-kicking. Next time they hear our association's escort chant, they'll stay far away.
The goods are intact, and everyone's unhurt! Ahhh, damn it!—I've dreamed of having such a reliable escort leader as you, Doctor.
We're friends for life from this day on, Doctor. One word from you and I'll rush to your aid, even if I'm on the other side of Terra—that's a promise.
I've already drawn my swords. You can beg for your life after we've fought.
Want my goods, none; else my life, one. Come and take it if you dare!
A few broken bones would be a good lesson for you.
Don't pick a fight if you're not prepared to get punched.
Give the signal and I'll do it.
In position. Awaiting your command.
Just tell me where to go.
Just tell me which one to cleave.
They've got guts, coming at us like this. Don't they recognize our banner? Guess we're in for a fight.
The fortune stick reads 'very lucky'! Only took one, two... five draws to get it. What a good sign! Let's go!
Everyone, keep an eye open, your sword at hand and uniform on. Safety first.
Three bulkies, twelve mid-sized… all set. Huh, why is there one more here? Did I count wrong?

There was this time I picked up a cloudbeast on a solo escort mission. We traveled together for a while. But just before entering the city, I set it free, afraid customers might see it and think I was soft. Now, I suppose I wouldn't be afraid to keep such a companion.
Just like when I wore my escort association's badge for the first time. Gotta keep my head bowed and tail tucked. I won't let you lose face, Doc!
My eyelids, they're stuck... Doc, just step on my tail. It's fine, just stomp!

You're the Doctor of Rhodes Island? I've heard so much about you. I sign this, and you'll be an official friend of Windscoot. Any help you might need, just— er... no, I know how to write my name. It's—where do I sign?

Want some dried plums, Doctor? I always eat one when I get sleepy on the night shift. A piece of green plum with no sugar added works better than pinching my thigh. Haha, look at your face! You look like the plum just bit you.

Once I no longer have to worry about the escort association, I want to go wander the jianghu, to see what's out there. Want to come along, Doctor? Where to? Haven't thought about it yet. What matters is wandering free like a fowlbeast, traveling only with my two swords, drawing them at the first sign of injustice, and drinking and singing to my heart's delight.

My swords? This one was given by my adoptive mother. The other was hers—she threw it in my face the day she left. The blood was everywhere. I had tried to convince her to retire from banditry and join the escort business, but she saw it as a betrayal. People... when goals differ, they are quick to call it treachery. She raised me, after all.

What are you eating? Give me a bite; I haven't eaten yet. Ran into a righteous volunteer on the way, he was collecting relief funds for his hometown that got hit by a Catastrophe, so I gave him all my money. A scam? Maybe, but I don't need more money than I can spend, and I can always sock him if it turns out he was lying. It's not like I'll ever starve with you around.

Not every bandit manages to make the move to an honest escort life. Some have walked the way of the bandit for too long to change, many of them were aunts and uncles who watched me grow up. I couldn't look them in the eye when I had to show them out, but people must keep moving forward, right?

I got the crystals on my hand from a highwayman. His legs were shaking and I thought I could talk him out of it, but his mind was made up. When I discarded his Originium explosive, we both got caught in the blast. In the end, I left him some money for his sick child's treatment. As for my own condition, I got used to it long ago.

I'll ask the local bandit boss about the situation here. No, we're not exactly friends, but we sort of pay this toll of theirs. Does that sound like we're in cahoots with the bandits? Hahah, it's just a way we can both make a living. Nobody wants unnecessary bloodshed, if we can help it.

Doctor, take some of these. My family came by during their escort job and brought me some treats from back home. What? We're under attack? Wait, you mean... them? Uh, hey, don't smoke on the landship. Put your shoes on and mind your manners! Don't glare at people like that! Ahem, Doctor... let me introduce you to my family.

In this line of work, encountering odd clients comes with the territory. There was this one time when I was hired to escort a gentleman, he insisted I carry him on my back down a muddy road. I agreed, but said only after terminating our escort contract, because I couldn't defend him while carrying someone on my back.

Thirty-two, then thirty... three? Oh, Doctor? Wait, where was I? Hmm, I've been away half an hour? No worries, almost done. The fiftieth document from the left... one, two... don't worry, I'm the best counter at my escort association.

You are reminiscing about the old Rhodes Island—about all the tragic destruction we witnessed, about the happy reunions we celebrated. But no matter how time wears away our precious memories, the ark beneath our feet will press ahead on its course across the lands. Come, Doctor. Everyone's waiting for you.

Birthdays are special for us. We can't say for certain when our lives started. But at the very least, you have your answer deep within... This gift… Kal'tsit hesitated for too long, and never got to give it to you. Happy birthday.
A new year, and you're still punctual as ever. That means the season's first scientific exam will be your reward— You didn't come to Medical for an appointment? Oh, is this... a present for me?
I'm getting used to my work and responsibilities as quickly as I can. I will be ready for our reunion.
Hee hee, did I scare you?
No priestly eyes on me now, right?
Stop struggling! You always liked it when I had to carry you during a retreat, didn't you?
I'm fine, I already learned how to heal myself. Leave the cleanup to me. You don't want to see what comes next.
Wait a moment, I need to collect tissue samples.
Some cut-to-the-chase commanding. Promise me you'll deploy me closer to the enemy next time, Doctor. I'll try some more efficient techniques.
Ahem, sorry, I used too much force…
This may sting a little. Just bear with it.
My talons shall be my stethoscope.
Ruin, and restore.
Switching forms.
Mon3tr, in position.
Deployment optimized, ready to go.
Communications, linked. Your orders, Doctor.
Enemy engaged. Let's end this quickly.
Make certain my claws don't scratch you!
Do not worry, I've fully mastered the art of tactical command. Don't fear injury, I guarantee you'll make it out alive.
When necessary, you'll see a more familiar side of me.

So long as a spark of hope for life remains, the unending cycle of despair cannot shake me. Not even Originium may force my life into stasis, Doctor. AMa-10 has shattered the fate predetermined at her inception.
She ended our cycle of reincarnation, granting me freedom and eternal life... and loneliness. Yet I cherish it, Doctor. It reminds me of what I have lost.
I saw her.

Leave my file here in the Medical Department, Doctor. Like Kal'tsit said, this is the core where Rhodes Island addresses critical challenges, and my knowledge is crucial. Now, let me concentrate on accomplishing my mission.
Wanna hear some stories about Kal'tsit? The kind she'd never tell anyone.

It was the end Kal'tsit had long anticipated. She prepared well, and faced it with composure. She loathed idle speculation about the future, and just the same refused to dwell on the past. 'Keep going.' I believe that is the only message she would have left us, Doctor. We should just keep moving forward.

Projekt Red likes to curl up and rest by my side, while Folinic always sweetly helps me with things I've overlooked. How should I respond to the way they look at me, Doctor? How did Kal'tsit first learn to love...? I do wish I could hold her once more.

'Protect the Doctor. Protect Amiya.' This directive indeed holds the highest priority in my core behavioral protocols, but this doesn't mean I am compelled to execute it. Protecting you is my own choice— And definitely not because I'm trying to trick you into dealing with an angry Closure!

The anti-Originium communication lines have been destroyed; unable to confirm your receipt of this transmission. The Crystal Activity Index continues to surge, and I've observed its escape from the void. Meltdown protocols initiated. I will eliminate all interceptors. Find her... and Kal'tsit.

Amiya's gone to chair the elite operators' meeting. Hmm... She now appears much taller than I remember... how odd. I'd like to spend more time with her, Doctor, but I find myself feeling rather anxious— We can go together? That's a great idea! Err, I mean, a sensible suggestion.

Why abandon a more efficient, more robust form? Why would I prefer others not fear me? I never considered this before. I made an unconscious decision the moment I awakened. Hey, are you done staring? I can still easily string you up— Huh, you're saying this is what she meant by 'humanity'?

I'm getting used to speaking plainly with the operators, Doctor. They've been cooperating with my check-up requests, and I'm addressing their concerns as Kal'tsit would, in the ways they're accustomed to. Our coordination has become increasingly seamless. Oh? There's been a steep drop in Medical appointments?

Yes, I declined Dr. Warfarin's request to perform a scientific examination on you, as per Kal'tsit's instructions. She wants to study me too? It's worth considering... She could assist with analyzing the knowledge and memories I've acquired. I know what she wants, and our goals are aligned.
Don't worry, this is all routine work. I've reviewed the correct process numerous times. Now... how do I edit these permission logs again?

When we'd just arrived here, I told Warmy Rhodes Island was like a big big transport. She was really excited when she said 'So the Doctor's just like you, a truckie at the steering wheel!' Haha, she's not wrong there. Your work decides the direction Rhodes Island sails, Doctor. Well done, mate.

There're so many days in a year, you gotta save one for yourself. Even the most hardworking diggers can't stay down in the mines all the time, right? So, let's get you out of your office. I'll even take you out for a spin after your birthday party's over, how 'bout it?
Doctor, lemme know if you wanna go for a ride, yeah?

Fancy a bevvy, Doctor? We got a tradition of drinkin' ourselves silly on New Year's Eve. I can deadset leave a whole bunch of truckies legless... Huh? Drunk drivin's bad? Nah, this ain't beer, it's carrot soda!
Take a squiz at this electric welding torch I just got! Wanna give it a go? Slow down, goggles on first.
